jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About McWhirter Steel**

McWhirter Steel is a family owned, Southern California structural steel fabricator and erector serving the construction industry since 1992\. For over three decades McWhirter Steel has built our reputation on quality, craftsmanship, reliability, and unwavering commitment to our clients’ success.

**Position Overview**

The **Project Coordinator** position supports day\-to\-day business operations across the field and administrative teams. This role ensures organizational effectiveness by handling administrative tasks, document control, scheduling, communication, record keeping, and support functions that enable the company to operate efficiently.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple active projects in a fast\-paced construction environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**General Office Administration**

Ø Manage front\-office operations including phones, emails, mail distribution, and visitor coordination

Ø Maintain an organized office environment including conference rooms, supplies, filing, and equipment

Ø Maintain office inventory and reorder supplies as needed

Ø Prepare correspondence, forms, and internal documents for leadership and project teams

Ø Assist with onboarding tasks and coordination for new employees (IT setup, safety orientation packets, HR paperwork)

Ø Support management with scheduling, calendar, and meeting coordination

**Project \& Field Support**

Ø Assist Project Managers with RFIs, submittals, change orders, and tracking logs

Ø Support the Field Superintendent and field leadership with administrative tasks, dispatching support, and documentation

Ø Maintain project binders, drawing logs, and version control

Ø Prepare jobsite packets, installation manuals, and mobilization documents

Ø Coordinate deliveries, trucking schedules, and vendor documentation when needed

Ø Support daily, weekly, and monthly field reporting workflows

Change Management and Cost Control

Ø Assist Project Managers with change order preparation by collecting field documentation, vendor quotations, labor and equipment backup, and other supporting records.

Ø Maintain change order logs, track pricing approval, billing and collection status.

Ø Track project commitments, Purchase Orders, subcontracts, equipment rentals, and vendor costs against project budgets.

Ø Track rental equipment from mobilization through off rent and reconcile rental invoices to help control project equipment costs.

**Document Control \& Compliance**

Ø Maintain accurate filing systems for contracts, POs, submittals, RFIs, safety documents, payroll records, and project files

Ø Ensure all documents comply with internal naming conventions, revision logs, and retention policies

Ø Assist with maintaining company compliance documents such as licenses, insurance certificates, contractor registrations, and vendor forms

Ø Support safety team with maintaining training records, incident reports, and compliance documentation

**Accounting \& Finance Support**

Ø Assist with AP/AR including invoice entry, check processing, receiving paperwork, and billing support

Ø Track job cost documents, receipts, fuel logs, rental equipment invoices, and credit card statements

Ø Support payroll workflows including timesheet collection, union reporting assistance, and filing

Ø Assist with SOV updates, billing packages, lien releases, and preliminary notices as requested

Ø Assist with Purchase Order (PO) requests. Including ordering, receiving, and inventorying of materials and equipment

**Procurement and Vendor Coordination**

Ø Prepare and track Purchase Order requests for project equipment, materials, trucking, cranes, subcontractors, and field support services as directed.

Ø Confirm vendor documentation rates, delivery requirements, invoice, backup, and off rent status.

Ø Communicate professionally with clients, General Contractors, inspectors, vendors, fabricators, and subcontractors while escalating contractual or cost issues to the Project Manager.

**Preconstruction and Estimating Support**

Ø Assist with downloading and organizing plans, specifications, addenda, and bid documents when needed.

Ø Support turnover from estimating to operations by organizing proposal, scope, clarifications, budgets, schedules, and project startup information.

Ø Maintain historical project records and cost information that support future estimating and operational planning.

**Qualifications**

Ø Two to five years of project coordination, project administration, or project engineering experience in commercial construction.

Ø Structural steel, miscellaneous metals, or specialty subcontractor experience is strongly preferred.

Ø Working knowledge of construction drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, change orders, and project documentation.

Ø Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities.

Ø Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, SharePoint, and OneDrive.

Ø Experience with Bluebeam, Tekla, Foundation, Microsoft Project, or comparable construction systems is preferred.

Ø Strong written and verbal communication skills with professional follow through.

Ø Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment with project financial and employee information.

Ø Self starter who identifies needs, follows issues through completion, and works effectively with both office and field teams.

**Working Conditions**

Ø Primarily office based in Anaheim, California, with periodic visits to active construction sites.

Ø Standard Monday through Friday schedule with flexibility based on project and business needs.

Ø Jobsite visits may require personal protective equipment and compliance with site specific safety requirements.

Ø Ability to sit, use a computer, and communicate by phone or video for extended periods and occasionally lift or carry project materials u

jobs.title: Project Coordinator, ESCO
jobs.description:
**Company And Culture**



Complex is the definitive platform for global youth culture and music lifestyle, seamlessly integrating cutting\-edge content, commerce and live experiences with unparalleled scale. Through innovative content, Complex tells stories of music, streetwear and style, sports, art and beyond. Its content engages in a dynamic conversation with the audience, reflecting and shaping the zeitgeist of convergence culture. A powerful media juggernaut paired with a curated marketplace, Complex is redefining the way fans interact with their favorite brands and artists and reshaping the future of digital culture and commerce.


**Why We're Hiring**



The Project Coordinator will provide cross\-functional support to ESCO’s Brand Management and Business Development teams, helping move new partnerships and licensed products from initial opportunity through development, approval, and launch.



This person will serve as a central liaison among ESCO’s internal Product, Creative, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal teams—as well as external IP holders, record labels, artist management teams, licensors, agencies, retailers, and other partners.



The Project Coordinator will manage project timelines, partner submissions, product and creative approvals, meeting follow\-ups, asset requests, and key deliverables. The role will also support ESCO’s growing business\-development pipeline through research, presentation development, opportunity tracking, and partner coordination.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously. This is an opportunity to gain hands\-on experience across licensing, business development, brand management, product development, and go\-to\-market execution within a rapidly growing music and culture collectibles business.



The successful Project Coordinator will bring structure, visibility, and consistent follow\-through to ESCO’s partnership and product\-development processes.



Projects will have clearly defined timelines, owners, deliverables, and next steps. Partner submissions and approvals will be accurately tracked, feedback will reach the right teams, and potential delays will be identified early. The business\-development pipeline will remain organized and current, enabling leadership to make informed decisions and prioritize the strongest opportunities.



Most importantly, this person will help ESCO turn more partnership opportunities into successful products by ensuring seamless coordination from initial conversation through development, approval, and launch.



### **What You'll Do**

**Project and Brand Management**
* Support the Director of Brand Management in coordinating licensed\-product development from initial concept through production and launch.
* Build, maintain, and communicate project timelines, milestones, approval deadlines, launch dates, and internal deliverables.
* Coordinate project kickoffs and ensure internal teams receive the necessary deal terms, creative direction, assets, style guides, product requirements, and partner information.
* Track product concepts, card checklists, artwork, packaging, samples, marketing materials, and other project deliverables.
* Schedule project meetings, prepare agendas, capture decisions, document action items, and follow up with responsible team members.
* Identify missing information, approval delays, and other potential risks before they affect production or launch timing.
* Coordinate handoffs among Business Development, Brand Management, Product, Creative, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal.
* Support the development and maintenance of product calendars, launch trackers, approval logs, and project\-status reports.
* Help ensure that internal teams remain aligned on partner expectations, contractual requirements, product scope, and launch timing.

**Licensing and Partner Approvals**
* Serve as a day\-to\-day liaison between ESCO’s internal teams and IP holders, record labels, artist management teams, licensors, agencies, and brand partners.
* Coordinate submissions and approvals for product concepts, artwork, card designs, packaging, copy, photography, promotional materials, retail presentations, and product samples.
* Maintain detailed approval trackers showing submission dates, partner feedback, revision status, deadlines, and final approvals.
* Review submissions for completeness and accuracy before sending them to external partners.
* Consolidate partner feedback and translate it into clear, actionable direction for Product, Creative, and Marketing teams.
* Follow up with partners to keep approvals moving and escalate potential delays when necessary.
* Maintain organized records of approved artwork, assets, legal notices, logos, trademarks, style guides, samples, and approval correspondence.
* Track relevant contractual requirements, including approved product categories, territories, distribution channels, exclusivity, launch windows, talent approvals, and marketing commitments.
* Coordinate the receipt and movement of partner\-supplied materials such as photography, video, reference assets, autographs, relics, logos, and brand guidelines.

**Business Development Support**
* Support the Director of Business Development in identifying and developing new partnerships, licensing opportunities, distribution relationships, brand collaborations, and growth initiatives.
* Research prospective artists, entertainment properties, brands, licensors, retailers, distributors, and strategic partners.
* Assist with pitch decks, presentations, proposals, product concepts, meeting materials, and opportunity summaries.
* Coordinate introductory calls, partner meetings, presentations, follow\-up communications, and next steps.
* Maintain ESCO’s business\-development pipeline, including partner contacts, opportunity stages, deal status, revenue potential, open requests, and next a

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator - Center for Interprofessional Education
jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE: Administrative Coordinator**

**DEPARTMENT: Center for Interprofessional Education** **REPORTS TO: Dean, Center for Interprofessional Education****LOCATION: Hybrid Remote (Whittier, California)** **FLSA STATUS: Non\-Exempt, Part\-time (20 hours per week)****RATE OF PAY: $22\.00 to $25\.00 per hour** **SUMMARY:**  

The Center for Interprofessional Education (CIPE) Coordinator plays a key role in advancing the university’s mission of preparing future health professionals for collaborative, team\-based care. This position provides comprehensive coordination for interprofessional education (IPE) activities, the Interprofessional Health Professions (IHP) courses, and the Standardized Patient (SP) program. Working in close partnership with faculty, staff, students, and external collaborators, the coordinator ensures high\-quality programming, seamless operations, and alignment with national best practices, including the Interprofessional Education Collaborative (IPEC) Core Competencies.  

The coordinator reports to the Dean of Interprofessional Education and serves as a central point of contact for IPE activities and SP operations, supporting both the strategic vision of the Center and the day\-to\-day execution of its programs. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Interprofessional Education (IPE) Coordination**

* Coordinate logistics for IPE virtual and on\-ground events, workshops, and activities across all health sciences programs.
* Manage event scheduling, registration, communications, and accurate record\-keeping.
* Serve as the primary contact for faculty and student participants in IPE activities.
* Support assessment efforts, including distribution and collection of pre\-/post\-surveys, attendance tracking, and preparation of evaluation reports.
* Collaborate with program directors and deans to align IPE activities with curricular needs, accreditation standards, and institutional outcomes.
* Provide administrative support for IPE Council and Advisory Board meetings, including scheduling, agenda preparation, minutes, archiving, and attendance tracking.
* Assist with IHP course coordination, including faculty support, assessment tracking, and course\-related communications.
* Maintain and update the CIPE website and ensure organized archiving of course and event materials.

 **Standardized Patient (SP) Program Coordination**

* Recruit, onboard, and maintain a diverse pool of standardized patients to meet institutional and programmatic needs.
* Schedule and assign SPs for IPE\-related simulations, ensuring adequate coverage and smooth execution of events.
* Track SP participation, training, and performance to ensure consistency and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with institutional policies, FERPA/HIPAA regulations, and confidentiality standards.
* Manage programmatic scheduling needs and calculate budgetary requirements for SP activities.
* Process timely payment for SPs and maintain accurate financial tracking for the SP program.
* Monitor the SP pool, documenting each SP’s strengths, areas for improvement, and training needs.
* Generate annual reports on SP utilization by program to support planning, resource allocation, and accreditation documentation.

 **Collaboration \& Communication**

* Serve as liaison between the CIPE, academic programs, and external partners to ensure alignment and shared goals.
* Maintain clear and timely communication with faculty, students, and SPs to support effective coordination.
* Foster a culture of professionalism, inclusivity, and excellence in all CIPE and SP\-related activities.

 **Evaluation \& Continuous Improvement**

* Collect, analyze, and report data from IPE and SP activities to inform continuous quality improvement.
* Provide regular reports to CIPE leadership and contribute to accreditation documentation.
* Identify opportunities for innovation and growth in IPE and SP programming in alignment with national best practices.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in education, health sciences, public health, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in program coordination, higher education, healthcare, or simulation\-based learning.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with faculty, staff, students, standardized patients, and external partners.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a diverse, fast\-paced academic environment.
* Familiarity with interprofessional education, simulation\-based training, or standardized patient methodology strongly preferred.

**NOTE:** The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the person assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills, and physical demands required of personnel so classified.

 **LOCATION**:  

This position is primarily hybrid. The role requires on\-campus presence at least once per week, with additional in\-person days as needed to support essential functions such as interprofessional events, standardized patient sessions, or team\-based collaboration. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

 **SKILLS, ABILITIES, AND QUALIFICATIONS:**  

**Education and/or Experience**  

Bachelor's degree from four\-year college or university; or 5 years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. **Communication and Language Skills**  

* Ability to read, interpret, and prepare documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to prepare clear, concise, reports and correspondence.
* Ability to speak effectively before groups of faculty, staff, students, and other member

jobs.title: Product Operations Assistant
jobs.description:
**SUMMARY**


Punch Studio designs and supplies premium home, gift, and stationery products for specialty retailers worldwide. With creative work led by an in\-house design team, the company brings together design, product development, and operational execution to deliver products that meet the needs of retail partners across a dynamic wholesale environment.


We're looking for a Product Operations Assistant to support our retail customer programs, working with suppliers and internal teams to ensure timely, accurate execution of sampling and ticketing. This mid\-level role suits a motivated self\-starter with a solid grasp of our industry, an aptitude for numbers, and sharp communication skills. You'll coordinate multiple programs simultaneously across different stages of the product lifecycle, where data integrity, accurate data mapping, and close attention to detail are essential, along with strong organization and consistent communication with all stakeholders at every stage. Ideally, you bring prior experience in program coordination within a wholesale or distribution environment and can deliver standards\-driven management for our high\-profile retail accounts.

 **Requirements** **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Communicate with factories on QA/QC and production feedback, tracking progress through final approval
* Partner with Sales, Product Development, Purchasing, and Logistics to calculate freight weights, dimensions, and CBMs to maximize container space
* Lead program circulation with Sales, Product Development, and Purchasing and Logistics, tracking milestones and flagging deadline risks to internal and external stakeholders.
* Proactively lead all internal and external communications for customer programs.
* Lead vendor assignment with a deep understanding of scheduled delivery dates and overall feasibility, proactively flagging challenges and offering solution\-oriented contingencies.
* Run and distribute weekly Master Production Schedule (MPS) reports
* Prepare upload files accurately, with attention to detail and an understanding of data mapping.
* Own the sampling process end to end — production, delivery, check\-in, labeling, and internal distribution; maintain an organized sample library by customer.
* Manage the full ticketing process, including ordering, tracking, the customer ticketing log, and deadline communication
* Support Creative, Sales, Product Development, and Logistics teams with sample retrieval as needed

**QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS**


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation will be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE:**

* 3\+ years of experience as a program coordinator, program specialist, or in a similar role.
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, Project Management, or a related field preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Experience in wholesale or distribution settings, including retail customer programs and supplier coordination.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:**

* Detail\-oriented, with solid knowledge of program management and product development procedures.
* Strong project management skills, from planning and scheduling through delivery, and able to work independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple simultaneous deadlines.
* Experience with reporting, data mapping, and upload file preparation.
* Experience working with factories and suppliers, and with internal partners such as Sales, Product Development, Purchasing, and Logistics.
* Must be eligible to work in the United States.
* Available to communicate with suppliers outside normal working hours during peak season.
* PMP/PRINCE2 certification a plus.

 **OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

* Positive Attitude
* Team Player

  

**Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k)

jobs.title: Lead Clinical Research Coordinator - Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description:
Folio Clinical Research


Job: Lead Clinical Research Coordinator


Location: Los Angeles, CA (5x a week)


About Folio Clinical Research


Folio Clinical Research is a leading urologic research network treating urologic cancers, urinary stones, Peyronie’s disease, sexual and erectile dysfunction (ED), low testosterone, prostate disorders, urinary incontinence, and more. We partner with leading physician practices to create a cohesive, quality\-oriented clinical culture, facilitating best practice sharing across our platform. Our affiliated practices gain access to a broad suite of clinical trials, providing significant benefits to both physicians and patients.


Position Overview


The Lead Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) works directly under the supervision of the Principal Investigator (PI) to manage all aspects of clinical trial activities. The CRC is essential in facilitating and coordinating daily clinical trial activities, ensuring compliance, quality, and efficiency throughout the trial process. This role involves direct collaboration with the PI, sponsors, and other key stakeholders. The CRC will interact with patients during the recruitment and screening process. The CRC will also facilitate the informed consent process and provide ongoing participant support as needed.


About You:

* Experienced Clinical Research Leader: You have a proven track record in managing clinical research operations, from feasibility assessments to study close\-out.
* Operational Expertise: You have deep experience managing day\-to\-day research site operations, ensuring adherence to protocol and regulatory standards
* Mentorship Skills: You have training experience and can successfully collaborate with Principal Investigators, particularly those with minimal research experience.
* Proactive Problem Solver: You always plan ahead and are proactive about having contingency strategies in place.
* Business Acumen: You execute with a sense of urgency, maintaining a keen focus on both research objectives and business outcomes.
* Commitment to Quality and Timeliness: You manage study timelines without compromising on quality.
* Passion for Innovation: You are dedicated to bringing life\-altering treatments to market, driven by patient outcomes.
* Effective Communicator: You communicate clearly and regularly, keeping all stakeholders informed and ensuring a smooth study.
* Self\-Driven: You thrive with minimal supervision, taking ownership and responsibility for your deliverables.


Key Responsibilities:

* Regulatory and Institutional Compliance: Support the Principal Investigator and relevant departments to ensure all clinical research activities comply with federal regulations, institutional policies, and sponsor requirements.
* Documentation Management: Maintain secure and accurate storage of all study documents, including consent forms, case report forms, and investigational material records, in compliance with both sponsor and institutional requirements.
* Study Oversight: Support the PI in ensuring the study meets compliance standards, including Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals, health and safety requirements, conflict of interest disclosures, and adherence to financial terms.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Maintain regular and effective communication with Sponsors, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), and internal team members (e.g., Investigators, Nurses, Medical Assistants) to facilitate study progress.
* Meeting Participation: Engage in Site Qualification Visits (SQVs), Site Initiation Visits (SIVs), Interim Monitoring Visits (IMVs), and other key study meetings as required.
* Problem\-Solving and Adaptation: Identify and anticipate potential obstacles to study timelines or deliverables, offering creative solutions to maintain momentum and study integrity.
* Inventory and Equipment Management: Manage study\-specific inventory, including identification, ordering, calibration, and secure storage of equipment required for the study.


Qualifications:

* Minimum of five years of Clinical Research Coordinator experience.
* Experience with various Electronic Data Capture (EDC), Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), and electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) systems.
* Comprehensive understanding of urology and other associated therapeutic areas, medical terminology, to effectively execute clinical trials.
* Deep knowledge of ICH\-GCP, and regulatory requirements, with the ability to implement these effectively throughout the clinical trial.
* Experience with data management processes, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of data collection, entry, and reporting, in line with Good Clinical Data Management Practices (GCDMP).
* Experience ensuring and prioritizing patient safety and data integrity, embodying a commitment to the ethical conduct of clinical trials.
* Experience maintaining the highest quality standards, while focusing on ongoing process improvements that lead to enhanced clinical trial efficiency and compliance.
* Excellent interpersonal communication, both written and verbal. Can easily interface with team members and external stakeholders. Proven ability to develop positive relationships with internal teams, physicians, and external partners.
* Strong attention to detail, and ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a dynamic research environment.
* Strong computer skills (MS Office, M PowerPoint, etc.) and software experience (CTMS, eTMF, EDC, IXRS, RTSM, etc.)
* Ability to prioritize tasks, effectively manage time, and allocate resources efficiently to meet tight study deadlines.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education/experience in science or health\-related field.

Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Policy.

**Administrative Coordinator**


**California Coalition for Worker Power (CCWP)**  

Housed at Koreatown Immigrant Workers Alliance (KIWA)

 **About CCWP**



The California Coalition for Worker Power (CCWP) is a statewide table of worker centers, labor policy advocates, and unions advancing strategies that build durable worker power across California. Our coalition focuses on structural reforms that strengthen worker organizations, expand collective voice, and protect workers, including immigrant and Black workers, from retaliation and exploitation.California Coalition for Worker Power seeks an Interim Managing Director who understands coalition dynamics, coalition tables, operational systems and finances and can work collaboratively with CCWP leadership team, staff, and partners.

 **Overview**


* Position Type: Full\-time, exempt
* Location: Hybrid, must be California\-based. Periodic travel to Sacramento and other in\-state locations required.
* Travel: Periodic travel to Sacramento and other in\-state locations required.
* Reports To: Policy Campaign Manager

  


**Job Description**

  


We are seeking an Administrative Coordinator to provide essential coordination to a statewide coalition of worker centers, labor partners, and community organizations, in order to operate effectively. This role supports communication and communication protocols, manages event logistics, digital and security documentation, financial reimbursements, and day\-to\-day coordination across coalition partners, to ensure that coalition and campaign activities stay organized, timely, and aligned.

* Draft and distribute coalition updates, meeting reminders, announcements, and other communications.

* Assist with organizing sensitive coalition notes, campaign materials, presentations, and shared communications resources.
* Help maintain and update the coalition’s website, shared calendars, contact lists, and organizational directories.

  


**Event \& Program Coordination**

  

* Drive planning and logistics for training, convenings, retreats, campaign events, and statewide gatherings.
* Coordinate with coalition partners including registrations, travel arrangements, interpretation needs, venue communication, catering, and materials preparation.
* Lead in\-person event setup, participant support, and post\-event follow\-up.

  


**Coalition Support**

  

* Serve as a professional and welcoming point of contact for member organizations and external partners.
* Support coordination among coalition committees, working groups, and campaigns.
* Help track action items, deadlines, and coalition deliverables.

  


**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools** such as Asana, Airtable, Monday.com, Google Workspace, or similar platforms; ability to create organized systems for tracking tasks, timelines, and deliverables.
* **Strong organizational and communication skills**, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* **Ability to work independently, manage complex projects, and competing deadlines.**
* **Demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism.**
* **Ability to work collaboratively with diverse partners and stakeholders**, while building trust, following through on commitments, and supporting a team\-oriented culture.
* **Commitment to worker justice, economic equity, and the values of coalition\-based organizing and advocacy**
* **Bilingual in Spanish** is a plus.

  


**Compensation and Benefits**

 **Salary**: $70,304 \- $75,000 to be negotiated based on experience and scope.

 **Benefits:** Employee healthcare, dental and vision plan; PTO and paid holidays; 403b retirement plan

 **Supervision \& Collaboration Structure**

  

The Administrative Coordinator will:

  

* **Report to the CCWP Policy Campaign Manager** and support the coordination and execution of campaign and coalition priorities.
* **Collaborate closely with the incoming CCWP Interim Managing Director and Co\-Managing Directors**, as well as other staff and coalition partners, to support effective communication, coordination, and organizational alignment.

Responsibilities
  
  

About the role
  
The TikTok LIVE Automotive team partners with top global automotive brands and their dealer networks to unlock live streaming as a new customer acquisition and lead generation channel. This role owns a portfolio of headline automotive KA (Key Account) brands end\-to\-end: co\-designing joint annual and campaign budgets, building the go\-live playbook with brand HQ and local dealers, driving live streaming quality and lead conversion on the ground, and turning early KA wins into scalable case studies that lift the whole automotive vertical. The goal is not more livestreams, it is real business outcomes (leads, test drives, orders) that make TikTok LIVE a must\-have channel for automotive marketing.
  
  

What you'll do
  
* KA account ownership: Own a portfolio of headline global automotive brands (OEMs and their dealer groups) as the primary TikTok LIVE point of contact, build multi\-level relationships across brand marketing, digital, retail, and agency stakeholders, and land TikTok LIVE inside their annual marketing and digital plan.
* Joint budget \& business planning: Co\-develop annual and campaign\-level budgets with each brand (media spend, live streaming activation, dealer subsidies, creator collaboration), align on KPIs (leads, CPL, test drives, showroom traffic, orders), and secure written commitments and quarterly business reviews.
* Live streaming guidance: Provide hands\-on coaching on live streaming strategy, content structure, host / dealer sales talent selection, live room setup, product demo scripts, interaction and lead\-capture mechanics, and use of live streaming and lead tools, so brand and dealer live rooms consistently hit quality and conversion benchmarks.
* Campaign execution: Design and land integrated campaigns around new car launches, auto shows, seasonal moments, and always\-on dealer live streaming, working with in\-app product entries, ads, creators, and offline events.
* Customer success \& LIVE ROI: Track full\-funnel performance (impressions, viewership, leads, CPL, dealer handoff, test drive, order), diagnose gaps, and iterate playbooks so each KA brand can prove positive live streaming ROI and renew / expand budget.
* Dealer \& creator ecosystem: Coordinate brand HQ, regional offices, country subsidiaries, dealer groups, and automotive creators into one live streaming operating model, and turn top\-performing dealers and creators into references that pull in the long tail.
* Playbook \& case sedimentation: Turn winning campaigns into repeatable automotive live streaming playbooks (by segment: mass\-market/NEV/used\-car, by market, by campaign type), and lead knowledge transfer to sales, dealer, and cross\-market teams.
* Cross\-functional collaboration: Work closely with sales, product, ads, creator, data, and governance teams to unblock KA needs, feed automotive\-specific requirements back into product and ad solutions, and represent the automotive industry point of view internally.


Qualifications
  
  

Minimun Qualification(s)
  
* Bachelor's degree or above, with 5\+ years of automotive\-industry experience in one of the following backgrounds: (1\) automotive KA / brand partnership / sales roles at OEMs, dealer groups, automotive agencies, or automotive media / marketing platforms; (2\) prior experience at a leading Chinese automotive brand's global / overseas business.
* Solid understanding of the global automotive brand and dealer ecosystem: how OEMs, regional offices, dealer groups, 4S stores, and automotive agencies work together on marketing budget, leads, and sales funnel.
* Hands\-on live streaming operations experience: able to guide a brand or dealer live room end\-to\-end, from content and host to interaction mechanics, lead capture, and conversion optimization.
* Strong commercial and budget sense: comfortable co\-owning annual budget conversations with senior brand and agency stakeholders, and defending the plan with data and ROI.
* Data\-driven: able to build a full\-funnel automotive metric system (impressions → viewership → leads → test drive → order), read data to find problems, and validate operations with experiments and control groups.
* Strong cross\-functional and project\-driving skills, comfortable coordinating brand, dealer, agency, product, ads, creator, and data stakeholders in parallel.
* Working proficiency in English, able to collaborate directly with overseas automotive brands, dealers, and internal teams and passionate about the automotive industry, live streaming, and creator economy, and willing to stay close to frontline brands, dealers, and live rooms.


Preferred Qualification(s)
  
* Prior experience at an OEM, dealer group, automotive agency, or automotive vertical of a major internet / e\-commerce / live streaming platform.
* Familiarity with automotive lead management and CRM systems, and with how leads are handed off from platform to dealer to sales.
* Experience running new\-car launch, auto show, or large\-scale automotive marketing campaigns across online and offline channels.
* Experience operating in multiple markets (US, EU, MENA, SEA, LATAM) or working with global brand HQ and local dealer networks in parallel.

As L.A.'s premier performing arts destination, The Music Center convenes artists, communities and ideas with the goal of deepening the cultural lives of every resident in Los Angeles County. The People Operations Coordinator supports a strategic People Operations department by coordinating key employee lifecycle processes across two sites. This role partners closely with People Operations leadership, site leaders, employees, and cross\-functional teams to support recruiting, onboarding, offboarding, employee records, People Operations communications, and day\-to\-day employee inquiries. The People Operations Coordinator helps ensure people processes are completed accurately, consistently, and timely while providing a positive employee experience and supporting the department’s broader people and business priorities.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBLITIES**

* Support recruiting activities, including job posting coordination, candidate communication, interview scheduling, offer coordination, background check follow\-up, and applicant tracking updates.
* Coordinate onboarding activities for new hires across two sites, including new hire communication, orientation scheduling, onboarding documentation, system updates, and coordination with hiring managers and support teams.
* Support offboarding processes, including separation documentation, exit coordination, final checklist completion, system updates, and communication with appropriate internal partners.
* Serve as a point of contact for employee questions and People Operations\-related inquiries, escalating matters to the People Operations Manager or appropriate people partner when needed.
* Maintain accurate employee records in both digital and hard copy formats, ensuring documentation is organized, confidential, and compliant with company requirements.
* Assist with HRIS data entry, employee changes, reporting, tracking, and audit preparation to support data accuracy and HR decision\-making.
* Partner with People Operations leadership to support employee engagement activities, People Operations communications, site events, and initiatives that align with the department’s people strategy.
* Coordinate meetings, interviews, orientations, trainings, and HR events across two sites while ensuring clear communication with employees, managers, and cross\-functional partners.
* Assist with compliance\-related administrative support, including filing, tracking, record retention, and preparation of employee documentation.
* Support People Operations projects, process improvements, and administrative priorities that improve consistency, efficiency, and employee experience across the sites.
* Perform other duties as required.

**MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Educations and/or Experience

jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Healthcare, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* 2 years of experience handling workers compensation claims.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience with claims management systems, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS) platforms, and standard productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets).
* Solid working knowledge of end\-to\-end workers compensation procedures, claims administration, and relevant state and federal labor laws.
* Comprehensive understanding of medical terminology, treatment protocols, and injury evaluation.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Workers Compensation and Owner Controlled Insurance Policy (OCIP) Program Lead oversees the strategic governance, placement, and daily administration of owner\-controlled insurance programs and occupational injury claims. This role drives end\-to\-end risk management by conducting exposure analyses, directing policy audits, and partnering closely with brokers and contractors to optimize coverage structures and ensure seamless program enrollment.


In addition to program strategy, the lead directs full\-lifecycle workers compensation claims management across employees, owners, and contractors. Acting as the primary liaison among injured workers, insurance carriers, legal counsel, and healthcare providers, the role coordinates quality medical care and facilitates prompt, modified\-duty return\-to\-work transitions. Furthermore, the position ensures regulatory compliance and workplace safety by delivering supervisor training, maintaining comprehensive claims databases, and analyzing incident trends to implement proactive, data\-driven injury prevention initiatives.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead end\-to\-end insurance placement and strategic risk mitigation across all operations. Manage data processing for policy placement, oversee policy audits, analyze program structures, and direct enrollments with OCIP brokers and contractors.
* Receive and process claims for owners, employees, and contractors, arrange medical care and facilitate return\-to\-work and modified\-duty accommodations.
* Serve as primary contact for injured workers, liaise with carriers, clinics, and legal counsel and maintain detailed incidents and financial records.
* Deliver supervisors claim training, analyze incident trends to prevent recurring injuries, and ensure alignment with workers compensation regulations.
* Evaluate risk exposures, design proactive risk control solutions, and build strategic vendor and insurer relationships.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
Role Name: Lead Recruiting Coordinator


Department: Talent


Location: San Carlos


Shift:


### **About 1X**


We’re building humanoid robots that work in home \- doing the chores, handling the tasks, and giving people their time back. Simple, but it’s not.


To do this right, we have to solve robotics, AI, manufacturing \- at the same time, at scale, in a form factor that has to be safe enough to live with your family. If you’re inspired by this, you’ll thrive here. We’ve been at this since 2014 and we’re at the point where the hard problems are behind us and the *hard work* is in front of us.


NEO is our flagship \- a home robot designed to move, learn, and operate in the real world alongside real people. We’re not demoing it \- we’re shipping it. We’re excited to meet you, if this excites you.


If you’ve spent your career working on problems that matter and want to see them actually reach the world \- this is that moment. We’re scaling, we’re hiring with intention, and we need people who want to build something that will genuinely change how humans spend their time \- safely creating abundance for all.

### **About the Team:**


The Talent team hires the people who build NEO: robotics, AI, manufacturing, and the teams that support them. Recruiting Coordination is the operating layer of that work. Every interview, every candidate touchpoint, and every record in Ashby runs through this team, so when coordination is excellent, 1X hires faster and candidates leave every conversation wanting to work here.

### **Your Charter:**


The mission of this role is to give a seamless experience during every interview, and to make the coordination function faster every quarter. You are one of two Lead Recruiting Coordinators. Each of you owns half of the hiring org end to end, from scheduling and candidate communication to data integrity in Ashby. You lead by setting the standard for quality and speed, and by being the person the team turns to when something breaks. Hiring speed is on 1X’s critical path, and this role is where that speed is won or lost day to day.

### **Key Outcomes:**

* Own end\-to\-end interview scheduling for executive and high\-volume roles in your half of the org, delivered without errors, with last\-minute conflicts resolved quickly and calmly.
* Deliver consistently high satisfaction scores from candidates and hiring managers through transparent, timely communication with every interview participant.
* Drive down time\-to\-schedule and time\-to\-feedback by identifying bottlenecks in the hiring workflow and implementing automation for scheduling and feedback collection.
* Optimize and iterate the coordination team’s playbooks and training guides so every coordinator runs the same process and new hires ramp fast.
* Lead as the escalation point for daily operational issues in your half of the org, setting the bar for quality and speed across the coordination team, and keep Ashby complete and current as the single source of truth for every open role.

### **Key Competencies:**

* Handles confidential candidates, compensation, and offer information with total accuracy and discretion.
* Stays calm and decisive when a schedule breaks an hour before the interview, and fixes it without creating noise for the candidate or the panel.
* Thinks in systems: sees a repeated problem and fixes the process, not only the instance.
* Communicates clearly and proactively with executives, hiring managers, and candidates, in writing and live.
* Sets a high standard and holds peers to it without direct authority.

### **Minimum Requirements:**

* 7\+ years of recruiting coordination experience, including scheduling for executive or high\-volume roles
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi\-participant interview schedules without errors
* Experience with an applicant tracking system as the system of record for hiring
* Proven track record of being the escalation point for a coordination or operations team

### **Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in Ashby
* Experience in implementing scheduling automation or workflow tooling, such as ATS integrations or no\-code automations
* Exposure to writing team playbooks, standard operating procedures, or training documentation
* Familiarity with hiring for hardware, robotics, or AI teams

### **What does a successful 1X Team Member look like:**


Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it’s the one thing you can’t get back \- because it is. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect.

### **Compensation Range:**


$100,000 \- $125,000

### **Benefits:**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Generous paid time off, company holidays, and parental leave
* 401(k) plan with company match (100% on the first 3% of contributions, 50% on the next 2%)
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) options
* Commuter benefits (transit and parking)
* Short\-term and long\-term disability, and life insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health, financial, and personal support
* Onsite snacks and catered lunches

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**


1X is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, disability, military or veteran status, justice system impact, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.


Compensation Range: $100K \- $125K

jobs.description:

Under the supervision of a Clinical Research Supervisor or Principal Investigator (PI), the incumbent will perform entry\-level duties related to the support and coordination of clinical studies, and may receive training and development to prepare and advance for journey\-level work at the next level within the series.


The Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator may be responsible for the coordination of one or more single or multi\-site, active or follow\-up clinical studies and may help design flow sheets, data forms and source documents; gather and interpret medical, surgical and laboratory data regarding clinical subjects; may apply understanding of inclusion/exclusion eligibility criteria for protocols; help recruit, enroll, register, schedule and retain study subjects; record protocol specific treatments and assure collection and shipment of samples; assist research personnel to keep patients on study schedules; complete study forms to submit to sponsors and/or appropriate agencies; collect, enter and clean data into study databases, maintaining data quality; assist with data analysis; assist with preparation of reports and tables; attend team meetings; and perform other duties as assigned.


  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience
* Experience writing scientific correspondence
* Excellent verbal and written communications and presentation skills ; excellent organizational skills; and excellent interpersonal skills to work effectively in a diverse team
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Windows
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-based environment; project management and coordination skills; ability to prioritize tasks and meet multiple deadlines on concurrent projects.
* Ability to establish cooperative working relationships with patients, co\-workers, \& physicians.
* Ability to work independently, exercising judgment and initiative
* Detail oriented, self\-motivated and a record of exceptional performance meeting multiple deadlines for concurrent projects
  

Preferred Qualifications:


* MRI brain imaging experience
* Blood biomarker experience
* BA/BS in neuroscience or a related science and sufficient experience and demonstrated skills to successfully perform the assigned duties and responsibilities
* Demonstrated proficiency with medical terminology
* Experience working with elderly patients or study subjects with neurodegenerative diseases
* Ability to abstract data from medical records and transfer it to data collection forms or directly into databases
* Experience performing statistical analysis
* Experiences preparing IRB submissions and helping with grant/manuscript preparation
* Experience analyzing data using statistical software

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
Logistics Operations Coordinator – Robotics

**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Locations:** Mountain View, CA  
**Positions Available:** 2

**Mountain View:** On\-site attendance required  
**Cambridge:** Remote working can be considered; candidates must be available to work Eastern Time (ET) hours

About the Opportunity

We are supporting a world\-leading advanced technology organization to expand its Logistics Operations function within a cutting\-edge **robotics, engineering and R\&D environment**.

We are seeking Logistics Operations Coordinators to take ownership of the day\-to\-day movement of specialist equipment, components, materials and other assets required by technical teams.

This is a hands\-on operational logistics position where accuracy, organization and reliable execution are critical. You will manage shipments from initial request through to final delivery, ensuring appropriate documentation is in place, processes are followed and stakeholders have clear visibility throughout.

You will work closely with robotics and laboratory teams, internal operations functions, suppliers and logistics partners to ensure equipment and materials reach the right location safely, compliantly and on time.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the day\-to\-day logistics pipeline, coordinating shipments from initial request through to final delivery.
* Coordinate the domestic and international movement of specialist equipment, components and materials supporting robotics, engineering and R\&D activities.
* Act as a key operational point of contact for internal robotics, engineering and laboratory teams requiring shipments.
* Gather accurate shipment requirements and ensure all necessary information is captured prior to dispatch.
* Coordinate with internal teams, suppliers, freight providers and other external partners.
* Obtain and maintain accurate shipping documentation, including commercial invoices, customs information and relevant regulatory paperwork.
* Ensure shipments are processed in line with established internal procedures and applicable customs and legal requirements.
* Track shipments throughout the delivery lifecycle and provide clear, timely updates to stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate shipment records and logistics data using spreadsheets, tracking tools and internal systems.
* Proactively identify potential delays, documentation gaps, compliance issues and other risks that could impact delivery.
* Escalate bottlenecks and operational issues to the Logistics Manager to support rapid resolution.
* Identify recurring issues or areas of non\-compliance within the logistics pipeline.
* Support a fast\-paced technical environment where the timely availability of equipment and materials is critical to ongoing robotics and engineering programs.

Experience \& Skills

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and highly organized logistics professional who is comfortable taking ownership of multiple shipments and priorities.

You should have:

* Previous experience in logistics, shipping, supply chain coordination or a similar process\-driven operational role.
* Practical knowledge of domestic and/or international shipping processes.
* Experience working with shipping documentation, including commercial invoices, shipping terms and customs documentation.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly when handling shipping documentation and operational data.
* Experience working within established processes, policies and compliance requirements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A proactive approach to identifying and escalating issues.
* Experience with spreadsheets, data entry, shipment tracking tools or logistics systems.
* The ability to operate effectively within a fast\-paced, global environment.

Desirable Experience

Experience within one or more of the following environments would be particularly valuable:

* Robotics and automation
* Engineering and advanced technology
* Research \& Development
* Laboratory or technical facilities
* Electronics and hardware
* Aerospace or automotive
* Manufacturing or industrial technology
* Scientific or research organizations

Experience coordinating **high\-value, specialist, technical or sensitive equipment** would also be advantageous.

The Environment

This is not a traditional high\-volume warehouse or distribution role.

You will be supporting specialist robotics, engineering and R\&D teams that rely on the efficient movement of technical equipment, components and materials.

The role requires someone who can combine strong logistics fundamentals with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to operate effectively in a highly technical, fast\-moving environment.

Pay: $26\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: CLIENT EXPERIENCE & MARKETING COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
ABOUT HARMONIA PILATES

Harmonia Pilates is a new boutique reformer Pilates studio opening in San Francisco’s Richmond District. We offer strength\-focused, progressive movement in a refined but welcoming environment.

Our values—Strength, Balance and Community—guide everything from our classes to the way each client is welcomed into the studio.

THE ROLE

We are looking for an organized, creative and outgoing Client Experience \& Marketing Coordinator to manage the front desk while helping build Harmonia’s local presence and online community.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys connecting with people, creating engaging social content and helping a growing brand come to life. It is a hands\-on position combining client service, studio operations, marketing and content creation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

CLIENT EXPERIENCE AND FRONT DESK

* Welcome clients and create a warm, polished studio experience
* Assist clients with bookings, memberships, class packages and account questions
* Manage check\-ins, waitlists, cancellations and basic booking\-system updates
* Keep the reception, retail and common areas organized and presentation\-ready
* Build genuine relationships with clients and support member retention
* Assist with studio events, workshops and community partnerships

MARKETING AND SOCIAL MEDIA

* Help plan and manage Harmonia’s Instagram and other social\-media channels
* Capture photo and video content in the studio
* Create and edit Reels, Stories, posts and short\-form videos
* Write captions and schedule content using Harmonia’s brand voice
* Share studio updates, instructor introductions, educational content and client stories
* Promote memberships, introductory offers, events and workshops
* Help manage the studio’s content calendar
* Support email newsletters and local marketing campaigns
* Identify partnership opportunities with neighborhood businesses and community groups
* Monitor engagement, inquiries and campaign results
* Ensure all content reflects Harmonia’s visual and verbal brand standards

MEMBERSHIP SALES

* Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective members and leads
* Respond promptly to phone calls, emails, text messages, website inquiries, and social media leads
* Conduct studio tours and consultations that create an exceptional first impression

---------------------


Community Autism Services (CAS) is seeking a motivated, relationship\-driven Behavior Technician (BT) \& Community Outreach Coordinator to support clinical services and community engagement in the Fremont and San Jose markets.


This hybrid role is designed to directly support client outcomes and regional growth. The individual in this position will divide their time between providing high\-quality ABA therapy services and building meaningful relationships with referral partners, schools, pediatric offices, and community organizations.

* Provide direct 1:1 ABA therapy in home, school, and/or center\-based settings.

* Collect accurate session data and complete documentation in a timely manner.
* Participate in supervision, team meetings, and ongoing training.

### **Community Outreach Responsibilities**

* Conduct in\-person outreach visits to pediatricians, schools, therapy providers, and community agencies.

-----------------------------------


Community Autism Services (CAS), a division of The Stepping Stones Group, provides evidence\-based Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy to children and families across multiple service settings, including center, home, and school environments.

jobs.description:
Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor\-based products and coaxial and high\-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

 **Position: Account Manager**

**Location: Santa Clara, CA**


Amphenol High Speed and Commercial Products Groups are the market leaders for high speed, high bandwidth electrical connectors for the Telecom/Datacom and Diverse market (Mobile Networks, Storage, Servers, Routers, Switches, etc.). Our products help to enable the electronics revolution and remain a key enabler for all the major Tier 1 OEMs globally. Our global headquarters are located in Nashua, NH and we have design, sales, and manufacturing locations globally. We are currently seeking an Account Manager to join our West Coast Sales team in Santa Clara, CA.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


The Account Manager is the voice of the customer into the organization as well as the voice of Amphenol out to the customer. This highly visible role will have responsibility for one of the largest OEM customers within the High Speed Products Group. The position requires excellent communication skills but also has a substantial focus on financial and market data.

* Preparing monthly and quarterly revenue projections for the account(s)
* Forecast analysis and preparing book\-to\-ship estimates
* Preparing negotiation strategy in conjunction with sales and product line management, submitting proposals and negotiating order fulfillment agreements to maximize share
* Coordinating customer activities, including product ramp strategies and resolution of delivery, quality, inventory, and financial issues in an international environment
* Prepare market share goals and work with sales, product management and operations to achieve those objectives and resolve any shortfalls to the plan
* Identify end customer market analysis/opportunities and develop plans to fulfill gaps to close the total available market space


A successful candidate will be skilled at working with a high level of detail and will be able to manage multiple tasks for customers in a time sensitive environment. They will also make presentations to top management; organizational skills and summarizing conclusions via data analysis is an important part of the position. To do so requires a strong working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint and the ability to communicate effectively. Some travel may be required.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* BS Degree in Marketing, Business or related area, MBA preferred
* Bi\-lingual Spanish/English Required
* Advanced PC Skills in MS Excel and PowerPoint, working ability with V\-lookups, Pivot Tables, and other more advanced excel skills
* 3\+ year of experience in Marketing, Customer Service, Planning or Finance
* Ability to effectively communicate across multiple functions internally and externally
* Strong oral and written communications to provide high level customer service and build relationships
* Detail\-oriented with keen business acumen


The base salary range for this position is $68,320 \- $104,400 annually. In determining rate of pay, Amphenol considers a variety of nondiscriminatory factors, including but not limited to geographic location, relevant industry experience, qualifications, skills, and education. It would be rare for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for a given role. Base salary is one facet of Amphenol's total rewards package which includes participation in our comprehensive benefits program with medical, dental, and vision benefits effective day 1, vacation, sick leave, personal days, paid holidays, life insurance, short/long term disability, and matching 401K.

  

Amphenol Corporation is proud of our reputation as an excellent employer. Our focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. Amphenol Corporation offers the opportunity for career growth within a global organization. We believe that Amphenol Corporation is unique in that every employee, regardless of his or her position, has the ability to positively impact the business.


Amphenol is an “Equal Opportunity Employer” \- Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin. For additional company information please visit our website at https://www.amphenol\-cs.com/

jobs.description:
**Who You Are**



Join FANUC America at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Industrial Robotics. Based in Northern California (primarily the Bay Area), this strategic sales role will lead FANUC's engagement with the rapidly growing ecosystem of robotics startups, AI innovators, and venture\-backed technology companies developing the next generation of intelligent automation solutions. This is a unique opportunity to influence how Physical AI, ROS2, autonomous robotics, digital twins, and advanced software platforms are deployed across FANUC's global installed base of industrial and collaborative robots.


**How It's Done**


* Develop and execute strategic growth initiatives targeting robotics startups, AI companies, venture\-backed technology firms, research institutions, and innovation ecosystems throughout Northern California and North America, positioning FANUC as the preferred robotics platform for advanced applications in artificial intelligence, machine learning, autonomous systems, physical AI, simulation, and robotic software
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with founders, CTOs, robotics architects, AI researchers, engineering executives, venture investors, universities, robotics laboratories, startup accelerators, incubators, and innovation centers to influence automation technology adoption and identify emerging business opportunities
* Identify opportunities to expand adoption of FANUC robot and controller technologies by supporting software\-first and AI\-driven application development, including integration with ROS2 frameworks, AI inference engines, cloud platforms, edge computing architectures, and advanced robotic software environments
* Collaborate closely with FANUC engineering, product management, and technical teams to communicate emerging market trends, customer requirements, software integration needs, and next\-generation technology opportunities that influence future product development and market strategy
* Represent FANUC at robotics, AI, automation, and startup ecosystem events, including technical conferences, industry forums, venture capital events, developer communities, and innovation programs, serving as a thought leader and ambassador for FANUC technologies
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of target industries, accounts, and senior leadership by:
	+ Researching market trends, regulatory and economic factors, and value/supply chains
	+ Analyzing customer business models, operations, financial performance, strategic objectives, and competitive landscape, including FAC, FANUC, and partner presence
	+ Evaluating executive roles, priorities, and backgrounds to enable informed, credible, and highly personalized engagement at the C\-suite level
* Determine best engagement strategies for current and prospective clients
* Develop strategies and action plans to improve overall customer satisfaction
* Develop, implement, and actively maintain comprehensive key account strategic plans
* Drive sales strategy
* Assess competitive threats and market dynamics and develop strategies to strengthen FAC's position within assigned accounts
* Insight development identifying both short\-term opportunities and long\-term strategic initiatives
* Executive\-level relationship development
* Coordinate facility automation audits with the appropriate FAC execution teams and/or ASI partners to identify operational challenges and potential automation opportunities
* Identify and facilitate engagement with appropriate ASI partners and monitor the progress of ASI and end\-user relationships throughout the sales cycle
* Conduct quarterly or semiannual business reviews with key customer stakeholders to review open issues, ongoing projects, support requirements, emerging opportunities, and account performance
* Regularly visit customer sites within assigned accounts and territory to strengthen relationships, support strategic initiatives, and identify new business opportunities


**What You Need**


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration or related field; or equivalent relevant experience
* Minimum five years of capital equipment sales with proven selling and negotiation skills, experience developing strategic account plans
* Experience in the robotics and/or automation industry
* Minimum three years of selling experience at the c\-suite level of an organization with established contacts within select markets and industry verticals
* A strong understanding of end\-to\-end Physical AI system that combines perception, reasoning, and autonomous action
* Must currently reside and/or have established business relationships in Northern California
* Must have or be able to obtain a valid driver's license


**What Would Be Even Better**


* Master's Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or related field
* Extensive knowledge of manufacturing processes
* 5\+ years of experience in the robotics and/or automation industry with working knowledge of FANUC products
* Experience working with robotics startups, AI companies, autonomous systems developers, or industrial software providers
* Understanding of robotics software architectures, ROS2, industrial communication protocols, edge computing, and AI\-enabled automation technologies
* Experience with Isaac Sim, generative AI, reinforcement learning, and industrial robotics
* Familiarity with software\-centric business models including SaaS, robotics\-as\-a\-service (RaaS), platform ecosystems, and developer enablement programs
* Experience developing strategic partnerships within startup, venture capital, university, or technology innovation ecosystems
* Knowledge of machine learning, computer vision, foundation models, large language models, physical AI, or autonomous robotics technologies applied to industrial environments
