jobs.title: Manager, customer success
jobs.description:
Location
San Francisco
Type
Full\-Time
Department
Customer Success
Compensation
$190,080 \- $211,200
  
**About Watershed**
-------------------


Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit\-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product\-building, want to work hard at a mission\-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.


We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

**The role**
------------


Watershed is hiring an experienced manager for one of our North American Customer Success teams! The team empowers our customers to measure, report and scale with our sustainability platform at the core. Our North American CS team has grown and we are looking for a leader who cares deeply about developing, coaching, and building a team of early career and experienced CSMs.


You and your team will help refine and scale the customer success function as we gear up for this next year\+ of growth. In this role, one of your primary areas of focus will be designing and building our “scaled” approach to Customer Success.You will shape the strategy, playbooks, systems, and tools that enable our teams to deliver strong customer outcomes efficiently and consistently. This includes developing 1:many engagement programs, improving lifecycle experiences, devising AI first strategies, and partnering with other CS leaders to adapt successful approaches across teams and geographies.


You will also serve as a senior advocate for your team and customers across Watershed. You will work closely with Product, Sales, Sustainability Advisory, Support, and other cross\-functional teams to help customers achieve their sustainability goals and translate customer needs into actionable improvements to our products and services


As an early leader in a fast\-growing company, you will play an important role in shaping the culture, operating model, and standards of the Customer Success organization. You will help build a diverse, inclusive, collaborative, and high\-performing team based in San Francisco and across North America.

**You will:**

* Hire, develop and coach a team of Customer Success Managers
* Develop and help drive team to achieve key metrics, including customer satisfaction, retention, and expansion
* Design, build, and oversee strategy and programs for a “Scaled” Customer Success motion. Leverage AI systems and tools to drive personalized scaled experiences and targeted team engagement. Partnering with global CS managers to help them adapt this motion to new geographies.
* Guide and support your team in delivering customer outcomes at scale, taking an active role in helping them drive 1:many engagement strategies with Watershed’s products and services
* Partner with your team to act as a key contact with Sr level stakeholders at our customers and support their lifecycle with Watershed
* Collaborate with our product teams and be the voice of the customer, providing regular and actionable customer feedback
* Develop and implement processes and tools that help the CS function scale and effectively deliver value for customers
* Be a representative of the CS function, and of the broader Watershed leadership team, within the San Francisco office

**You have:**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in a Customer Success or similar role including at least 2 years of management experience
* A background and experience with Customer Success in an Enterprise SaaS space
* Experience delivering and managing Scaled Customer Success programs for Mid\-Market and Enterprise Customers
* A passion for people development and coaching
* Great examples of working cross functionally to build products for customers
* Experience developing operational processes and delivering on key metrics in early stage/ high growth companies that drive towards operational excellence




**Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)**


Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

**What’s the interview process like?**


It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

**What if I need accommodations for my interview?**


At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long\-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy\-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, GTM
jobs.description:
**About Niantic Spatial**


At Niantic Spatial, we're building the future of physical AI. Powered by a proprietary database of over 30 billion posed images, our groundbreaking mapping technology unlocks a new dimension of interaction and spatial intelligence that helps both humans and machines better understand, represent, navigate, and engage with the real environment.


Our reconstruction technology captures environments with geometric accuracy and extreme detail from any standard camera, and our Visual Positioning System delivers precise positioning almost anywhere in the world. We serve customers across robotics, the public sector, and energy and industrial markets \- building for the 80% of economic activity that takes place beyond our screens.

**About the Role**


We're looking for our founding Sales Development Representative to introduce Niantic Spatial to the organizations shaping the future of spatial computing, autonomy, and AI. Reporting into Marketing, you'll follow up on inbound interest, open meaningful first conversations with prospective customers and partners, and build a qualified pipeline.


This role sits at the intersection of research, communication, and disciplined execution. You'll learn how organizations approach their operational and technical challenges, understand their use cases, and assess where our products can help. Your conversations do double duty: they build pipelines, and they give Product real signals about where we are finding product\-market fit.


You'll work closely with marketing, product, business development, and operations to turn market interest into pipeline, and help build the systems, messaging, and feedback loops that make a growing go\-to\-market team more effective.

**What You'll Do**

* **Build Early\-Stage Pipeline \-** Respond quickly to inbound interest, qualify initial fit, and uncover business and technical priorities. * **Create Qualified Conversations \-** Research target accounts across industries such as oil and gas, defense and the public sector, and embodied AI. Build an informed point of view on each prospect's business, technical environment, and potential need for spatial intelligence.
* **Reach Prospects Thoughtfully \-** Run personalized outreach across email, phone, LinkedIn, events, and other channels. Lead with a clear reason for reaching out and make every interaction useful, whether or not it produces a meeting.
* **Explain the Opportunity \-** Learn our products and point of view deeply enough to explain them clearly to technical and executive audiences. Connect our capabilities to real customer problems without overstating what the products can do.
* **Surface Product\-Market Fit Signal \-** Ask thoughtful questions about how organizations build, deploy, and operate systems that need to understand the physical world. Recognize promising use cases and route the right context to product, sales, and technical teams so they can test where fit is strongest.
* **Hand Off Cleanly \-** Translate discovery notes into a clear articulation of the customer's need, the proposed solution, initial scope, and next steps. Partner with Business Development on the first proposal and make sure the opportunity moves into the sales process with its context intact.
* **Strengthen the Go\-To\-Market Motion \-** Capture patterns from prospect conversations: recurring pain points, objections, terminology, competitive context, and emerging use cases. Share them with Marketing, Business Development, Product, and Operations. Improve our processes, data quality, and tooling, using automation and AI to remove repetitive work while keeping judgment and personalization at the center of the prospect experience.

**What You'll Bring**

* 1\-2 years in sales development, business development, customer\-facing technology, fundraising, or a similarly communication\-intensive role, or strong curiosity and drive early in your career.
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences.
* Comfort starting conversations with people you don't know. You listen carefully, ask strong follow\-up questions, and persist without becoming transactional or scripted.
* Ownership of your own work: you can run a thoughtful follow\-up process, keep accurate records, and stay organized across many accounts and conversations.
* Curiosity about how technology changes the way organizations operate, and the ability to learn a complex product, find the business relevance, and communicate it clearly.
* An appetite for experimentation. You'll test a new message or channel, learn from the result, and make the next iteration better.
* Persistence, sound judgment, and a high standard for preparation and follow\-through.
* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience.

**Nice to Have**

* An interest in AI, spatial computing, robotics, autonomy, mapping, or other technologies that connect digital systems to the physical world.
* Experience using CRM (we use HubSpot), sales engagement, research, and productivity tools.
* Exposure to oil and gas, defense and the public sector, or embodied AI markets.
* Experience working alongside product teams, or an interest in how early customer conversations shape what gets built.

This role is based in our San Francisco office, with three days per week in office.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Prospect into target accounts via cold calls, emails, LinkedIn, and creative outbound tactics
* Qualify prospects and book high\-quality meetings for the Account Executives
* Collaborate on outbound messaging, sequences, and value propositions tailored to US markets
* Research accounts, industries, and buying personas to personalise outreach
* Maintain clean, accurate data in HubSpot and prospecting tools
* Share insights on objection patterns, ICP quality, and market feedback
* Help establish early outbound best practices and documentation for future SDR hires

 **What We’re Looking For**


This is a **builder SDR role**, not a volume\-at\-all\-costs seat.


You’ll likely be a strong fit if you:

* Have **1–2 years of experience** in SDR, BDR, or sales\-adjacent roles (B2B SaaS preferred)
* Are confident on the phone and thoughtful in written communication
* Are naturally curious and enjoy understanding how different businesses operate
* Are organised, disciplined, and able to manage your own activity and output
* Can handle rejection, ambiguity, and experimentation without losing momentum
* Want to grow into an AE or senior commercial role over time
* Have experience with tools like HubSpot, Firmable, Apollo, ZoomInfo, etc.

 **Why Join as Founding US SDR**

* You’ll help build the outbound engine from scratch
* Direct mentorship from the Head of Sales
* Clear progression path as the US team grows
* Exposure to regional GTM strategy, not just activity metrics

**Who this role is NOT for**

* Are looking for a highly scripted, volume\-only SDR role with rigid sequences and instructions
* Struggle with rejection or need constant validation to stay motivated
* Prefer being told exactly what to say, who to target, and how to work each day
* Are uncomfortable experimenting with messaging, industries, and outbound approaches
* Expect a large team, clear handoffs, and mature tooling from day one
* Are not interested in understanding the broader business, product, or market context
* This role is best suited for someone who wants to learn fast, think commercially, and grow into a more senior sales role over time.

#### **Registered Nurse (RN) – Street Medicine/Portable Care Program Coordinator**


Organization: North Jersey Community Research Initiative (NJCRI)



Work Location: In Person


#### **Position Summary**


NJCRI is seeking an experienced, independent, and highly motivated Registered Nurse (RN) to serve as the Street Medicine/Portable Care Program Coordinator.



The RN Program Coordinator provides clinical and operational leadership for NJCRI’s mobile and community\-based healthcare services for individuals experiencing homelessness and other underserved populations. This position combines direct nursing care, program management, community outreach, staff supervision, quality oversight, and partnership development.



The Program Coordinator directly supervises the program’s Community Health Worker (CHW), Case Manager, and Medical Assistant and is responsible for coordinating the team’s daily activities, outreach assignments, documentation, performance, and delivery of high\-quality, patient\-centered services.



The ideal candidate will have experience in addiction nursing, harm reduction, community health, infectious disease, or healthcare for underserved populations, along with demonstrated leadership and supervisory skills. The RN Program Coordinator must be comfortable providing services in nontraditional healthcare settings, including shelters, community locations, encampments, and mobile outreach environments.



Clinical Services \& Direct Patient Care



Provide nursing services in community\-based settings, including shelters, encampments, outreach locations, and mobile health settings.



Coordinate and participate in street outreach, mobile health services, and community engagement activities.



Conduct HIV, viral hepatitis, and sexually transmitted infection (STI) testing, counseling, education, and linkage to treatment.



Perform phlebotomy and specimen collection for laboratory testing.



Conduct health screenings and point\-of\-care testing, including blood pressure, blood glucose, cholesterol, pregnancy testing, and other appropriate assessments.



Review laboratory results and coordinate appropriate follow\-up with patients and healthcare providers.



Provide wound assessment, treatment, education, and ongoing wound care management within the RN scope of practice and established clinical protocols.



Administer vaccinations, medications, and other preventive health services as authorized and within scope of practice.



Provide overdose prevention and harm\-reduction education and facilitate access to Naloxone.



Assess patients for acute and chronic health concerns and coordinate appropriate clinical intervention, escalation, or referral.



Coordinate referrals and linkage to primary care, infectious disease care, behavioral health services, substance use disorder treatment, social services, housing resources, and other supportive services.



Facilitate pregnancy testing and referrals for prenatal and reproductive healthcare services.



Monitor patient progress and support successful linkage to and retention in healthcare services.


#### **Leadership \& Staff Supervision**


Provide direct supervision and day\-to\-day oversight of the Community Health Worker, Case Manager, and Medical Assistant assigned to the program.



Establish clear staff responsibilities, assignments, priorities, and performance expectations.



Coordinate staff schedules and outreach assignments to ensure appropriate coverage for mobile and community\-based services.



Conduct regular team meetings and individual supervision to review program activities, patient needs, barriers to care, and follow\-up responsibilities.



Monitor staff performance, productivity, documentation, attendance, and completion of assigned responsibilities.



Provide coaching, training, and ongoing guidance to support staff development and adherence to program and clinical standards.



Ensure staff complete required documentation, data entry, outreach records, referrals, and follow\-up activities accurately and within established timeframes.



Address performance or operational concerns promptly and collaborate with NJCRI leadership and Human Resources when additional support or corrective action is necessary.



Identify staff training needs and coordinate appropriate education and professional development.



Promote effective communication and collaboration among clinical, outreach, case management, and support staff.



Foster a professional, respectful, accountable, and patient\-centered team environment.


#### **Program Management \& Operations**


Manage and coordinate the day\-to\-day operations of the Street Medicine/Portable Care Program, including clinical workflows, outreach activities, staffing, and service delivery.



Develop, implement, and evaluate program policies, procedures, workflows, and quality improvement initiatives.



Ensure services are delivered in accordance with NJCRI policies and applicable federal, state, local, clinical, regulatory, and grant requirements.



Monitor program performance, service utilization, quality indicators, and outcomes to ensure achievement of agency and grant objectives.



Identify clinical and operational barriers and work collaboratively with leadership to develop and implement solutions.



Ensure accurate and timely clinical documentation, case notes, and data entry within the electronic health record and required reporting systems.



Prepare and submit required monthly, quarterly, annual, and grant\-related reports accurately and within established deadlines.



Collect and evaluate patient feedback and satisfaction information to identify opportunities for program improvement.



Maintain appropriate clinical and outreach supplies and communicate supply or equipment needs to management.



Collaborate with NJCRI clinical, behavioral health, outreach, case management, and administrative teams to promote continuity of care.

**Job Description**
-------------------


The Department of Social Services (DSS) is comprised of the administrative units of the New York City Human Resources Administration (HRA) and the Department of Homeless Services (DHS). HRA is dedicated to fighting poverty and income inequality by providing New Yorkers in need with essential benefits such as Food Assistance and Emergency Rental Assistance. DHS is committed to preventing and addressing homelessness in New York City by employing a variety of innovative strategies to help families and individuals successfully exit shelter and return to self\-sufficiency as quickly as possible.
  

  

The Office of the Ombudsman provides independent and impartial assistance to OHS clients and provides the public with access to a wide array of information and services.
  

  

The DSS Ombudsman staff responds to constituent concerns and inquiries. The Ombudsman Office is the point of intake for all DHS shelter concerns received via the HRA intake line, and the staff routes inquiries to the appropriate division or provider. In addition, Ombudsman addresses concerns from shelter residents that are not related to facility conditions. All of these inquiries are tracked in the Intranet Quorum (IQ) system for reporting purposes.
  

  

The Community Coordinator will report to the Ombudsman Deputy Director and provide effective conflict resolution; ensure fair and equal access to DHS, City, and community\-based services and resources; and maintain a comprehensive data tracking and reporting system. The Community Coordinator will actively engage constituents in a meaningful manner and empower them to participate in decisions that affect their lives. The Community Coordinator will visit shelters to meet with shelter management and residents and conduct presentations regarding what the Office of the Ombudsman can help them with.
  

  

The Office of the Ombudsman is recruiting one (1\) Community Coordinator to function as a DSS Ombudsman Community Coordinator who will:
  

  

* Participate in and lead both internal and external meetings and conferences with constituents; participate/lead field visits to support the needs of constituents, as well as to inform and further the goals of the Office of the Ombudsman and Department of Homeless Services.

* Conduct outreach to community\-based organizations and advocates; arranges and assists in the preparation and presentation of IQ data; manages projects to improve access that emanates from these meetings.

  

* Aid constituents who contact the Office of the Ombudsman on issues relating to homelessness (through phone, email, walk\-ins, correspondence), by addressing the concerns raised, researching cases as comprehensively as needed to thoroughly understand their concerns raised, and working with appropriate internal and external partners to achieve a successful resolution.

  

* Provide supportive client experience through effective and compassionate listening and timely client\-focused case management. Provide direct counseling and/or outreach services. Refer to other public agencies or community resources as needed.

  

* Maintain records detailing and tracking ongoing and completed cases/activities in Intranet Quorum (IQ). Generate reports designed to detail and/or aggregate activities on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis to identify shelter concerns and complaints. Frequently enters data into relevant databases when developed.

  

* Develop, strengthens, and maintain rapport with internal and external partners to support the needs of constituents. Develop and maintains knowledge base of resources, which support the needs of constituents.

  

* Consult stakeholders to implement a multidisciplinary approach to client care. Work with community agencies and/or groups; attend meetings and relevant training.

**About Power Pilates**

Power Pilates is dedicated to fostering education programs, studios and a workplace where every client and staffer is valued and feels a genuine sense of belonging.

**The Role**

The Client Experience Specialist is the person who makes sure a first\-time client becomes a regular. You'll run the front desk during your shift, but the heart of the job is the follow\-through: reaching out after intro classes, helping clients pick the right package, welcoming back people we haven't seen in a while, and keeping our studios looking the way a classical Pilates studio should. * Deliver a warm, polished check\-in and sales experience for every client, in person, by phone and by email

* Open and/or close the studio as a trusted key holder

**You are**

* Experienced: 2\+ years at a fitness, spa or hospitality front desk, ideally with sales results you can talk about

* A clear, professional writer \- email and text are half of this job

* Reliable enough to hold keys and open or close a studio on your own

jobs.title: Finance & Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Latent**


Latent is building the clinical agentic engine for enterprise pharmacy—software that enables leading health systems to serve more patients, grow their pharmacy operations, and capture more value compliantly, without adding headcount. We are a fast\-moving team looking for thoughtful, ambitious people who want to help build both the business and the systems behind it.

**The Opportunity**


Latent is hiring a Finance \& Business Operations Manager to own the systems that keep the company running: our books, our billing, our spend, our insurance, and our payroll and expense operations. You will be the person who makes sure money moves accurately, on time, and with the right controls behind it.


This is a hands\-on ownership role, not an oversight role. You will work in QuickBooks, Brex, and Rippling directly, and you will design the policies and processes around them. You will partner closely with our strategic finance function—they build the model and the forecast; you own the operational reality that feeds it.


On any given day, you might reconcile a month\-end account, issue a batch of customer invoices, chase a receivable, review expense reports, renegotiate a software renewal, or work through an insurance renewal with our broker.

**What You’ll Do**

**Accounting and the books**

* Own day\-to\-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online, including categorization, reconciliations, and chart\-of\-accounts hygiene
* Run or support month\-end close, including accruals, prepaids, and account reconciliations
* Keep financial records accurate, organized, and audit\-ready
* Maintain the chart of accounts, classes, and departments so reporting stays meaningful as we grow
* Coordinate with external accounting, bookkeeping, and tax partners

**Invoicing and accounts receivable**

* Own customer invoicing end to end, including recurring, milestone, and usage\-based billing
* Ensure invoices are accurate, properly coded, and issued on schedule
* Track receivables, follow up on outstanding balances, and manage collections
* Resolve billing questions and discrepancies with customers and internal stakeholders
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success so contract terms flow correctly into billing

**Accounts payable, corporate cards, and spend management**

* Administer Brex: card issuance, spend limits, approval flows, receipt compliance, and reporting
* Review vendor bills for accuracy, proper approval, and correct coding
* Manage payment runs, track payment status, and resolve vendor discrepancies
* Own vendor onboarding, renewals, purchasing workflows, and contract records
* Maintain visibility into software subscriptions and other recurring commitments, and identify savings opportunities
* Evaluate vendors and negotiate commercial terms
* Partner with budget owners to ensure purchases are appropriate, approved, and within budget

**Personnel expense and payroll operations**

* Own employee expense management: policy, submission workflows, review, and reimbursement
* Support payroll processing in Rippling, including off\-cycle runs, and ensure accurate GL mapping into QuickBooks
* Maintain employee records and support onboarding, offboarding, and benefits administration workflows
* Serve as the first point of contact for employee questions on expenses, reimbursements, and payroll
* Partner with People and leadership so compensation changes flow correctly into payroll and the books
* Handle confidential compensation and employee data with consistently sound judgment

**Insurance and business administration**

* Own company business insurance: renewals, broker relationships, coverage reviews, and certificate\-of\-insurance requests
* Ensure coverage keeps pace with headcount, customer contracts, and our risk profile
* Maintain corporate records, state registrations, and business licenses
* Support customer and partner requests for insurance, tax, and compliance documentation

**Building the operations function**

* Identify manual or inefficient processes and replace them with better systems and controls
* Document financial and operational policies, approval thresholds, and operating procedures
* Help select and implement finance and operations tools as the company grows
* Take ownership of new operational priorities as they arise

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–6 years of experience in accounting operations, finance operations, business operations, or startup G\&A
* Hands\-on ownership of QuickBooks Online or a comparable general ledger—not just reviewing someone else’s work
* Direct experience running accounts payable, accounts receivable, and expense workflows
* Familiarity with corporate card and spend platforms (Brex, Ramp, or similar) and HR/payroll systems (Rippling, Gusto, Justworks, or similar)
* Excellent attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy
* Advanced proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets
* Strong organizational and project\-management skills, with comfort owning recurring deadlines
* Clear, thoughtful communication with colleagues, vendors, and external partners
* A proactive, low\-ego approach and willingness to take ownership
* Comfort operating in a fast\-changing environment with incomplete information

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working at an early\-stage or rapidly growing technology company
* Experience through a full month\-end close, an audit, or a finance systems migration
* Experience managing business insurance renewals or working directly with brokers
* Exposure to multi\-state payroll and payroll compliance
* Experience with procurement or spend\-management systems
* Interest in healthcare, pharmacy operations, or health technology

**What Success Looks Like**


Within your first year, you will have:

* Closed the books accurately on a predictable monthly cadence
* Made invoicing and collections run on schedule, with receivables actively managed
* Given company leaders clear visibility into vendor spend, subscriptions, and card activit

* Lead end\-to\-end insurance placement and strategic risk mitigation across all operations. Manage data processing for policy placement, oversee policy audits, analyze program structures, and direct enrollments with OCIP brokers and contractors.

jobs.title: TPS Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever\-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------


The Treasury and Payments Solutions (TPS) Event Coordinator manages the execution and operational support of trade shows, conferences, bank\-hosted Client Advisory Groups, and employee events. The role coordinates attendee registration and communications, invitations, meeting and session logistics, rooming lists, shipping and material handling, venues, vendors, production partners, event timelines, project plans, budget tracking, invoicing, contracts, and onsite support.


The role also supports event reporting, participation tracking, meeting management, feedback and lead capture, campaign attribution, and post\-event analytics, using Salesforce and other event technologies where appropriate. Working across Sales, Marketing, Product, Strategy, and internal event partners, the coordinator helps maintain accurate data, enables timely follow\-up, improves event processes, and delivers a consistent participant experience across external client and internal employee events.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Event Execution \& Operations (60%)**

* Manage end\-to\-end execution of trade shows, conferences, bank\-hosted Client Advisory Groups, and employee events.
* Coordinate event logistics, including invitations, attendee registration and communications, agendas and session support, meeting logistics, rooming lists, shipping and material handling, venue coordination, and vendor management.
* Support multiple large\-scale events simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
* Manage event timelines, project plans, and execution deliverables.
* Serve as onsite support for priority trade shows, conferences, Client Advisory Groups, and employee events.
* Manage event vendors, venues, sponsorship partners, facilitators, and production partners appropriate to each event type.
* Support budget tracking and reconciliation, coordinate invoicing and payment processes, and maintain event\-related contracts and documentation.

**Salesforce, Reporting \& Pipeline Support (25%)**

* Serve as the primary Salesforce resource for applicable external event and conference reporting, while supporting participation and engagement reporting for Client Advisory Groups and employee events.
* Support audience identification, attendee targeting, invitation, registration, and communication processes across client and employee events.
* Partner with event strategy, client advocacy, and business stakeholders to track meeting activity, participant feedback, commitments, and post\-event follow\-up.
* Work with digital marketing and internal partners to maintain dashboards or reporting that measure participation and engagement across event types.
* Track opportunity influence and pipeline generation for applicable external events, and participation, engagement, and follow\-up measures for Client Advisory Groups and employee events.
* Produce post\-event analytics and reporting to support business reviews, Client Advisory Group follow\-up, and employee event assessment.
* Ensure accurate campaign attribution, meeting capture, participation tracking, and feedback documentation processes, as applicable.

**Meeting Management \& Lead Capture (10%)**

* Manage meeting and session scheduling, confirmations, agendas, participant communications, and logistics.
* Oversee lead, feedback, question, and participation capture processes, including the use of Captello and other event technologies as appropriate.
* Ensure meeting, lead, feedback, and participation data is captured accurately and shared appropriately for follow\-up.
* Partner with event strategy and client advocacy stakeholders to maximize client engagement and support effective employee participation.

**Process Improvement \& Team Support (5%)**

* Maintain event playbooks, templates, and standard operating procedures.
* Identify opportunities to streamline execution and improve client, guest, and employee participant experiences.
* Support cross\-functional coordination among Sales, Marketing, Product, Leadership, client advocacy, communications, and employee event partners.

**Measurement \& Impact**


Impact will be reflected through reliable execution across trade shows, conferences, bank\-hosted Client Advisory Groups, and employee events; accurate reporting and attribution; timely follow\-up on meetings, leads, feedback, and commitments; effective operational controls; and continuous improvement of participant experiences.

* On\-time completion of event timelines, project plans, logistics, and execution deliverables
* Accuracy of Salesforce campaign attribution, meeting capture, lead and feedback data, participation tracking, dashboards, and post\-event reporting, as applicable
* Effective budget tracking, reconciliation, invoicing, payment processing, contract management, and documentation
* Timely coordination of meeting activity, Client Advisory Group commitments, participant feedback, and post\-event follow\-up
* Consistent use and improvement of event playbooks, templates, and standard operating procedures

**Success Profile**

* Exceptional attention to detail while supporting multiple large\-scale events and concurrent priorities
* Strong partnership across Sales, Marketing, Product, Leadership, digital marketing, client advocacy, communications, and employee event teams
* Accurate, timely reporting, campaign management, analytics, meeting capture, lead and feedback

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator / Office Manager

The position offers a well\-rounded introduction to how a successful international company operates while providing valuable professional development and career growth opportunities.

Blanke Corporation is a leading manufacturer and distributor of innovative tile installation and flooring solutions. As part of an international organization with headquarters in Germany, we serve customers throughout North America and collaborate with industry\-leading manufacturers and partners worldwide.

Qualifications

Preferred Skills \& Experience

jobs.title: Development Coordinator (Raiser's Edge Expert)
jobs.description:
**High Meadows School and Camp \| Roswell, Georgia**  
**Full\-time \| 12\-month \| 40 hours/week \| Non\-exempt**

Due to an internal promotion, High Meadows School and Camp is seeking a **Development Coordinator** to join our Development team. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys organization, data, details, as well as the creative side of coordinating Development events, mailings, invitations, and being the person behind the scenes who helps everything come together.

Working closely with the Director of Development, the Development Coordinator helps keep the day\-to\-day work of Development organized, accurate, and moving forward. From maintaining donor records and processing gifts to supporting fundraising campaigns and coordinating Development events, this person plays an important role in helping High Meadows build and strengthen relationships across our community.

**What You'll Do**

* As resident Raiser’s Edge expert, you will manage and maintain our Raiser’s Edge donor database, keeping constituent, donor, gift, pledge, and prospect information accurate and up to date
* Process gifts, pledges, and recurring contributions and prepare acknowledgments, tax receipts, pledge reminders, and donor correspondence
* Create reports, mailing lists, donor segments, data merges, and giving analyses to support fundraising and stewardship efforts
* Partner with the Finance team to reconcile gifts and maintain accurate Development and financial records
* Keep Development projects, deadlines, calendars, files, procedures, and tracking systems organized
* Coordinate Development mailings and provide administrative and project support for fundraising campaigns, donor stewardship, alumni engagement, and other Development initiatives
* Assist the Director of Development with donor research, meeting preparation, reports, presentations, correspondence, and special projects
* Plan and coordinate Development Department events and donor gatherings in collaboration with the Director of Development and Events Manager, including invitations, guest and donor lists, RSVPs, communications, fundraising or auction records, event details, and post\-event follow\-up
* Work collaboratively with the Events Manager on Development events, with both positions contributing to the planning, coordination, and successful execution of these events
* Collaborate with Marketing \& Communications to help ensure Development information and messaging are accurate, timely, and consistent
* Pitch in on other Development projects and priorities as they arise

**You Might Be a Great Fit If You...**

· Are highly organized and genuinely enjoy keeping details straight

· Like working with data, spreadsheets, databases, reports, and systems

· Enjoy coordinating events and seeing the details come together

· Can manage several priorities and deadlines without losing track of the small things

· Take ownership of your work and follow through

· Communicate warmly and professionally with donors, families, volunteers, colleagues, and other members of the School community

· Are comfortable handling confidential donor, family, and financial information with discretion

· Enjoy working independently while also being part of a collaborative team

· Can adjust when priorities change and still keep things moving

· Are willing to jump in, solve problems, and help where needed

**What You'll Bring**

Experience with Raiser’s Edge is required for this position. Experience with Veracross is helpful, as is strong proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel. You should also be comfortable working with donor data, reports, spreadsheets, gift records, and financial information.

We'd also like to see approximately three to five years of relevant experience in areas such as Development/fundraising, database administration, nonprofit or school operations, or administrative support. Prior experience supporting fundraising operations, donor relations, gift processing, Development programs, or Development\-related events strongly preferred.

A bachelor's degree is preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

**What Success Looks Like**

Our Development Coordinator is someone people can count on. You'll know the donor data, understand the systems, anticipate deadlines, catch details, and help keep Development initiatives moving throughout the year.

You'll also be comfortable moving between very different kinds of work—perhaps preparing a donor report one day, processing gifts the next, and then working alongside the Director of Development and Events Manager to coordinate an upcoming donor gathering.

Success at High Meadows means being curious, collaborative, dependable, and willing to take initiative. We're looking for someone who wants to understand the School and Camp as a whole, builds positive relationships across departments, and takes pride in the behind\-the\-scenes work that helps Development and the broader High Meadows community succeed.

**A Little About High Meadows**

High Meadows School and Camp is located on 42 wooded acres in Roswell, Georgia, about 30 minutes north of Atlanta. Our campus includes multiple buildings, meadows, forest, and an active barnyard—so working here doesn't always look like working in a traditional office.

High Meadows offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and vision coverage; school\-paid life and long\-term disability insurance; a 403(b) retirement plan with up to a 4% school match; paid leave; and a tuition discount for children attending High Meadows School.

**Apply**

Please apply via our school website, www.highmeadows.org, About Us, Working at High Meadows, then scroll down to Active Vacancies. Once you click on a vacancy, you click “Apply Now”.

Questions? Email HR Manager Jane Murphy at **jmurphy@highmeadows.org.** If you are selected for the next steps in the process, you will be contacted directly.

*High Meadows School and Camp

jobs.title: Community Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**


Person in this position will be responsible for providing support, outreach, and engagement services to veterans and service members at risk of suicide. Utilizing lived experience and trauma\-informed care, the specialist builds trust with participants, connects them to essential services, and promotes hope, recovery, and wellness. Essential functions include those listed below.


**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Conduct community outreach and engagement activities to identify and connect with at\-risk veterans and service members.
* Provide support and mentorship using shared lived experience to foster trust and empowerment.
* Assist individuals in navigating mental health and substance use services, housing resources, crisis intervention, and other support systems.
* Collaborate with local VA facilities, community providers, and the broader support network to coordinate services and referrals.
* Participate in suicide prevention trainings and maintain knowledge of best practices related to veteran care.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of all interactions and services provided, in compliance with grant requirements and confidentiality standards.
* Support follow\-up efforts with program participants to ensure continued engagement and service connection.
* Promote protective factors such as connectedness, resilience, and purpose among participants.
* Attend and participate in team meetings, supervision, and relevant community events.
* Must Embrace and embody the mission, vision, guiding principles, clinical vision, and goals of WestCare Foundation; and
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

**ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS:**

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the duties and responsibilities satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.*

***Experience and Competencies:***

* Strong interpersonal, engagement, advocacy, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to organize and prioritize a caseload, coordinate multiple services, and complete documentation timely.
* Ability to communicate effectively with participants, families, providers, community partners, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Sound judgment, problem\-solving ability, and the ability to respond appropriately to urgent participant needs.
* Basic computer proficiency and ability to use electronic records, databases, email, and standard office applications.
* Excellent communication skills;
* Ability to exercise good judgment and discretion;
* Ability to work well in a team environment;
* Military/Veteran status required.
* Adherence to the highest standard of ethical conduct, especially to standards governing confidentiality;
* Professional appearance and demeanor;
* Valid driver’s license and ability to obtain and maintain WestCare’s vehicle insurance is required; and
* Ability to obtain and maintain a criminal history background check.
* During your tenure with WestCare there may be new requirements, including, but not limited to vaccinations that are issued by local, State, Federal, and/or Funders that WestCare may have to comply with. Should this occur Human Resources or appropriate personnel will inform you.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:**

* Minimum of two (2\) years of experience of relevant experience.
* Experience working with high\-risk populations, including individuals experiencing mental health and/or substance use disorders.
* Knowledge of suicide prevention principles, trauma\-informed care, community resources, and challenges affecting veterans and service members.

**LICENSURE/CERTIFICATION:**

* Not applicable for this position.

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

* Work is primarily performed in an office setting.
* Regular travel throughout the assigned service area is required to support outreach, community partnerships, participant services, meetings, and program activities.
* Travel between WestCare facilities, VA facilities, community partner locations, and outreach sites may be required.
* Position requires regular interaction with Veterans and individuals who may be experiencing behavioral health concerns, emotional distress, significant psychosocial stressors, or suicide risk.
* Some evening or weekend work may be required to support outreach events, community activities, or program needs.

jobs.title: Event Coordinator - Atlanta
jobs.description:
**Event Coordinator**
=====================

**S.A.F.E. Management**  

**The Job**  


S.A.F.E. Management staffs and operates event security and guest services at nearly 70 venues across 11 markets and 10 states. That includes major NFL and college stadiums in Las Vegas, Phoenix, Houston, Nashville, Atlanta, Jacksonville, Tampa, Baltimore, Detroit, Newark, and Denver. On a busy weekend we have 20,000 team members working live events around the country.  


The Event Coordinator is a key player in the success of these events. You will help build the staffing plan, brief the team, proactively engage staff during the event, handle event\-day operations, and represent S.A.F.E. in front of the client.  


This is a hands\-on operations role for someone who aspires to grow in the sports \& entertainment industry.  

**What You'll Do:**  

**Run Events*** Work directly with clients to gather event details, staffing requirements, and day\-of expectations
* Build and update event\-day documentation, post assignments, and staffing plans
* Monitor venue operations during events to assess staffing levels, coverage, and performance against S.A.F.E. standards
* Solve day\-of problems quickly: call\-offs, gate changes, crowd flow, client requests, weather, unique event operations
* Brief the team prior to the start of the event and assist with debriefing afterward so the next event runs better

  

**Build the Team*** Participate in the recruiting process, including sourcing, applicant tracking, and interview scheduling
* Support critical teammate trainings such as, New Hire, Returning Staff, and Leadership trainings
* Handle staff questions in real time, on and off site
* Set the tone on professionalism and accountability that the team follows

 **Run the Back End**
Strong operators are organized operators and this sets the tone for game and event day.* Create and schedule events in our workforce management platform
* Submit and reconcile crew calls accurately in the timekeeping system
* Invoice completed events promptly and accurately
* Respond to office calls and emails within a timely manner
* Maintain clear, organized event documentation so another team member can step in and run the event if needed

 **Who We're Looking For*** Bachelor's degree
* 0 to 5 years of experience out of school
* A track record of competing on a team. Athletics, a campus organization, or an early job where your performance was measured and other people depended on you
* Ability to work efficiently in a fast\-paced, time\-sensitive environment
* Ability to communicate in front of a crowd and to senior\-level leadership
* Detail oriented, proficient with Microsoft Office, and the ability to quickly to pick up new systems
* Available nights, weekends, and holidays as our schedule follows the entertainment and events calendar
* Passionate about sports and live entertainment industry

 **Why S.A.F.E.**
We operate nearly 70 venues in 11 markets across 10 states, with the vision to continue to grow. This creates real responsibility early in your career. It also means a track to grow with S.A.F.E. is available for those who want it: coordinators can cross\-train at other venues in the portfolio and move up to manager with strong performance, managers can go on to eventually run venues.  

**We offer:*** Health insurance, 401(k) with company match, and paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Direct exposure to venue leadership, clients, and league/event\- level operations
* A career track across a national portfolio

 **Schedule**
Standard office hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with flexibility required for evening and weekend events, trainings, and interviews. This position reports directly to the respective market’s Managing Director. *We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.*

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **About Us**



Aptitude 8 is the leading HubSpot solutions consultancy for companies with complex CRM operations, advanced tech stacks, and ambitious growth goals. We design and implement CRM, data, automation, and RevOps solutions that unlock revenue performance and operational excellence. You'll join a rapidly scaling team of builders and operators who want to experiment, solve hard problems, and deliver outcomes that matter.



At Aptitude 8, you'll find remote flexibility, 401k, great benefits, meaningful work, growth opportunities, and the chance to shape the future of how companies operate!


### **About The Role**



We are seeking an individual looking to enhance their marketing career in a position that will allow behind\-the\-scenes access to a rapidly growing professional services business. This role is on our Marketing Team, helping position Aptitude 8 as the \#1 technical consulting partner in the HubSpot ecosystem.



In this role, you will work directly with our Demand Gen Manager on tasks spanning copywriting, social media management, event coordination, advertising, and much more. You will have ample opportunity to learn new skills, collaborate across departments, and have a direct impact on the success of our revenue goals.


**A normal day in this role****:** In this role, you will find that each day looks a little different. On a Monday, you might be putting together the next HubSpot User Group event, procuring swag and promotional items for another event, helping to coordinate a partnership co\-marketing initiative, and fleshing out an outline for a tactical eBook. On Tuesday, you might find yourself helping write emails for a lead gen initiative, making updates to our website, throwing together a social media graphic, or asking for status updates from event venues.


### **About You:**



You consider yourself a motivated, curious, independent, and innovative person who is ready to dive head\-first into any challenge. You're not afraid to ask questions, willing to do some digging/be resourceful, and confident enough in your opinions to provide edits, feedback, and ideas. You identify as a marketer, you are well rounded within the marketing function, and you love working and collaborating as a team. Key items of importance are that you are a skilled planner, detail\-oriented, can manage yours and your team's time effectively, and are very organized to keep track of multiple tasks and projects the team is working on. We are a fully remote team, so tech savviness is key.


* 2\+ years of experience in B2B Marketing either in an agency or in a junior role on an in\-house marketing team.
* Incredibly detail oriented, organized, and love making a plan and sticking to it.
* Well versed in checklists, SOPs, and are excellent at holding your team and vendors accountable.
* Possess a strong creative drive and enjoy things like graphic design, copywriting, branding, and video *(advanced proficiency not required but huge plus)*
* You're an early adopter of AI and know how to leverage it to make yourself more efficient.
* You love to organize and plan events, and you have a knack for project management.
* Proficient at keeping tabs on spend, budget, and working with finance.
* A self\-starter and able to work towards a solution with minimal direction.
* Ability to adapt to change quickly and are undaunted by something you've never done before.
* You love learning new things and excel at gaining expertise through research.
* You are a utility player and seamlessly flex into new tasks and requests.
* You love marketing automation, specifically the HubSpot platform.
	+ HubSpot certifications or other relevant experience are a huge plus.

**Salary Range:** $65\-75k/yr. We recognize that candidates bring a variety of backgrounds and skills, and we're committed to offering competitive and equitable compensation aligned with each individual's expertise.

  


#### **EEO Employer**



Aptitude 8 provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination or harassment of any type regardless of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.



This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training./

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**


Thrive delivers upon the promise of technology by enabling our clients’ digital transformation journeys with best practices on an AI, cybersecurity and cloud focused NextGen managed services platform.


Thrive’s culture is powered by diverse talent, big ideas, and a customer\-first mindset—and it’s what truly sets us apart. Thrive is built for people who want more than a weekday routine. If you’re hungry to grow, eager to tackle new challenges and ready to drive real impact in a rapidly expanding environment, then welcome to THRIVE!

**Position Overview**

As an Account Executive on Thrive’s Velocity team, you will drive revenue growth across a high\-volume portfolio of emerging and lower\-complexity accounts through proactive outbound outreach, upsell and cross\-sell selling, and disciplined pipeline management. This role is ideal for a motivated, early\-career sales professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys high activity, and is energized by building relationships, uncovering client needs, and closing transactional opportunities. You will partner closely with internal teams to deliver a strong customer experience while helping clients access the right Thrive solutions to support their business goals.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Manage and grow a designated portfolio of Velocity accounts through proactive outreach, relationship development, and opportunity identification
* Generate revenue by driving upsell, cross\-sell, and expansion opportunities across Thrive’s solutions and services
* Conduct a high volume of outbound calls, emails, and follow\-up activities to create pipeline and move opportunities forward
* Qualify client needs, identify buying signals, and align Thrive solutions to customer priorities using a consultative sales approach
* Own the sales process for transactional opportunities from initial outreach through quote, proposal, and close
* Maintain accurate account details, activity tracking, pipeline updates, and forecasting within Salesforce and related sales tools
* Partner effectively with internal stakeholders including service delivery, client success, solutions, and operations to support client needs and close business
* Monitor account activity, service trends, and customer feedback to identify retention risks and growth opportunities
* Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets tied to bookings, activity, and account growth
* Build knowledge of Thrive’s services, value proposition, and key market trends to communicate confidently with clients
* Participate in sales training, coaching, role\-play, and enablement activities to strengthen selling capability and accelerate performance
* Complete required reporting, documentation, and administrative responsibilities with accuracy, timeliness, and professionalism

  

**Requirements** **Qualifications \& Experience:**

* 2\+ years of sales, inside sales, business development, account management, or customer\-facing revenue experience, preferably in technology, managed services, SaaS, or a related industry
* Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of outreach and sales activity while maintaining strong follow\-up and organization
* Experience generating revenue through upsell, cross\-sell, renewals support, or transactional selling preferred
* Strong communication skills with the ability to build rapport, ask thoughtful questions, and clearly articulate value to clients
* Ability to identify opportunities, qualify needs, and advance deals in a fast\-paced, metrics\-driven sales environment
* Comfort using CRM tools such as Salesforce to manage pipeline, activity, and account information with discipline and accuracy
* Strong time management and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize across multiple accounts and opportunities
* Collaborative approach with the ability to work cross\-functionally and contribute to a strong team environment
* Curiosity, coachability, and willingness to learn Thrive’s solutions, sales process, and client needs quickly
* Bachelor’s degree preferred, but not required for candidates with relevant sales experience and a strong track record of performance

**Competencies to be Successful in the Role**

* Drive and Energy: Brings a high level of activity, urgency, and enthusiasm to managing accounts and creating opportunities
* Customer Focus: Builds strong relationships and looks for ways to help clients solve problems and gain value from Thrive’s solutions
* Sales Curiosity: Asks thoughtful questions, listens well, and uncovers underlying client needs and growth opportunities
* Communication: Communicates clearly, professionally, and confidently across phone, email, and virtual interactions
* Resilience: Stays motivated through rejection, setbacks, and changing priorities in a fast\-paced sales environment
* Organization and Discipline: Maintains strong follow\-up, pipeline hygiene, and attention to detail across a high volume of activity
* Coachability: Responds well to feedback, applies learning quickly, and shows a desire to continuously improve
* Collaboration: Works effectively with internal teams to support clients, solve problems, and move opportunities forward
* Adaptability: Adjusts quickly to new priorities, tools, messaging, and business needs in a growing organization
* Ownership: Takes accountability for results, follows through on commitments, and demonstrates pride in doing the job well

jobs.title: Associate National Account Manager
jobs.description:
**SUMMARY:**

FNA Group is a world class and leading manufacturer of consumer and industrial pressure washers and other outdoor power equipment. FNA's highly acclaimed brands include Simpson, Delco and CRX. Exclusive licenses with recognizable brands such as DeWalt, Stanley Black \& Decker and Craftsman further strengthens FNA's market presence and awareness. FNA is a dynamic organization with unprecedented growth due largely to its ability to attract and retain highly talented associates.


We have an excellent opportunity for a results\-oriented Associate National Account Manager who can work remotely from a home office in the southeastern United States.

 **Job Description:**


As an Associate National Account Manager for FNA Group, you will be responsible for developing and growing key retail partnerships within the company's consumers portfolio. You will support our sales initiatives with our customers in efforts of growing our business. Additionally, you will interface with FNA Group Demand Planning, Marketing, and Product teams in developing selling strategies, launching new products and aligning our forecast in efforts of delivering incremental business for your customers while maintaining targeted volume and profitability levels. The Associate National Account Manager can work remotely from a home office in the southeastern United States.

 **Duties / Responsibilities:**

* Support the National Account Team in developing and executing the annual account strategy and targets.
* Develop relationships with key customer partners across merchant, inventory, and online teams.
* Work cross\-functionally with internal teams to execute new product launches, maintain current listings, and identify opportunities with assortment.
* Master product knowledge for assigned customer.
* Ability to present in front of internal and external key decision makers.
* Assist in building customer presentations for product line reviews, business reviews, product launches, promotional planning, and assortment recommendations.
* Analyze POS, inventory, market\-share, promotional, and competitive data to identify risks and growth opportunities.
* Partner with demand planning and supply chain teams to ensure inventory aligns with retailer forecasts, promotions, resets, and product transitions.
* Coordinate new\-item setup, SKU maintenance, content readiness, pricing, packaging, samples, and retailer\-system requirements.
* Support assortment planning and recommendations across in\-store and online channels, including online exclusives, bundles, and promotional offers.
* Maintain competitive intelligence on products, pricing, features, promotions, customer reviews, and assortment changes.
* Develop weekly and monthly business recaps that communicate performance, key trends, risks, opportunities, and action items.
* Support store walks, product training, trade shows, product\-walk events, and retailer meetings.

 **Required Skills / Abilities:**

* 3\-4 years in B2B or field sales, account management, or channel experience.
* Strong analytical ability, including experience interpreting POS, inventory, forecasting, market\-share, and profitability data.
* Strong communication, presentation, organization, and project management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate across functions in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Willingness to travel for retailer meetings, store visits, line reviews, trade shows, and internal planning sessions.

 **Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's Degree in business or equivalent.
* Experience in supporting Lowe's, The Home Depot, or another major national retailer is strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Find Your Career With LiftOne**

We’re a family\-owned company under our fourth generation of leadership and have built our business based on the principles of trust, integrity and a desire to help our customers and employees succeed.


LiftOne invests in people, facilities and innovative technology as part of the essential role we play in supporting our country’s supply chain and enabling critical goods to be delivered to homes and businesses. We’re a privately held company, and pair our scale with a strong foundation in our culture and values. This combination gives us a competitive advantage in the market and helps make us a trailblazing organization that is built to last.


We’re looking for hard\-working, team\-oriented professionals who enjoy working on new challenges every day. We believe our employees are the key to our success, and we’re committed to providing a work experience that helps our team grow to their full potential. We offer great benefits, competitive salaries and opportunities for advancement to all our employees.


Be a part of the essential work we do at LiftOne and make a difference for our customers, our community and our company. Learn more about what it means to become a team member with LiftOne.

**Summary**


As a LiftOne Account Manager, you will be combining technical knowledge with sales skill to profitably grow revenue for the company and maximize market share. This position requires someone that has a strong technical acumen, is assertive, personable, and solutions\-oriented. In this position, you will identify new sales opportunities and manage a book of assigned business, develop sales proposals, estimates, specifications, and presentations. You will prepare strategic plans to increase revenue and position LiftOne as the premier partner for material handling equipment, service programs, preventive maintenance contracts, parts, additional repair programs, rental power programs and rental services. The ability to work with people and teams is essential.

**Essential Functions**

* Strategically identify opportunities to grow sales profitably with new and existing customers within an assigned territory. Develop and execute account plans for existing and potential target accounts.
* Pursues the critical success factors for the application, distribution, and satisfaction of customer needs for material handling equipment and service programs
* Partner with the customer to understand their business and serve as a trusted advisor who understands their needs.
* Develop and deliver product demonstrations and sales presentations that explain why a customer should consider a change, why it makes sense now and then why you and CTE are in the unique position to deliver the solutions that will benefit the customer.
* Think critically and suggest improvements that lead to risk mitigation, cost savings, profitable revenue growth or other customer goal achievement.
* Understand and report on significant market trends and competitive intelligence.
* Provide clear and accurate responses for RFPs and contribute technical solutions directly to proposals.
* Identify customer business opportunities by analyzing cost\-benefit ratios of equipment in customer environment; engineering or proposing changes in equipment, processes, or services.
* Develop and calculate finance solutions for varied customer needs or demands.
* Build a strong understanding of customers’ business issues ie: inventory, asset management, ROI, financial statement analysis.
* Maintain and document customer interactions within a CRM and quoting system from first meeting to deal closure and follow\-up activities.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**


This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

**Qualifications**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualifying individuals to perform the essential functions.

jobs.description:
**About Us**

Classic Commercial Services founded in 1973 is a premier commercial floor and textile cleaning specialist serving hotels, senior living communities, high\-end apartment communities, and event spaces across the Atlanta area — with an active expansion underway into Savannah. We're IICRC certified, backed by a 100% satisfaction guarantee, and known for high\-end specialized cleaning (carpet, tile \& grout, upholstery, drapery, and 24/7 water restoration) rather than general janitorial work.

**The Role**

We're hiring an Assistant Manager to own our client relationships and help run the day\-to\-day of the business alongside our Service Manager. This is a hybrid role for someone who's equally comfortable managing accounts and pitching in on operations — a great fit for someone who wants real ownership and a growth path, not just a desk job.

**What You'll Do**

**Account Management**

* Own relationships with our existing client base — hotels, senior living communities, apartment properties, and more
* Manage our sales pipeline from lead to close, including proposal follow\-up
* Proactively check in with clients to keep service on schedule and catch accounts before they go quiet
* Check in post jobs to ensure quality, gather feedback and address concerns
* Handle customer escalations professionally and find solutions quickly

**Operations Support**

* Learn our scheduling and dispatch system well enough to run day\-to\-day operations when needed
* Support the operations team with coordination, vendor communication, and administrative follow\-through
* Assist in organization and operation of warehouse, inventory and lockers
* Keep track of fleet maintenance and repairs

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong relationship\-management or account\-management experience — this is the core of the role
* Staying on top of follow\-ups and details
* Tech savvy\- Comfortable working in a CRMs and other office software
* A proactive, ownership mindset — someone who sees a problem and solves it rather than waiting to be told
* Prior experience in field services, facilities, hospitality, or property management is a plus, but not required
* Strong communication skills and professionalism with client\-facing escalations

Pay: $41,600\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year

* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

Welcome to Ryerson, where exceptional career opportunities await. As a leading provider of industrial metal products and services since 1842, we are committed to excellence and best\-in\-class customer service. Join our team and be a part of a legacy of excellence, where your contributions will be valued, and your development supported. jobs.description:
**Job Description:**


Alliance Ground International (AGI) is one of the largest independently owned ground handling company providing services to 100\+ airlines in 61 airports across the U.S. and Canada. We are the home to over 12,000 team members supporting over 1\.5B Kilos and over 400K departures. Our Ground division has a strong reputation in aviation ground services. We are committed to providing the highest level of quality service and continuing our track record of outstanding safety. As we continue to grow, we are looking for only the best in the industry.


The work of an Account Manager includes but is not limited to managing, directing and coordinating all activities relating to cargo account operations by performing the following duties personally or through subordinates. Establish, implement and maintain all departmental policies and procedures, to ensure all Company cargo operations are safe, efficient and in compliance with all applicable Company and governmental regulations. Responsible for the work accomplished in the carriage of cargo process, flight/load manifest/weight \& balance control process and has the authority to direct persons to accomplish that work. Provide for the oversight and provisioning of ground handling services related to cargo operations.

* Coordinate with Company personnel, customers, third party service providers and applicable government agencies to ensure contract/regulatory compliance and customer satisfaction in all aspects of the Company's cargo operations.
* Conduct periodic audits on all Company cargo operations.
* Produce, revise, and distribute all departmental training aids, directives, reports, forms, memos, etc. and is responsible for all departmental manuals.
* Ensure all personnel involved in Company cargo operations and/or ground handling of Company aircraft are properly trained.
* Evaluate training and performance records of employees to determine and formulate training designed to increase employee efficiency, safety, plus ensure compliance with all Company and governmental regulations.
* Maintain the Hazardous Materials Training Program for all applicable employees.
* Develop and implement policies and procedures for the safe and efficient handling of ULDs.
* Lead by example to deliver consistently great service to our customers
* Ensure compliance with all Company safety and security procedures in order to meet/exceed regulatory standards
* Maintain, monitor and report on agreed key performance indicators (KPI's)
* Conduct full investigations on irregularities, accidents or complaints as per our standard reporting requirements
* Drive consistency and standards by ensuring clear communications at all levels on operational policies and procedures.
* Ensure all agreed training is completed and documented
* Build and maintain relationships with stakeholders, internal and external
* Resolve issues/conflicts in a timely manner
* Ensure efficient operation of inbound and outbound flights
* Conducts oneself in such a way as to promote and drive integrity, fairness, personal attitude and respect for others.
* Able to meet the Station's attendance policy.

Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding employees; addressing complaints and resolving issues.


Qualifications  

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Effective people management and planning /organizational skills, customer focused and analytical with good judgment, able to work under pressure and a team player


Knowledge, Skill and Abilities

* Warehouse management experience preferred
* Ability to deal with conflict and resolve issues
* Intermediate computer skills with working knowledge of Microsoft Office programs.
* Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.
* Must be able to handle stress in a fast\-paced environment and ensure deadlines are met.
* Ability to concentrate on detail.
* Ability to lift 50\-70 lbs.
* Adhere to safety practices and programs.
* Ability to multitask.
* Good communication skills


Education and Experience

* Associates degree from college or university; or three to five years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Valid US driver’s license.
* Successful completion of required airport badging process and pre\-employment drug screen is required.


Schedule of Hours  

As an airline services provider, Alliance Ground International requires its employees to be able to work flexible schedules which may be adjusted to meet operational demands such as flight delays, cancellations, etc., Strict adherence to company attendance policies are expected and enforced.

  

Alliance Ground International is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. AGI is committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or veteran status.

Securitas Healthcare empowers caregivers to deliver connected, productive, and safe care. Our innovative portfolio of solutions helps hospitals, clinics, and senior living organizations protect people, use their assets efficiently, and understand their operations for a caring and healing environment. With deep roots in healthcare and a commitment to our customers’ long\-term success, we are proud to work with over 15,000 providers worldwide across the care continuum. Responsible for growing a pre\-assigned book of business as well as prospecting for new accounts, presenting Securitas Healthcare solutions, closing the business, and managing the account after the initial sale to ensure continued revenue growth. * Effectively work with our Authorized Service Providers (ASP’s) where applicable to plan and manage deployments and assure proper support is provided.
* Keep all pertinent people informed of any problems or important issues concerning the accounts
