* Update and analyze information on each current account; be knowledgeable of client solutions in place that aligns with our solutions
* Track and create meaningful information on current accounts by developing a strategic plan to promote growth and execute
* Assist in mentoring Client Executives and Account Mangers to hone sales skills
* Develop and execute a strategic plan to promote growth within territory
* Engage in problem solving and make decisions and recommendations as appropriate
* Travel as necessary to meet the goals of the company through attendance at trade shows, client sites, national account visits, etc.
* Other duties as assigned
**Required Qualifications:**

* College degree in Business or Marketing or equivalent combination education and work experience in these areas required.
* 5\-7 years of sales experience required; business to business
* 2 plus years of experience of managing corporate sales accounts
* Sales experience in healthcare required
* Successful track record managing a growing account portfolio \& sales territory
* The right individual will be self\-motivated, with a high energy level what will take the initiative to research, make decisions, follow through on and accomplish multiple tasks with a sense of vision, detail, commitment, priority and urgency
* Must be a leader with demonstrated selling and relationship building capabilities that enjoys a challenge
* Must possess above\-average oral and written communication abilities, and strong interpersonal skills
* The ability to present products and information to key high\-level people required
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word is essential
* Physically capable of setting up and tearing down trade show booths and demo kits, may require lifting up to 50 lbs.
* Valid Driver’s license and a good driving record is required
* Must have the ability to travel at 50%\-60% of the time.

**To Excel:**

* Experience managing and partnering with Group Purchasing Organizations (GPOs).
* Background in building and scaling Real\-Time Location Services (RTLS) pipelines and solutions.
* Proven success working with Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs) and hospital systems, navigating complex healthcare procurement and stakeholder environments.

**Supervisor’s Title:** Sr Director, National Accounts

**Department Name:** Sales

**FLSA Status:** Exempt, Full\-time, M\-F

jobs.description:
**Description**


Join Syneos Health in partnership with a large Biopharmaceutical company as a Pharmaceutical Sales Representative (PSR). Become a part of a fast\-paced and challenging environment where our compassion and dedication drive us to meet the unique needs and goals of our customers. The PSR role is responsible for building relationships with recognized experts, healthcare providers (HCPs) and prioritized stakeholders.

 **The successful PSR will:**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing, and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key accounts with the goal of maximizing sales
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action
* Deliver clinical brand specific presentations of product(s) to physicians and other appropriate health care professionals
* Develop a complete understanding of the health care delivery system within each assigned customer, including the physician hierarchy, key pharmacy personnel, clinical nursing staff, etc.
* Develop deep product and competitor knowledge and understanding of local and regional market trends
* Analyze local trends, identifying long and short\-term goals to craft a strong product business plan
* Collaborate and partner with peers in the sales organization, brand team and other support partners to deliver an extraordinary customer experience
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner
* Execute the company brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area
* Participation in training and development programs
* Maintain adherence and compliance with all corporate, industry policies and procedures

 **Essential Requirements:**

* BA/BS degree required, Life Sciences preferred
* Business to business sales experience or internship experience and/or sales degree or 2\+ years of pharmaceutical experience
* Ability to identify key decision makers, develop positive relationships and strong customer dedication and influence prescribing habits
* Ability to learn, apply, and communicate products and disease states
* Proven track record of success in exceeding results
* Team player who can also work independently, highly collaborative and motivated to succeed
* Strong communication, business analytics and account management skills

 **Desired Requirements:**

* Respiratory Experience

  

At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, the work is challenging, and the pace is exhilarating. By joining one of our commercial teams, you’re empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Syneos Health has launched more sales teams in the last 5 years across all major therapeutic areas than the top 25 pharma companies combined. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Associate - Global Customer Success
jobs.description:
StubHub is on a mission to redefine the live event experience on a global scale. Whether someone is looking to attend their first event or their hundredth, we're here to delight them all the way from the moment they start looking for a ticket until they step through the gate. The same goes for our sellers. From fans selling a single ticket to the promoters of a worldwide stadium tour, we want StubHub to be the safest, most convenient way to offer a ticket to the millions of fans who browse our platform around the world.



We're seeking a Strategy \& Operations Associate to improve the systems, data, and operating models behind StubHub's global customer success organization. You'll help thousands across our customer success organization deliver reliable outcomes through better staffing, training, standards, and performance visibility.



You will build the intelligence and operating systems that help Global Customer Success perform at its best. Working across data, technology, and operations, you'll turn complex problems into scalable solutions for a global workforce of thousands.


**Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:**



This is a full\-time position requiring flexibility in terms of schedule. Nights and/or weekends may be required based on the needs of the business.


**This role is hybrid in Atlanta, GA, and may require up to 20% travel to company offices in New York, Los Angeles, Limerick, and other international partner locations.**



**What You'll Do**
* Build the single source of truth for customer success performance, connecting service quality, productivity, staffing, training, and customer outcomes.
* Use AI, automation, and rapid prototyping to transform manual reporting and operational processes into faster, smarter, and more scalable systems.
* Develop decision tools that help leaders anticipate demand, deploy the right skills and capacity, and respond quickly during major events and demand spikes.
* Build the forecasting, capacity, and workforce economics models that translate customer demand, productivity, service targets, and cost into clear headcount, staffing, budget, and partner decisions across channels and markets.
* Reinvent how performance improves by translating customer interactions and operational data into sharper quality programs, training curricula, coaching, and knowledge systems.
* Tackle high\-impact, ambiguous problems – from emerging performance gaps to new tooling launches – owning the work from problem definition and analysis through recommendation and implementation.
* Design metrics, dashboards, and operating reviews that surface what matters, explain why it is happening, and make the next action clear.
* Establish shared standards, definitions, and feedback loops across internal teams and global outsourcing partners, creating consistency without slowing innovation.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, Data, and Technology leaders to test new ideas, scale what works, and shape the next generation of customer support at StubHub.
**What You've Done**
* 2\-5\+ years in business operations / strategy or consulting.
* Strong SQL and spreadsheet skills, plus experience building or maintaining dashboards.
* Experience leveraging AI tools to build, scale, and iterate data reporting and processes.
* Ability to structure ambiguous questions, validate data, identify patterns, and recommend action.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accurate, decision\-ready work.
* Ability to coordinate projects across stakeholders and move from analysis to implementation.
* Clear communication, customer\-first judgment, curiosity, and ownership in a fast\-moving environment.
**What We Offer**
* **Accelerated Growth Environment**: An environment designed for swift skill and knowledge enhancement, where you have the autonomy to lead experiments and tests on a massive scale.
* **Top Tier Compensation Package**: Competitive base, equity, and upside that tracks with your impact.
* **Flexible Time Off**: Enjoy unlimited Flex Time Off, giving you the flexibility to manage your schedule and take time to recharge as needed.
* **Comprehensive Benefits Package**: Prioritize your well\-being with a comprehensive benefits package, featuring 401k, and premium Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance options.
  




**About Us**
StubHub is the world's leading marketplace to buy and sell tickets to any live event, anywhere. Through StubHub in North America and viagogo, our international platform, we service customers in 195 countries in 33 languages and 49 available currencies. With more than 300 million tickets available annually on our platform to events around the world \- from sports to music, comedy to dance, festivals to theater \- StubHub offers the safest, most convenient way to buy or sell tickets to the most memorable live experiences. Come join our team for a front\-row seat to the action.

* Flexible schedule

**Build Your Income. Build Your Career. Make an Impact.**  


  

Are you driven, competitive, coachable, and ready for an opportunity where your income and advancement are connected to your performance?  


  

We are growing—and we're looking for the right people to grow with us.  


  

Our team helps individuals, families, businesses, and employees protect what matters most through supplemental insurance benefits. We work hard, support one another, grow together, and believe work should be fun.

**Growth. Service. Teamwork. Fun. Integrity.**

Our agents come from many backgrounds, including business ownership, hospitality, retail, automotive sales, customer service, and professional sales.  


  

No insurance experience is required. We provide training, a proven sales system, coaching, and field support. You should be comfortable working independently, managing your time, following a system, hearing “no,” and continuing forward.  


  

**What You'll Do**  

* Present supplemental insurance products to individuals, businesses, and employee groups
* Build relationships with new and existing clients
* Prospect for customers and business opportunities
* Conduct appointments and follow up with prospects
* Work toward activity and production goals
* Answer client questions and resolve concerns
* Generate referrals and repeat opportunities

Develop your sales, communication, and leadership skills  
* 

  

**What We're Looking For**  

* Driven, resilient, and self\-motivated
* Independent and comfortable managing your own schedule
* Coachable and willing to follow a proven system
* Goal\-oriented and comfortable with measurable results
* Emotionally mature and willing to accept feedback
* Relationship\-focused with strong communication skills

Able to take ownership of your performance  
* 

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* 2–4 years of outside sales experience preferred, but not required
* Experience in B2B sales, customer service, business ownership, hospitality, retail, or another performance\-driven field
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills
* Organized and detail\-oriented

Insurance license preferred, or willingness to obtain required licensing  
* 

  

**What We Provide**  


  

**Training \& Support**  

* Intensive Sales Academy training
* Proven sales system
* Field training with experienced agents
* Ongoing coaching and professional development

Access to leaders and top\-performing producers  
* 

  

**Income \& Growth Potential**  

* Average first\-year agent income of **$65,000**
* Qualified agents may earn **well above $100,000** in their first year
* Weekly commission advances and performance bonuses
* Performance\-based advancement and leadership opportunities
* Passive renewal commissions you own for life after your 2\-year anniversary

Stock ownership plan  
* 

  

**Freedom \& Flexibility**  


  

As an independent agent, you have flexibility in managing your schedule, independence in your day\-to\-day work, and greater control over your activity and earning potential.  


  

**This Could Be a Great Fit If...**  


  

You want more than simply completing assigned tasks and waiting for a paycheck. You enjoy working with people, are willing to learn, can handle rejection, and take ownership of your results.  


  

You want an opportunity where your effort, growth, and performance can directly impact your income and advancement.  


  

We're growing quickly and looking for passionate, service\-minded, hardworking people who are serious about success—and enjoy having fun along the way.  


  

**If you're ready to learn, work, grow, and build something meaningful, we'd love to talk with you.**  


Flexible work from home options available.

A major focus of Chronetyx is **molecular infectious\-disease testing**, including pathogen identification and antibiotic\-resistance testing.

**What You Will Sell**

Our growing infectious\-disease testing menu includes:

* **Urinary Tract Infection (UTI) PCR** with reflex antibiotic\-resistance testing
* **Wound and skin/soft\-tissue infection PCR** with antibiotic\-resistance testing
* **Bacterial Vaginosis**
* **Group B Strep**
* **Sexually Transmitted Infection (STI)**
* **Respiratory pathogen testing**
* **Throat/Pharyngitis testing**
* Additional molecular infectious\-disease panels and specialty diagnostic testing

The Laboratory Sales Representative will be responsible for developing new physician and healthcare accounts while growing existing relationships within an assigned territory.

This is a **business\-development\-focused sales position**. We are looking for someone who is comfortable prospecting, gaining access to healthcare decision\-makers, presenting laboratory solutions, closing new accounts, and developing long\-term client relationships.

The ideal candidate understands clinical laboratory sales and can effectively communicate the value of accurate molecular testing, antibiotic\-resistance information, turnaround time, specimen logistics, reimbursement, and physician workflow.

* Develop new business for Chronetyx molecular and infectious\-disease laboratory services.
* Identify, prospect, and convert physician practices and healthcare organizations within the assigned territory.
* Build relationships with physicians, administrators, practice managers, nursing leadership, and other healthcare decision\-makers.
* Present and educate clients on UTI PCR testing, Bacterial Vaginosis testing, Group B Strep testing, STI testing, Wound testing, Respiratory testing, Pharyngitis/Strep testing.
* Explain the clinical and operational advantages of molecular pathogen identification compared with traditional C\&S testing approaches.
* Develop and maintain an active pipeline of prospective accounts.
* Conduct regular in\-person sales calls, presentations, lunches, meetings, and follow\-up activities.
* Coordinate with Chronetyx laboratory operations, client services, billing, informatics, and logistics teams to successfully onboard new accounts.
* Maintain detailed sales activity, account information, target lists, forecasts, and next steps.
* Meet or exceed assigned sales activity, revenue, and specimen\-volume goals.

**Who We Are Looking For**

**Previous clinical laboratory sales experience is strongly preferred and may be considered a requirement for certain territories.**

We have a particularly strong interest in candidates with prior experience selling:

* Molecular infectious\-disease testing
* PCR\-based laboratory testing
* UTI molecular testing
* Wound infection testing
* Antibiotic\-resistance testing
* Respiratory panels
* STI testing
* Clinical pathology or specialty laboratory services

**Prior infectious\-disease laboratory sales experience is highly desirable.**

Candidates with successful prior experience at companies such as **Eurofins Diatherix, TEN Healthcare, Infinite Genomics, Vikor Scientific, or similar molecular and infectious\-disease laboratories** are strongly encouraged to apply.

An existing network of physician, practice, long\-term care, or healthcare relationships within the assigned territory is a significant advantage.

**Target Customers**

Representatives may call on:

* Urology practices
* Wound\-care centers
* Primary\-care practices
* Urgent\-care centers
* Long\-term care and skilled\-nursing facilities
* Infectious\-disease practices
* Podiatry practices
* OB/GYN and women's health practices
* Multi\-specialty physician groups
* Hospitals and health systems
* Other healthcare organizations with significant infectious\-disease testing needs

**Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of successful healthcare sales experience preferred.
* Build on your current book of business by adding new client accounts
* Clinical laboratory sales experience strongly preferred.
* Molecular infectious\-disease or PCR sales experience highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to prospect, develop, and close new business.
* Established physician and healthcare relationships within the territory are highly desirable.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare, Biology, Biomedical Science, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
* Understanding of Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance, and laboratory reimbursement is preferred.
* Strong communication internal and external, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to understand and communicate clinical and scientific information.
* Proven record of meeting or exceeding sales goals.
* Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to independently develop a territory.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Outlook, Teams, and CRM or sales\-management systems.
* Willingness to travel throughout the assigned territory.

Entry\-Level Sales Representative  
Start in Sales. Prove Yourself. Build a Career.  


Base Pay \+ Uncapped Performance Bonuses \| Full\-Time \| Paid Training \| Career Advancement  


Pinnacle Home Improvements is one of the fastest\-growing exterior home improvement companies in the Southeast, and we're looking for competitive, motivated, and ambitious individuals who want more than just another job.  
This is an opportunity to break into sales, develop valuable communication skills, earn based on your performance, and create a path toward sales and leadership.  
No sales experience? That's okay. We're not looking for the perfect resume; we're looking for people with drive, grit, coachability, and a strong work ethic.  
We'll provide training, coaching, scripts, and proven systems. You bring the effort and willingness to improve.  


What We Offer  
Competitive base pay plus uncapped performance bonuses  
Reps after successful training averaging $1,200\+ per week  
Top performers with the opportunity to earn $100,000\+ annually  
Paid, hands\-on training  
Daily coaching and ongoing professional development  
Proven scripts and systems designed to help you succeed  
Performance\-based recognition and advancement  
Clear opportunities to grow into sales and leadership roles  
Competitive, team\-oriented environment  
Opportunity to build a long\-term career with a growing company  
What You'll Do \- As an Entry\-Level Sales Representative, you'll represent Pinnacle Home Improvements in local communities and introduce homeowners to our exterior remodeling services.  
You'll:  
Engage with homeowners through face\-to\-face residential outreach  
Build rapport and identify potential home improvement needs  
Educate homeowners about Pinnacle's roofing, windows, siding, gutters, and door services  
Generate interest and schedule free consultations with our in\-home sales team  
Work toward individual and team performance goals  
Participate in ongoing sales training, coaching, and team meetings  
Professionally represent the Pinnacle brand in the communities we serve  
Who We're Looking For  
You may be a great fit if you're:  
Competitive and motivated by goals  
Comfortable talking to new people  
Coachable and willing to improve  
Resilient and able to handle rejection  
Dependable and accountable  
Positive, energetic, and team\-oriented  
Hungry for an opportunity to grow  
Looking for a career, not just your next job  
Previous sales experience is not required.  
Experience in sales, customer service, retail, hospitality, athletics, marketing, or other competitive environments can be helpful, but your attitude, work ethic, and willingness to learn matter more to us than your resume.  
Requirements  
Must be at least 18 years old  
Strong communication and interpersonal skills  
Reliable transportation  
Ability to walk and work outdoors for extended periods  
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment  
Willingness to be coached and held accountable to performance expectations

Friday: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM  
This role is for individuals who are ready to win.  
This role requires you to get outside your comfort zone. You'll work in the field, talk to people you've never met, hear "no," and be challenged to improve. But if you're competitive, coachable, resilient, and willing to work, you'll have an opportunity to develop skills that can take you far beyond an entry\-level position.  
At Pinnacle, we believe performance should create opportunity.  
Start in sales development. Learn how to generate business. Get coached by proven leaders. Perform at a high level. Earn your way into sales and leadership.  
We're not looking for people who simply want to "try" sales.  
We're looking for people who want an opportunity to prove what they're capable of.  
If that sounds like you, we'd like to meet you.  
Apply today and start advancing your career with Pinnacle Home Improvements.

The Administrative Coordinator provides professional, efficient, and high\-quality administrative support to the Physician Assistant (PA) Program. * Serve as the primary point of contact for students by greeting and assisting them in the program office.

* Support processing of adjunct faculty preceptor payments and program\-related invoices.
* Assist in student subsidized housing arrangements.
* Conduct monthly verification of preceptor licensure and board certification status
* Other duties as assigned.

##### **Clinical Skills Laboratory Responsibilities**


* Responsible for the overall coordination, operation, and continuous improvement of the clinical skills laboratory.
* Assist with daily operations of the space, including schedules, labs, classes, and assessments, and ensure the lab is well maintained.
* Ensure compliance and coordinate with Campus Facilities and others to ensure the space is properly maintained.
* Conduct and maintain inventory for the PA Program Clinical Skills Laboratory.
* Collaborate with faculty to identify laboratory supplies and equipment needs for teaching, clinical skills practice, testing, and simulation activities.
* Coordinate the ordering, receiving, storage, and distribution of clinical supplies utilized in skills labs, testing, and simulations.
* Maintain accurate inventory of consumable supplies, equipment, and instructional materials; perform routine and end\-of\-term inventories.
* Monitor supply usage trends to ensure appropriate stock levels aligned with program enrollment and course scheduling.
* Assist in developing the lab budget.
* Ensure proper storage and calibration, oversee the lifecycle of equipment and supplies, and maintain the overall orderliness of the lab.

jobs.description:
**Pilgrim Lutheran Church \& School \- Enrollment \& Marketing Coordinator**

Pilgrim Lutheran Church \& School is seeking a **mission\-driven, relationship\-focused professional** to serve as our **Enrollment \& Marketing Coordinator**. This position is central to growing our school community by helping prospective families discover Pilgrim, guiding them through the enrollment process, and telling the story of what makes our school special.

The Coordinator will lead enrollment and admissions efforts, manage school marketing and communications, and support select fundraising and advancement activities. This is an opportunity for a creative, organized, and people\-oriented professional to make a meaningful impact on the future of a vibrant Lutheran school community.

**Position Snapshot**

* **Schedule:** Approximately 35 hours per week
* **Salary:** $42,000 annually
* **Performance Incentive:** Additional performance bonuses may be available for achieving mutually agreed\-upon enrollment goals.
* **Health Benefits:** Employee\-only medical, dental, and vision benefits
* **Health Opt\-Out:** Additional $2,010 annually, if eligible
* **Retirement:** Employer contribution of 3% of base salary
* **Paid Time Off**

**Key ResponsibilitiesEnrollment \& Admissions**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective families from initial inquiry through enrollment.
* Manage the admissions and enrollment pipeline, including inquiries, applications, follow\-up, and enrollment records.
* Coordinate tours, shadow days, open houses, and other recruitment events.
* Develop and implement strategies to increase inquiries, applications, enrollment, and student retention.
* Build strong, welcoming relationships with prospective and current families.
* Identify opportunities to improve the prospective\-family experience and strengthen enrollment processes.
* Track enrollment trends and use data to identify opportunities for growth.
* Collaborate with school leadership and faculty to showcase Pilgrim's programs, strengths, and student experience.

**Marketing \& Communications**

* Develop and coordinate marketing and communications that promote Pilgrim's mission, programs, events, and community.
* Create engaging admissions and marketing materials for print and digital platforms.
* Gather stories, photographs, testimonials, and other content that showcase student life and the Pilgrim experience.
* Maintain and update enrollment\-related website content and support the school's social media and digital presence.
* Ensure consistent, compelling messaging across enrollment, marketing, and school communications.
* Develop creative outreach strategies to introduce Pilgrim to prospective families and strengthen awareness in the surrounding community.

**Advancement \& Fundraising Support**

* Coordinate communications for annual giving and select fundraising campaigns.
* Ensure gifts are acknowledged promptly and appropriately.
* Assist with fundraising events, sponsorships, donor communications, and other advancement initiatives.
* Support school leadership, volunteers, and the board with donor outreach and stewardship.
* Create marketing and communications materials that support fundraising and community engagement.

**Administration \& Reporting**

* Track enrollment inquiries, applications, conversion, retention, and other key enrollment indicators.
* Provide regular enrollment and marketing reports to school leadership.
* Maintain organized admissions, marketing, and advancement records.
* Recommend improvements to enrollment, communications, and outreach processes.
* Collaborate with the Director of Operations and other members of the administrative team on events and initiatives.

**Qualifications**

The ideal candidate will have:

* A college degree or equivalent professional experience in enrollment, admissions, marketing, communications, education, nonprofit leadership, or a related field.
* Experience in admissions, enrollment, marketing, communications, customer or family engagement, or a related area.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Strong relationship\-building skills and a welcoming, service\-oriented approach.
* Creativity and enthusiasm for telling an organization's story and connecting with its community.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently.
* Proficiency with digital communication tools, social media, databases, spreadsheets, website platforms, and reporting systems.
* Strong attention to detail and accurate recordkeeping.
* Commitment to the mission, ministry, and values of Pilgrim Lutheran Church \& School.

Experience in fundraising or nonprofit advancement is **helpful but not required**.

**Why This Position Matters**

At Pilgrim, enrollment is about more than filling seats – it is about welcoming families into a community where students are known, supported, challenged, and encouraged to grow.

The Enrollment \& Marketing Coordinator will play a key role in helping more families discover Pilgrim, and understand what makes our school unique. Through thoughtful admissions, creative marketing, strong communication, and genuine relationship\-building, this person will help grow our school community and strengthen its future.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys **connecting with people, telling a compelling story, building relationships, and helping an organization grow.**

Pay: $42,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Run a regional healthcare business. Change thousands of lives.**


Are you a proven operator who wants to own a P\&L — not just manage tasks? Do you want your leadership to translate directly into patients getting care they'd otherwise go without? Join United Allergy Services and run your region like it's your own business.

**Who we are:**


United Allergy Services is the largest allergy care provider in the U.S. We partner with physicians nationwide to bring allergy testing and immunotherapy directly into local clinics — expanding access to millions of patients who would otherwise go without care. We've helped more than 300,000 patients overcome their allergies and earned thousands of 5\-star patient reviews along the way. Recently acquired by an ambitious team with deep experience in allergy pharmacy services, telemedicine, and technology, we're growing fast — and we need leaders who can grow with us.

**Your future role:**


As Regional Operations Manager, you'll own a territory of partnered physician clinics — their performance, their people, and their P\&L. You'll train and supervise a team of Clinical Allergy Specialists, build deep relationships with physicians and clinic leadership, recruit top talent, and make the business decisions that drive your region's growth. Your results are measured, your upside is shared through profit share, and your ceiling is set by your own performance. This is general management, not account management.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Own regional P\&L performance — set goals, execute quarterly business plans, and make smart business decisions to hit them.
* Support, train, and supervise Clinical Allergy Specialists across multiple clinics in your region.
* Build trusted relationships with physicians and clinical leadership through regular on\-site visits and quarterly business reviews.
* Recruit, develop, and retain a high\-performing regional team.
* Lead new clinic implementations and identify process improvements that lift clinic performance.
* Travel regularly to clinics within your territory.
**Who****we're****looking for:**

* Proven people leader — you've managed teams of 10\+ and know how to develop talent.
* P\&L mindset — you've owned business results before, or you're hungry to own them now.
* Healthcare experience, or a strong desire to build a career in healthcare.
* Comfortable and credible communicating with physicians and clinical leadership.
* High accountability, entrepreneurial self\-starter — you treat the region like your own business.
* Willingness to travel within your territory.
**Compensation \& benefits:**

* $60k–$120k base \+ profit share.
* Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off.
* Career advancement opportunities as we scale nationwide.
**Work Location**: In person / regional travel

**Ready to run your own region? Apply today.**

jobs.title: Partner Account Manager
jobs.description:
What's the role?:  

We are seeking a strategic, consultative Partner Account Manager who will drive revenue growth through a key global hyperscale cloud partnership while supporting Enterprise Sales opportunities across APAC.  

This role is not a traditional alliance, channel, or partner marketing position. The successful candidate will act as a strategic sales partner, helping Account Executives identify, shape, accelerate, and close complex enterprise opportunities through strategic cloud partner engagement. They will also be a direct seller, hunting for new business opportunities across the APAC region.### **What You Will Do**

* Partner with Enterprise Account Executives to influence and accelerate strategic opportunities through our cloud ecosystem partnerships.
* Leverage cloud marketplace programs, co\-sell motions, and partner funding initiatives to increase deal size and shorten sales cycles.
* Build and maintain relationships with partner field organizations across the region.
* Prospect and develop new business opportunities within strategic partner accounts.
* Expand existing partner\-related business by identifying new use cases, stakeholders, and revenue opportunities.
* Support partnership KPIs that unlock strategic sales, marketing, and business development investments.
* Develop consultative account strategies that align customer business objectives with HERE capabilities and partner solutions.
* Act as a trusted advisor to internal sales teams, helping position joint value propositions that drive customer outcomes and business growth.
  


Who are you?:
A strategic sales and cloud partnership leader who acts as a trusted advisor to both enterprise sales teams and HEREs strategic partnership, influencing opportunities early and helping organizations solve complex business challenges through cloud\-driven solutions.* 5\+ years in Enterprise Sales, Strategic Partnerships, Business Development, or Alliances.
* Experience selling SaaS, cloud, or enterprise technology.
* Consultative selling experience with complex enterprise customers.
* Proven experience influencing large, multi\-stakeholder sales opportunities.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience creating pipeline and identifying new opportunities.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies, industries, or partner ecosystems.


Preferred Experience* Experience with hyperscale cloud partnerships
* Deep knowledge of location technology
* Experience selling SaaS, cloud or enterprise technology

**Why HERE?**


HERE combines global location data, enterprise\-grade technology and deep real\-world context. You will help customers use those capabilities to optimize movement, improve operations, build location\-aware products and apply AI to problems in the physical world. You do not need to know everything about HERE on day one. What matters is your ability to learn quickly, architect credible solutions and communicate their value.


The expected base salary range for this position is $96,600 to $138,000 per year. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as skills and experience. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, which is subject to company and individual performance.  

Life at HERE comes with generous benefits to support your health and overall wellness. Benefits available to US\-based HERE employees include health (Medical/Dental/Vision) insurance, retirement savings plans, paid time off \& leave policies.  

As part of HERE Technologies employment process, candidates will be required to successfully complete a background verification process. Offers of employment and any related claims are subject to the successful completion of a background verification. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, HERE will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  

HERE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.  

Under Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 and VEVRAA, we have developed an affirmative action program (AAP) for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. Portions of the AAP are available for review by applicants and employees through our People Team. **\#LI\-VP**
Who are we?:

HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower our customers to achieve better outcomes – from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely.  

At HERE we take it upon ourselves to be the change we wish to see. We create solutions that fuel innovation, provide opportunity and foster inclusion to improve people’s lives. If you are inspired by an open world and driven to create positive change, join us. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel.

Our innovative portfolio of solutions helps hospitals, clinics, and senior living organizations protect people, use their assets efficiently, and understand their operations for a caring and healing environment. jobs.description:
Runwise is looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) to help our rapidly scaling and mission\-driven sales team form even deeper relationships with the biggest names in Real Estate.


**The Team**



Runwise (www.runwise.com) is a fast\-paced, customer\-focused climate\-tech startup that controls and runs the key energy systems (heating, water, etc…) in 8,000\+ buildings throughout the US. Runwise's unique hardware and software service significantly reduces energy usage, substantially lowering costs and carbon output. As of today, Runwise's technology takes the equivalent of 100,000 cars worth of carbon emissions off the road each year.


**The Role**



As a BDR at Runwise, you will own a list of one hundred and fifty of the biggest names in Real Estate. Roughly half of these accounts will be existing customers, while the other half have not yet worked with us. Paired with a Senior Account Executive (who is an expert in the industry) you will be charged with getting Runwise in front of key accounts for portfolio expansion conversations and net new growth opportunities. As the conversations progress, you will support in putting together sales pitches, proposals, and pricing to drive a substantial portion of the company's revenue. BDRs will need to learn industry dynamics, organization structures, and the motivations of each buyer persona. BDRs need to know how to prospect for the right contacts strategically, break into complex organizations, and dynamically tailor the offering to drive decisions.



The right candidate is someone who is goal\-oriented, thinks out of the box, has strong presentation skills, and is highly organized. The right candidate can think a few steps ahead and can connect dots between accounts, contacts, and locations to act relationally. The right candidate can switch between calls, strategy and administrative work in an efficient manner.


**Responsibilities**


* Identify key players, analyze business cases for Runwise, and formulate a pitch
* Leverage a variety of data tools to locate contact information for an account
* Utilize calls, emails, and other creative tactics to connect with accounts
* Partner with a Senior Account Executives to make sure their pipeline continues to grow and deals move swiftly down the funnel
* Generate professional presentations and error free proposals on quick deadlines
* Maintain clean systems and gain proficiency in CRM (Salesforce), automated email tools (Outreach), lead gen tools, city databases, and excel.

**Qualifications**



This position requires an ambitious self\-starter and someone that can effectively connect with Senior level decision makers. Relationship selling skills, with the ability to make a compelling business case, are essential.


* 3\-5 years as an SDR, Account Manager or Account Executive.
* Exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, coupled with excellent listening skills and a positive and energetic phone presence.
* High level of integrity and an energetic commitment to building a successful company.
* Ability to work independently as well as partner with a Senior Account Executive in a fast\-paced environment.
* Adept computer skills including proficiency with LinkedIn, Google Suite.
* Experience with CRM applications preferred.


On Target Earning: **$115,000**


**What you believe:**


* No job is too small.
* Sincerity builds trust.
* Setbacks fuel progress.
* Efficiency is vital.


**Benefits:**


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* HSA \& FSA options
* Paid Parental Leave
* Access to Talkspace \& Health Advocate
* Flexible PTO
* Commuter Benefits
* 401K
* Company paid life insurance
* Voluntary supplemental life insurance
* Free in\-office lunch on Wednesdays
* Hybrid work environment

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Business Development Representative (BDR)**
=============================================

**Location:** Chicago, IL  

**Schedule:** Hybrid (minimum 3 days per week in our Chicago office)

**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a highly motivated Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing sales organization. This person will be on the front lines of our go\-to\-market motion, responsible for generating qualified opportunities for our sales team by engaging CFOs, GCs, Corporate Secretaries, Equity Administrators, and capital\-markets executives at some of the most innovative companies in the world.


You'll be responsible for creating qualified pipeline through thoughtful research, outreach, strong discovery, and clear communication. This is a Chicago\-based role, and candidates must be able to work in our Chicago office at least three days per week.

**Role Requirements**
---------------------

* Intrinsically motivated self\-starter, willing to do whatever it takes to be successful in growing Vinyl Equity
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; you ask precise questions and articulate complex ideas simply
* Ability to manage structured outbound outreach to senior executives (CFO, GC, Corporate Secretary, Equity Admin)
* Build and maintain a healthy top\-of\-funnel pipeline using targeted email, phone, LinkedIn, and industry research
* Comfort operating within a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment where processes evolve quickly
* Demonstrated discipline with CRM hygiene, follow\-up, and detailed documentation
* A growth mindset and willingness to iterate, learn, and improve daily
* Ability to collaborate closely with the sales team to support strategic deal cycles
* Represent Vinyl Equity with professionalism and industry fluency in every interaction
* Must be based in Chicago and able to be in\-office 3\+ days per week
* Bachelor's degree

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------

* Prior BDR or other customer\-facing experience
* Familiarity with HubSpot
* Experience selling into financial services, fintech, SaaS, or B2B enterprise accounts
* Exposure to equity management, corporate governance, or capital markets
* Experience at a high\-growth startup

**You could be a great fit if**
-------------------------------

* You communicate with clarity: succinct, direct, and confident with senior audiences
* You enjoy guiding prospects through the early stages of their buying process by identifying pain, impact, and urgency
* You are curious, intellectually engaged, and eager to become an expert in capital markets, equity operations, and compliance workflows
* You take pride in operational excellence, including precise CRM updates, tight follow\-ups, and well\-structured outreach sequences
* You're motivated by fast growth and excited by the pace, autonomy, and opportunity that comes with an early\-stage startup
* You bring persistence and grit, and you are energized by hitting ambitious pipeline goals
* You thrive in environments where creativity and problem\-solving are essential to success
* You're energized by the idea of helping introduce real innovation into an industry that has largely stood still for nearly three decades
* You're comfortable with (and thrive in) ambiguity. This role will be essential in defining how Vinyl goes to market, but will require agency to ensure that we take nothing for granted and leave no stones unturned. There is no concrete playbook for outbound sales in this industry. We're defining it.

**You may not be a great fit if**
---------------------------------

* You dislike prospecting. This role requires consistent outbound sourcing.
* You prefer to leave product knowledge to others. Our expectation is that our entire GTM team will develop deep product and market fluency.
* You resist structured documentation or CRM hygiene.
* You prefer slow\-changing environments or rigid process definitions.
* You are uncomfortable engaging senior executives early in the sales process.
* You prefer to fit into a structured commercial environment with predetermined outbound clarity.

**Our Philosophy**
------------------


A few principles that guide how we operate at Vinyl Equity:

* We value high\-agency ownership, first\-principled thinking, thoughtful communication, and a bias toward action
* We believe small, exceptionally talented teams outperform larger teams with average talent
* We aim to demonstrate both product and industry expertise in every interaction with prospects and customers
* Creativity, drive, innovation, and consistency win in otherwise stagnant industries
* Act with high integrity without compromise

**Compensation and Benefits (for U.S.\- based full\-time employees)**
---------------------------------------------------------------------

* Base: $50,000–$75,000
* OTE: $75,000–$95,000 (uncapped commission, paid quarterly)
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401k
* Flexible PTO
* Hybrid work schedule
* Equity\-based compensation

**Description**


The Customer Success Manager is responsible for managing a portfolio of CDW Lifecycle repair customers and serving as the primary connection between customers and internal teams. This role leads customer onboarding, supports day\-to\-day account management, monitors fleet and service performance, communicates proactively, identifies opportunities to improve value, and resolves or escalates issues to support customer satisfaction, retention, and long\-term success.

**What You Will Do:**

* Onboarding and Adoption: Lead onboarding of new customers to services engagements. Host kickoff meetings to validate scope, set expectations, and demonstrate use of the software application. Guide customers through product and service adoption to support intended use and value realization.
* Account Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts. Build and maintain productive working relationships with customer stakeholders. Coordinate with internal teams to address customer needs, questions, and issues. Proactively communicate updates, risks, and next steps to internal and external stakeholders.
* Customer Health and Retention: Monitor KPIs and customer sentiment daily. Identify risks, address issues, and escalate where needed to support customer retention.
* Data, Reporting, and Reviews: Compile and share weekly reports with relevant data points, including insights from internal systems, escalated tickets, and service\-related issues. Conduct regular account meetings focused on performance, open items, and areas for improvement.
* Renewals and Growth Support: Partner with the sales team to support contract renewals. Identify opportunities for additional products or services aligned to customer needs and usage.
* Customer Feedback and Continuous Improvement: Gather, document, and follow up on customer feedback. Share trends and insights with internal teams to support service and product improvements. Provide customers with feedback and recommendations to improve fleet sustainability.
* Tools and Systems: Maintain working knowledge of company products, systems, and processes. Track tasks, update status, and provide daily updates in an internal work tracking system. Use tools such as Salesforce, Power BI, Excel, Repair Engine, Trainual, and other systems as required to manage accounts and reporting.
* Internal Collaboration \& Mentoring: Collaborate with Customer Success Managers and Project Managers on various initiatives related to Customer Success. Guide and mentor other Customer Success Managers to elevate individual and team competency.

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in customer service, customer success, or customer\-facing project management; technology\-related experience preferred.

jobs.description:
Welcome to Gordon Food Service! We are excited that you are thinking about opportunities with us, and we have an amazing story to share. See below for a quick glance of who we are and the impact you could have on the food service industry. There's a seat at our table for you...


**Overview**

For over 125 years, Gordon Food Service has delivered the excellence, expertise, and quality products our customers need to design successful food operations and experiences. We've grown to be the largest family\-operated broadline food distribution company in North America by being passionately committed to the people we serve.


At Gordon Food Service, our customers come first. As an Outside Food Sales Representative, you will cultivate relationships, develop new business, and provide innovative solutions to our customers, helping them to achieve their goals and, in return, yours!


**This position will reside in: Downtown Chicago**

**Position Benefits**

* Salary Range: $60,000 \- $85,000 (based on experience)
* A generous 401(k) matching program that is above industry standards
* Financial rewards for performance compensation structure which includes salary, commission, and bonuses
* Low\-cost benefit options for you and your family's health and future
* An Automobile expense reimbursement plan
* Cell phone reimbursement plan

**Outside Food Sales Representative**

We invite you to join our sales team where you’ll experience a world where servant leadership and cutting\-edge tools and training come together to support your career growth and financial objectives.


As an Outside Food Sales Representative, you’ll be responsible for the overall sales and relationship management efforts for existing and prospective customers within your assigned territory. This includes pursuing new customers, deepening and strengthening existing customer relationships, and sales territory management.


**Pursuing New Customers**

* Researching industry and market trends impacting restaurants within your territory
* Identifying and researching prospective customers within your territory
* Developing sales strategies that highlight products, services, values, and solutions offered by Gordon Food Service and presenting the sales strategy to prospective customers

**Deepen and Strengthen Existing Customer Relationships**

* Visiting all customers within the assigned territory on a weekly, bi\-weekly, or monthly basis
* Conducting business reviews to determine existing customers needs and areas of opportunity for growing sales
* Providing ongoing training to customers on Gordon Food Service product offerings
* Identifying opportunities within existing customers businesses where Gordon Food Service can add value through product and service offerings

**Sales Territory Management**

* Balancing new customers acquisition and deepening and strengthening existing customer relationships
* Coordinating visits to prospective customers and existing customers
* Communicating order status and order processing updates to customers

**Sales Training \- Getting you Ready**

Gordon Food Service’s goal during your first 90 days is to set you up for success! This includes engaging you in various training offerings, including e\-learning, classroom sessions, video roleplays, job shadowing, and peer sales representative mentorship. Throughout your first 90 days, you will learn:


* How to use Gordon Food Service systems, processes, and tools to manage customer relationships
* About the products available to Gordon Food Service customers
* The sales process for engaging new customers
* How to establish your relationships in the vast network of resources available to you, a Gordon Food Service sales representative
* Best practices on developing relationships with current and prospective customers
* Strategies on how to effectively manage your territory

**Position Requirements**

* **Bilingual in Spanish required**
* High School Diploma/GED is required
* Bachelor's degree and/or culinary certificate preferred
* 1 year of prior sales, business, or food service experience
* Maintaining a valid state driver's license and a safe driving record

Gordon Food Service encourages v eterans and active military members to apply.


**BE PART OF AN AMAZING CULTURE WHERE WHAT MATTERS TO YOU, MATTERS TO US!**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Gordon Food Service values our customers and understands that their success is largely dependent upon their workforce. To demonstrate our commitment to our partnership, we will require any candidate who works for a Gordon Food Service customer to provide a letter of support from their management if they are selected for the interview process.


Equal Employment Opportunity is a matter of policy at Gordon Food Service, Inc. and we are committed to a work environment in which all individuals are treated with respect and dignity.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or status as a qualified individual with disability. If you require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process due to a disability, please submit your request to talent@gfs.com and use the words “Accommodation Request” in your subject line.


All Gordon Food Service locations are tobacco\-free.


Gordon Food Service is a drug\-free workplace and conducts pre\-employment drug tests.

jobs.description:
About Us: Paychex is reimagining how businesses manage their workforce by bringing payroll, HR, benefits, and advisory services together into a single connected HCM platform. As Paychex and Paycor come together, we're combining innovative technology, data\-driven insights, AI, and human expertise to help organizations work smarter, support their people, and achieve better business outcomes. This is an exciting time to join our team as we continue to invest in innovation, simplify client experiences, and shape the future of work. At Paychex, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and be part of something bigger as One Paychex. Overview:

We're looking for a data\-driven Paid Media \& Analytics Specialist to own the day\-to\-day management of our paid advertising program in partnership with our media agency. This person will be the internal point person for a $10M\+ annual paid media investment spanning Google, Meta, LinkedIn, StackAdapt, and other platforms — holding the agency accountable for performance, building the reporting that shows what's working, and translating data into recommendations that lower our cost to acquire a customer. This is an individual contributor role reporting directly into marketing leadership, ideal for someone who is as comfortable in a spreadsheet or dashboard as they are on a call pushing an agency for a clearer answer.


Responsibilities:
* Serve as the primary internal owner of the agency relationship — briefing, reviewing plans, and holding the team accountable for performance across paid search, paid social, and programmatic/display (Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, StackAdapt/CM360, and emerging channels).
* Manage and help optimize a $10M\+ annual paid media budget in collaboration with the agency, ensuring efficient pacing, channel mix, and return on ad spend.
* Build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting (HubSpot, GA4, platform\-native tools) that track CAC, channel efficiency, funnel conversion, and budget pacing against goal.
* Dig into campaign\- and channel\-level data to spot optimization opportunities and risks — creative fatigue, measurement inflation, broken tracking or conversion feeds, budget concentration — and turn findings into clear recommendations.
* Partner with the agency on quarterly and annual planning, audits, and new\-channel tests, and help stand up measurement as our CDP and media mix model (Google Meridian) come online.
* Stay current on platform updates, betas, and best practices across all managed channels, bringing forward opportunities to test and scale.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with sales, product marketing, and marketing operations to keep paid media strategy aligned with company\-wide CAC reduction and growth targets.
* Maintain data integrity across ad platforms, CRM, and reporting tools, flagging and resolving tracking or attribution gaps.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing or another relatable field \- Preferred
* 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in paid media / digital advertising, in\-house or agency\-side, with direct platform experience across Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager; programmatic/DSP experience (StackAdapt or similar) strongly preferred.
* Strong data analysis skills: advanced Excel/Google Sheets required; experience building or maintaining dashboards (HubSpot, GA4, Looker, Tableau, or similar) required; SQL a plus.
* Experience managing or directly contributing to paid media budgets of $5M\+ annually.
* Track record of managing external agency or vendor relationships and holding them accountable to KPIs.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted analytics or reporting tools used to improve marketing productivity.
* Working knowledge of B2B or SMB SaaS acquisition funnels and core metrics (CAC, LTV, conversion rate, ROAS).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to translate data into a clear point of view for non\-analytics stakeholders.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, metrics\-driven environment with shifting priorities.
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, analytics, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


Compensation: In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share that the base pay range for this position is $79,400 \- $124,700 per year. Please keep in mind that this range is the base pay only and does not consider other components that make up the total rewards package for the position. If you are hired at Paychex, your overall compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience which may result in total compensation outside of this range. Live the Paychex Values:
* Act with uncompromising integrity.


* Provide outstanding service and build trusted relationships.


* Drive innovation in our products and services and continually improve our processes.


* Work in partnership and support each other.


* Be personally accountable and deliver on commitments.


* Treat each other with respect and dignity.


What's in it for you?:
* We value your well\-being: We provide over 21 comprehensive rewards, including medical coverage, virtual wellness classes, tuition reimbursement, 401(k) \+ employer match, adoption assistance, financial assistance, and much more.
* We value your time: From paid time off to company holidays, culture days, and comprehensive work\-life balance programs, we will ensure you have the flexibility you need to be your best.
* We value your development: Our award\-winning training and development programs empower our employees with ongoing learning opportunities to give you the building blocks to grow your career.
* We value your perspective: Our company culture reflects the diversity of our employees. We want you to be you and your voice to be heard.
* We value our communities: We offer paid time

**Company Description** **About AbbVie**


At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/. Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.

 **Job Description** **Marketing Coordinator, Promotions**

**Role**


The Promotions team is dedicated to bringing all consumer offers to life for the Allergan Aesthetics portfolio of products.


The marketing coordinator, promotions will be responsible for the development, management and execution of consumer promotions to attract, engage, and retain patients.


You will be both highly organized, strategic and detail oriented, producing large consumer promotions on\-time. You’ll need to anticipate bottlenecks and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. You’ll be able to coordinate and communicate with agencies, internal stakeholders, brand leads, and tech partners. You can also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done.

**Responsibilities**


Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Promotions, the focus of this position will be to ensure brand positioning and strategic imperatives are executed through promotions and to ensure all initiatives meet specific business needs in a timely manner. To ensure projects are optimized and achieving portfolio goals, the marketing coordinator will:

* Ensure Consumer Promotions runs smoothly by efficiently and effectively completing all necessary steps from approvals, through execution, and reporting.
* Partnering with Brand teams in creative development and review of promotion related assets.
* Collaborate with internal teams: Brand, CRM, Paid Media, MLRC, Product, Engineering, Sales Training, Commercial Directors, Customer Service, and Reps
* Manage and route Finance approval and allowance forms.
* Coordinate with Data \& Analytics teams to properly target and set up reporting for proper measurement:
* Ensure MADI, Insights, \& Tableau reporting are successfully in place for all campaigns
* Creation of promotions in the OfferBuilder system.
* Attend status meetings with internal and external agencies and cross\-functional partners.
* Prepare and submit materials for medical, legal, regulatory and compliance reviews. Including annotating documents and creating anchor text for references.
* Work hand\-in\-hand with Project Managers to capture notes and determine next steps coming out of cross functional project status.
* Maintain promotion logs and folders for promotion management and tracking
* Prepare performance reports post promotion.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Essential Skills, Experience, and Competencies**

* Self\-Starter who proactively seeks solutions to ensure positive outcomes and on\-time deliverables.
* Strong organizations skills with the ability to multi\-task various projects simultaneously.
* Excels administratively and is proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Apps, tracking and monitoring budgets, promotions, and deliverables.
* Keen marketing sense and thrives in an environment where project ownership is encouraged.
* Team player who can step in as needed on ad hoc requests and collaborate cross\-functionally with various departments to include Brand, Education, Digital/Social, and Field Sales.
* Flexible and easily adapts to change.

  

**Qualifications**  

Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree is required in a related field of study
* 5\+ years of marketing experience with a growing level of responsibility
* Agency experience or background helpful
* Experience with pharmaceuticals, medical device products, beauty is a plus
* Knowledge of basic marketing strategies
* Excellent project management and communication skills
* Experience with JIRA, Figma, Workfront, Airtable, Slack, SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint is preferred
* Design or copywriting skills a plus

  

**Additional Information**

Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.

* This job is eligible to participate in our short\-term incentive programs.

new_jobs.description:
Role Name: Lead Recruiting Coordinator


Department: Talent


Location: San Carlos


Shift:


### **About 1X**


We’re building humanoid robots that work in home \- doing the chores, handling the tasks, and giving people their time back. Simple, but it’s not.


To do this right, we have to solve robotics, AI, manufacturing \- at the same time, at scale, in a form factor that has to be safe enough to live with your family. If you’re inspired by this, you’ll thrive here. We’ve been at this since 2014 and we’re at the point where the hard problems are behind us and the *hard work* is in front of us.


NEO is our flagship \- a home robot designed to move, learn, and operate in the real world alongside real people. We’re not demoing it \- we’re shipping it. We’re excited to meet you, if this excites you.


If you’ve spent your career working on problems that matter and want to see them actually reach the world \- this is that moment. We’re scaling, we’re hiring with intention, and we need people who want to build something that will genuinely change how humans spend their time \- safely creating abundance for all.

### **About the Team:**


The Talent team hires the people who build NEO: robotics, AI, manufacturing, and the teams that support them. Recruiting Coordination is the operating layer of that work. Every interview, every candidate touchpoint, and every record in Ashby runs through this team, so when coordination is excellent, 1X hires faster and candidates leave every conversation wanting to work here.

### **Your Charter:**


The mission of this role is to give a seamless experience during every interview, and to make the coordination function faster every quarter. You are one of two Lead Recruiting Coordinators. Each of you owns half of the hiring org end to end, from scheduling and candidate communication to data integrity in Ashby. You lead by setting the standard for quality and speed, and by being the person the team turns to when something breaks. Hiring speed is on 1X’s critical path, and this role is where that speed is won or lost day to day.

### **Key Outcomes:**

* Own end\-to\-end interview scheduling for executive and high\-volume roles in your half of the org, delivered without errors, with last\-minute conflicts resolved quickly and calmly.
* Deliver consistently high satisfaction scores from candidates and hiring managers through transparent, timely communication with every interview participant.
* Drive down time\-to\-schedule and time\-to\-feedback by identifying bottlenecks in the hiring workflow and implementing automation for scheduling and feedback collection.
* Optimize and iterate the coordination team’s playbooks and training guides so every coordinator runs the same process and new hires ramp fast.
* Lead as the escalation point for daily operational issues in your half of the org, setting the bar for quality and speed across the coordination team, and keep Ashby complete and current as the single source of truth for every open role.

### **Key Competencies:**

* Handles confidential candidates, compensation, and offer information with total accuracy and discretion.
* Stays calm and decisive when a schedule breaks an hour before the interview, and fixes it without creating noise for the candidate or the panel.
* Thinks in systems: sees a repeated problem and fixes the process, not only the instance.
* Communicates clearly and proactively with executives, hiring managers, and candidates, in writing and live.
* Sets a high standard and holds peers to it without direct authority.

### **Minimum Requirements:**

* 7\+ years of recruiting coordination experience, including scheduling for executive or high\-volume roles
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi\-participant interview schedules without errors
* Experience with an applicant tracking system as the system of record for hiring
* Proven track record of being the escalation point for a coordination or operations team

### **Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in Ashby
* Experience in implementing scheduling automation or workflow tooling, such as ATS integrations or no\-code automations
* Exposure to writing team playbooks, standard operating procedures, or training documentation
* Familiarity with hiring for hardware, robotics, or AI teams

### **What does a successful 1X Team Member look like:**


Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it’s the one thing you can’t get back \- because it is. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect.

### **Compensation Range:**


$100,000 \- $125,000

### **Benefits:**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Generous paid time off, company holidays, and parental leave
* 401(k) plan with company match (100% on the first 3% of contributions, 50% on the next 2%)
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) options
* Commuter benefits (transit and parking)
* Short\-term and long\-term disability, and life insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health, financial, and personal support
* Onsite snacks and catered lunches

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**


1X is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, disability, military or veteran status, justice system impact, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

new_jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator (fixed-term)
new_jobs.description:
### **The Role**



You'll own the interview coordination process and candidate experience from the first phone call through the final onsite, ensuring every applicant moves through our talent pipeline smoothly and professionally.



In a fast\-moving hiring environment, you'll rely on your organizational skills, knowledge of team priorities, and relationships across the business to manage complex schedules and unscripted demands with a calm, collected demeanor.


**This is a full\-time, non\-exempt, fixed\-term position (expected length of 6 months) based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.** **Note: the expected start time for this role is between 7\-8 AM PT to help support our EST\-based offices and interviewing needs.**


### **What you'll do...**


* Schedule panel and onsite interviews across our offices based on well\-defined interview plans.
* Become a power user in our scheduling tool (ModernLoop) and applicant tracking system (Greenhouse) to accurately turn around scheduling requests in a timely manner.
* Partner directly with our recruiters and hiring managers across the business to ensure candidates move through our recruiting process in a delightful and efficient manner.
* Use documented interview plans to schedule candidates for their next touchpoints in our hiring process.
* Welcome candidates onsite and give them tours of our Oakland HQ, providing an exceptional candidate experience, representing Everlaw's values and culture.

### **About you**


* You have 6\+ months of experience in recruiting or recruiting coordination, supporting high\-volume hiring or complex recruiting processes across different departments.
* You have hands\-on experience with the ModernLoop scheduling platform and Greenhouse applicant tracking system (ATS)
* You communicate clearly, quickly, and professionally with candidates, hiring managers, and recruiters.
* You are highly organized and thrive on managing multiple tasks, schedules, and priorities simultaneously.
* You have experience using Google Suite and intermediate knowledge of how to maintain and utilize basic spreadsheet functionality.
* You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role.


Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.


### **The Team \- Recruiting**



The Recruiting team builds the teams that advance Everlaw's mission by connecting exceptional, diverse talent with meaningful work. It partners across the company to define what success looks like, attract strong candidates, and support fair, evidence\-based hiring decisions. This work strengthens a scalable, quality\-focused hiring engine that raises talent density while delivering a candidate experience worthy of Everlaw's award\-winning culture.


### **Total Rewards \& Benefits**


* The expected hourly range for this role is $38\.47 \- $48\.56, actual salary will be determined based on factors including the candidate's experience and skills. This role is eligible for the benefits below.

#### **Health \& wellness**


* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses
* Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness
* Paid parental leave
* Company\-sponsored life and disability insurance

#### **Financial rewards**


* 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

#### **Growth \& everyday perks**


* An accrual of 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave
* Hybrid work with regular work\-from\-home days and flexibility for life's logistics
* Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup
* Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company\-wide events in our offices

### **About Everlaw**



When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.



We're the kind of place that's ranked \#1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career\-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upside at a company in control of its own destiny, we'd love to get to know you.


* \#PR1
* \#LI\-Hybrid


About Everlaw

*At Everlaw, you'll shape how AI re\-wires the legal industry, at a category\-leading business built on a mission to illuminate the truth.*



Everlaw is an equal opportunity employer. We pride ourselves on having a diverse workforce and we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. We respect the gender, gender identity and gender expression of our applicants and employees, and we honor requests for pronouns. It is our policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity, including the California Equal Pay Act. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and convic
