new_jobs.description:
Represent an exceptional lineup of world‑class spirits, beer, and wine — build relationships, grow market share, and elevate your sales career with Reyes Beverage Group.* **Portfolio:** Modelo, Coors Light, Lagunitas, with a special concentration on our Spirits and Wine portfolio with brands like Gallo, Tito's, Jack Daniels, as well as our Sazerac portfolios.
* **Schedule**: Monday – Friday. No Weekends.
* Family‑owned company with **50 years of stability and growth**.
* Values‑driven culture focused on **integrity, teamwork, and accountability**.
* Ongoing **training and development** to support long‑term sales success.
* Competitive **pay with incentive opportunities**, 401(k) match, full health benefits, and generous PTO.
* Field sales roles include **monthly MOTUS car \& mileage reimbursement**.

 **Position Responsibilities:*** Achieve sales goals within assigned timeframes that meet monthly business objectives while actively acquiring new business and maintaining established distribution
* Accomplish timely and productive execution of sales plans and promotions at retail, securing trade support by communicating pricing and product promotions, coordinating use of product displays and point\-of\-sale materials, promotional events and other product promotion opportunities
* Maintain compliance with Quality Control and product code date standards
* Plan and conduct regular sales visits to accounts
* Manage accurate inventory levels to minimize out\-of\-stock and out\-of\-code issues
* Monitor product placement and rotation in both selling and storage areas to ensure freshness and maximize shelf impact
* Other projects or duties as assigned
 **Required Education and Experience:*** Bachelor's Degree with 0 to 2 years of related experience or High School Diploma/General Education Diploma with 3 to 5 plus years of specific experience
* Must be at least 21 years of age or meet minimum state legal age requirements.
* Must have reliable automobile transportation, maintain an acceptable driving record and valid driver license, and maintain auto insurance coverage at least to the minimum amount specified by the Company and state law.
* The employee must be able to lift products from 25 lbs. to 50 lbs. on a regular basis and up to 175 lbs. when handling keg product.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Account Manager**
===================

  

**Date:** Sep 15, 2026


**Location:** San Jose, California, United States


**Company:** Super Micro Computer


**Job Req ID: 30194**
---------------------


**About Supermicro:**
---------------------


Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the \#5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.  

  



**Job Summary:**
----------------


Supermicro Computer is looking for an Account Manager who has experience with selling technical solutions and developing business. The ideal candidate must also have a proven track record in winning enterprise level relationships and consistently achieving and exceeding assigned sales quotas.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
------------------------------------------


* Manage products through their entire lifecycle until product EOL


* Develop strategic sales goals with exceptional execution to meet the sales target


* Qualify leads and creating target lists of enterprise or data center accounts


* Seek potential customers (e.g., Corporate Customers, Value\-Added Resellers, OEMs) through cold calling and follow\-up customer visits


* Participate in marketing activities such as trade shows to generate leads


* Ability to strategically positioned Supermicro’s products and services in the market


* Develop customer relationships and maintain/manage accounts, expand existing client accounts for retention and potential growth


* Work with cross functional teams to draft and negotiate various types of contracts


* Manage day\-to\-day sales operations


* Negotiate sales pricing, monitoring orders, facilitating credit issues and negotiating sales returns

  

**Qualifications:**
-------------------


* Bachelor degree in business, engineering or similar fields preferred
* 1\-2 years of hands\-on experience with selling computer hardware solutions to data center or enterprise accounts (prior software or telecom sales will be considered) preferred
* Successful track record with credible cold calling and follow\-up with key decision makers
* Ability to thrive both independently and in a team environment
* Demonstrated ability in the following areas: pre\-call planning, opportunity qualification and objection handling, call structure and control, time and territory management
* Strong persuasive and negotiating skills; Ability to polished words in verbal, written, and presentation
* Extremely proactive, highly organized, with proven ability to manage multiple tasks
* Exceptional management skill in time and territory

  

**Salary Range**
----------------


$72,500 \- $104,000


The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.


**EEO Statement**
-----------------


Supermicro is an Equal Opportunity Employer and embraces diversity in our employee population. It is the policy of Supermicro to provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

new_jobs.title: Regional Account Manager - West
new_jobs.description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY:**


Clean Harbors is seeking a Regional Account Manager to support the Retail Market Segment across the Western United States as part of the Technical Services Regional Account Sales team. This role is responsible for developing and growing strategic relationships with regional retail customers while expanding Clean Harbors' market presence throughout an assigned territory including strategic vision and execution of critical programs that develop and deepen our relationships within regional retail customers. The Regional Account Manager will identify new business opportunities, expand existing customer relationships, increase share of wallet, and position Clean Harbors as the preferred environmental services partner across all aspects of a retail customer’s operations.


\*\*\*Applicants may live anywhere in the US and should be no more than one hour from a major Airport\*\*\*

**Why work for Clean Harbors?**

* Health and Safety is our \#1 priority, and we live it 3\-6\-5!
* Competitive wages
* Comprehensive health benefits coverage after 30 days of full\-time employment
* Group 401K/RRSP with company matching component
* Generous paid time off, company paid training and tuition reimbursement
* Positive and safe work environments
* Opportunities for growth and development for all the stages of your career

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Ensuring that Health and Safety is the number one priority by complying with all safe work practices, policies, and processes and always acting in a safe manner.
* Develop and implement strategic sales plans for Regional Accounts to support the Company in achieving profitable revenue growth (e.g., detailed revenue potential estimates for all sites, analysis of decision processes and key players, understanding our critical stakeholders, and weekly plans for activity and revenue growth for each account).
* Leverage professional network, current client relationships, and prospect leads to develop new business opportunities.
* Develop and advance a solid and trusting relationship between clients and the company, mapping client organizations and focusing on decision makers with varying buyer motivations.
* Develop a complete understanding of a Regional Account’s needs, understand market drivers and forces, ensure appropriate service and/or product delivery and pricing, and communicate concisely and effectively to achieve mutual goals.
* Use insight and consultative selling techniques to coach customer stakeholders and build consensus for Clean Harbors/Safety\-Kleen’s solutions within their organization.
* Anticipate the Regional Account’s changes, adjusting and adapting accordingly.
* Manage communications between business stakeholders and internal teams.
* Negotiate contracts with the Regional Account, establish a timeline of performance, and deliver predictable results.
* Establish and oversee internal budgets with the company and external budgets with the Regional Account.
* Plan and present reports on each account’s progress, goals, and quarterly initiatives; Utilize executive presence and influence to drive consensus and bias\-to\-action with internal and external.
* Meet all account’s needs and deliverables according to proposed timelines, contracts, and agreements.
* Proactively resolve customer issues and complaints.
* Analyze customer data, working cross\-functionally with support teams, deepen customer relationship management through valuable insights and action plans.
* Deepen existing business relationships by continuing to increase the account’s satisfaction with ownership of contractual service requirements, follow up with service delivery and deliver ever\-improving customer service.
* Understand account profitability, value, and potential to inform strategy that maximizes profit, increases market share, and keeps the company as the provider of choice.

**Key Priorities:**

**Regional Business Development**

* Develop and execute growth plans for assigned regional retail customers.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer operations and identify new opportunities across service lines to better support their business.
* Expand share of wallet by introducing additional Clean Harbors service lines.
* Develop new regional retail prospects and convert them into long\-term customers.

 **Customer Relationship Management**

* Build relationships with corporate, regional, and field\-level decision makers.
* Conduct regular business reviews with assigned customers.
* Develop customer account plans identifying growth opportunities and strategic priorities.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction through proactive communication and issue resolution.

**Cross\-Functional Sales Leadership**

* Coordinate internal resources across Safety\-Kleen, Environmental Services, Field Services, Emergency Response, and Operations.
	+ Partner with local Account Managers to identify opportunities to expand across multiple customer locations.
	+ Support regional contract renewals and competitive bid opportunities.
	+ Maintain accurate opportunity management and forecasting within Salesforce.

**Commercial Strategy**

* Support regional pricing strategies and commercial proposals.
	+ Review historical pricing, competitive positioning, and customer trends to improve win rates.
	+ Negotiate service agreements and pricing within established commercial guidelines.

* Bachelor’s Degree with a preference toward those in Sales, Marketing, Business, or related fields.
* Minimum 5 years relevant **Retail or Environmental Services industry** experience, as high level “C” sales development and management or combination of relevant experience in the industry.

* Proven track record of developing and executing sales strategies; target customer selection, sales processes, account development, and multi\-tiered relationship building.

new_jobs.title: Strategic Business Operations Lead, API
new_jobs.description:
Perplexity's API Platform brings our work in AI, search, and agent orchestration to developers. Our customers range from AI\-native startups to some of the world's largest technology companies. Working with them, alongside our own developments in building Perplexity’s core application gives our team direct exposure to how search, models, and tools are used to build and scale AI\-native products and applications.


**About this role**
-------------------


We are looking for a Strategic Business Operations Lead to manage customer relationships and lead projects that help grow the API business. The role is roughly half customer\-facing and half strategic and operational work, with an initial focus on building and improving our post\-sale programs.


You will own a portfolio of API customers, learning how AI\-native companies and large enterprises evaluate, adopt, and scale AI infrastructure. Working closely with API leadership, you will help shape how the business operates and lead projects such as product migrations, customer enablement, and account coverage. You will put recommendations into practice, with results measured in customer adoption, retention, and growth.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Manage a portfolio of API customer relationships, leading account conversations, understanding business priorities, and coordinating next steps across technical and commercial teams.
* Build account plans around adoption, value, and growth. Identify risks early and partner with Sales and account owners on renewals and expansion.
* Design and improve the post\-sale operating model, including customer segmentation, account coverage, onboarding, health signals, and handoffs between teams.
* Lead strategic projects across the API business, with an initial emphasis on customer adoption and retention. Scope the problem, develop a recommendation, coordinate execution, and track outcomes.
* Run customer programs such as product and endpoint migrations, enablement, and rollout communications. Establish the audience, milestones, internal responsibilities, and follow\-up needed for each.
* Coordinate customer communications for product updates, pricing changes, deprecations, and incidents, working with Engineering, Support, and commercial teams on accurate messaging.
* Analyze usage, consumption against commitments, renewal risk, and expansion signals to prioritize customer engagement and inform business decisions.
* Build practical reporting, workflows, and automation that help the team manage a growing customer base. Partner with Finance and Billing Operations to improve the customer experience around credits, commitments, and billing.
* Bring insights from customers into API planning and take on additional strategic initiatives as business priorities evolve.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


* 5\+ years of experience in business operations, strategy and operations, consulting, customer success, account management, or a related role.
* A track record of taking ambiguous business problems from analysis through implementation, including projects that require coordination across multiple teams.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable working with spreadsheets, usage data, and business metrics to identify a problem, test a hypothesis, and recommend an action.
* Strong relationship skills and a genuine interest in spending a substantial part of your time with customers. You can lead a conversation, understand their priorities, and take responsibility for the follow\-up.
* Curiosity about APIs and AI products, with the ability to learn technical concepts and work effectively with engineering teams.
* Clear writing, commercial judgment, and the ability to balance ongoing customer relationships with longer\-term projects.

**Nice to have**
----------------


* Direct customer\-facing experience in a B2B technology company, including account management, customer success, partnerships, or solutions work.
* Experience with API businesses, developer platforms, or consumption\-based revenue models.
* Working knowledge of SQL, CRM systems, or BI tools, and experience automating recurring analysis or workflows.

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category


Sales
Job Details


**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


**The Opportunity**

As a Qualified Business Development Representative, you will support the Qualified sales effort in multiple functions while developing your skills as a future Account Executive. You'll be hands\-on with the Qualified platform every\-day and the one who will interface within prospects in both an inbound and outbound fashion. You'll be setting an example and showcasing the future of B2B sales and marketing.  



  

Your daily responsibilities will include the prospecting and sourcing of potential decision\-makers, outbound lead generation, leading qualification phone meetings, and facilitating the closing of deals by leveraging the Qualified knowledge base. You will create an excellent first impression for prospective customers over multiple channels, including email, phone, and social. You will work closely with the sales and marketing teams, corresponding with customers and driving Qualified’s message to the market.


**What You'll Be Doing**

* Engage with potential prospects over email and phone to qualify and set appointments for the account executives
* Identify target customers through email, phone, and social channels
* Maintain active engagement with leads through informed, creative follow\-ups
* Research and develop prospective accounts
* Work closely with account executives to identify qualified accounts and define strategies for outreach
* Utilize the Qualified software to engage customers in real time
* Partner with marketing to deliver proper messaging and identify the best target market segments
* Achieve quarterly quotas for developed leads and closed business

**Qualifications:**

new_jobs.title: Finance & Business Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Latent**


Latent is building the clinical agentic engine for enterprise pharmacy—software that enables leading health systems to serve more patients, grow their pharmacy operations, and capture more value compliantly, without adding headcount. We are a fast\-moving team looking for thoughtful, ambitious people who want to help build both the business and the systems behind it.

**The Opportunity**


Latent is hiring a Finance \& Business Operations Manager to own the systems that keep the company running: our books, our billing, our spend, our insurance, and our payroll and expense operations. You will be the person who makes sure money moves accurately, on time, and with the right controls behind it.


This is a hands\-on ownership role, not an oversight role. You will work in QuickBooks, Brex, and Rippling directly, and you will design the policies and processes around them. You will partner closely with our strategic finance function—they build the model and the forecast; you own the operational reality that feeds it.


On any given day, you might reconcile a month\-end account, issue a batch of customer invoices, chase a receivable, review expense reports, renegotiate a software renewal, or work through an insurance renewal with our broker.

**What You’ll Do**

**Accounting and the books**

* Own day\-to\-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online, including categorization, reconciliations, and chart\-of\-accounts hygiene
* Run or support month\-end close, including accruals, prepaids, and account reconciliations
* Keep financial records accurate, organized, and audit\-ready
* Maintain the chart of accounts, classes, and departments so reporting stays meaningful as we grow
* Coordinate with external accounting, bookkeeping, and tax partners

**Invoicing and accounts receivable**

* Own customer invoicing end to end, including recurring, milestone, and usage\-based billing
* Ensure invoices are accurate, properly coded, and issued on schedule
* Track receivables, follow up on outstanding balances, and manage collections
* Resolve billing questions and discrepancies with customers and internal stakeholders
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success so contract terms flow correctly into billing

**Accounts payable, corporate cards, and spend management**

* Administer Brex: card issuance, spend limits, approval flows, receipt compliance, and reporting
* Review vendor bills for accuracy, proper approval, and correct coding
* Manage payment runs, track payment status, and resolve vendor discrepancies
* Own vendor onboarding, renewals, purchasing workflows, and contract records
* Maintain visibility into software subscriptions and other recurring commitments, and identify savings opportunities
* Evaluate vendors and negotiate commercial terms
* Partner with budget owners to ensure purchases are appropriate, approved, and within budget

**Personnel expense and payroll operations**

* Own employee expense management: policy, submission workflows, review, and reimbursement
* Support payroll processing in Rippling, including off\-cycle runs, and ensure accurate GL mapping into QuickBooks
* Maintain employee records and support onboarding, offboarding, and benefits administration workflows
* Serve as the first point of contact for employee questions on expenses, reimbursements, and payroll
* Partner with People and leadership so compensation changes flow correctly into payroll and the books
* Handle confidential compensation and employee data with consistently sound judgment

**Insurance and business administration**

* Own company business insurance: renewals, broker relationships, coverage reviews, and certificate\-of\-insurance requests
* Ensure coverage keeps pace with headcount, customer contracts, and our risk profile
* Maintain corporate records, state registrations, and business licenses
* Support customer and partner requests for insurance, tax, and compliance documentation

**Building the operations function**

* Identify manual or inefficient processes and replace them with better systems and controls
* Document financial and operational policies, approval thresholds, and operating procedures
* Help select and implement finance and operations tools as the company grows
* Take ownership of new operational priorities as they arise

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–6 years of experience in accounting operations, finance operations, business operations, or startup G\&A
* Hands\-on ownership of QuickBooks Online or a comparable general ledger—not just reviewing someone else’s work
* Direct experience running accounts payable, accounts receivable, and expense workflows
* Familiarity with corporate card and spend platforms (Brex, Ramp, or similar) and HR/payroll systems (Rippling, Gusto, Justworks, or similar)
* Excellent attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy
* Advanced proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets
* Strong organizational and project\-management skills, with comfort owning recurring deadlines
* Clear, thoughtful communication with colleagues, vendors, and external partners
* A proactive, low\-ego approach and willingness to take ownership
* Comfort operating in a fast\-changing environment with incomplete information

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working at an early\-stage or rapidly growing technology company
* Experience through a full month\-end close, an audit, or a finance systems migration
* Experience managing business insurance renewals or working directly with brokers
* Exposure to multi\-state payroll and payroll compliance
* Experience with procurement or spend\-management systems
* Interest in healthcare, pharmacy operations, or health technology

**What Success Looks Like**


Within your first year, you will have:

* Closed the books accurately on a predictable monthly cadence
* Made invoicing and collections run on schedule, with receivables actively managed
* Given company leaders clear visibility into vendor spend, subscriptions, and card activit

At White Swan Bridal, we believe every bride deserves a warm, elevated, and unforgettable experience from the moment she walks through our doors.

We are looking for a full\-time **Client Experience Coordinator** to be the welcoming face and voice of our boutique. This role is essential in creating a seamless, organized, and beautiful experience for both our brides and our team, while also supporting our day\-to\-day social media presence.

**Role and Responsibilities**

* Follow up on order statuses and ensure clear communication with both vendors and brides
* Help maintain accuracy and organization across all order\-related information
* Print and attach tags to new gowns
* Maintain store cleanliness and presentation throughout the day

**Weekend Support**

* Float between front desk and sales floor
* Reset fitting rooms and assist with dress care
* Help maintain a smooth, elevated experience during busy appointments

**We’re Looking For Someone Who Is**

* Available to work every weekend (Saturdays and Sundays)
* Naturally warm, welcoming, and professional
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented
* Calm and composed in a fast\-paced environment
* A strong communicator (in person, phone, written, and digital)
* Comfortable managing brand communication across social media
* Has an eye for visual presentation and content
* Takes initiative and enjoys supporting a team

**Qualifications**

* Previous experience in retail, hospitality, or other client\-facing roles preferred
* Comfortable using computers and technology in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong written communication skills (email, messaging, and social media)
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Ability to learn and adapt quickly to new systems (experience with CRM platforms such as Cloud Bridal is a plus)
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail
* **Must be available to work weekends**

**Schedule \& Compensation**

* Full\-time (40 hours per week) \- Weekends are a must!
* Hourly: $16–$19/hour (based on experience)

Pay: $16\.00 \- $19\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Are you available to work every Saturday and Sunday?

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
### **About Us**



Aptitude 8 is the leading HubSpot solutions consultancy for companies with complex CRM operations, advanced tech stacks, and ambitious growth goals. We design and implement CRM, data, automation, and RevOps solutions that unlock revenue performance and operational excellence. You'll join a rapidly scaling team of builders and operators who want to experiment, solve hard problems, and deliver outcomes that matter.



At Aptitude 8, you'll find remote flexibility, 401k, great benefits, meaningful work, growth opportunities, and the chance to shape the future of how companies operate!


### **About The Role**



We are seeking an individual looking to enhance their marketing career in a position that will allow behind\-the\-scenes access to a rapidly growing professional services business. This role is on our Marketing Team, helping position Aptitude 8 as the \#1 technical consulting partner in the HubSpot ecosystem.



In this role, you will work directly with our Demand Gen Manager on tasks spanning copywriting, social media management, event coordination, advertising, and much more. You will have ample opportunity to learn new skills, collaborate across departments, and have a direct impact on the success of our revenue goals.


**A normal day in this role****:** In this role, you will find that each day looks a little different. On a Monday, you might be putting together the next HubSpot User Group event, procuring swag and promotional items for another event, helping to coordinate a partnership co\-marketing initiative, and fleshing out an outline for a tactical eBook. On Tuesday, you might find yourself helping write emails for a lead gen initiative, making updates to our website, throwing together a social media graphic, or asking for status updates from event venues.


### **About You:**



You consider yourself a motivated, curious, independent, and innovative person who is ready to dive head\-first into any challenge. You're not afraid to ask questions, willing to do some digging/be resourceful, and confident enough in your opinions to provide edits, feedback, and ideas. You identify as a marketer, you are well rounded within the marketing function, and you love working and collaborating as a team. Key items of importance are that you are a skilled planner, detail\-oriented, can manage yours and your team's time effectively, and are very organized to keep track of multiple tasks and projects the team is working on. We are a fully remote team, so tech savviness is key.


* 2\+ years of experience in B2B Marketing either in an agency or in a junior role on an in\-house marketing team.
* Incredibly detail oriented, organized, and love making a plan and sticking to it.
* Well versed in checklists, SOPs, and are excellent at holding your team and vendors accountable.
* Possess a strong creative drive and enjoy things like graphic design, copywriting, branding, and video *(advanced proficiency not required but huge plus)*
* You're an early adopter of AI and know how to leverage it to make yourself more efficient.
* You love to organize and plan events, and you have a knack for project management.
* Proficient at keeping tabs on spend, budget, and working with finance.
* A self\-starter and able to work towards a solution with minimal direction.
* Ability to adapt to change quickly and are undaunted by something you've never done before.
* You love learning new things and excel at gaining expertise through research.
* You are a utility player and seamlessly flex into new tasks and requests.
* You love marketing automation, specifically the HubSpot platform.
	+ HubSpot certifications or other relevant experience are a huge plus.

**Salary Range:** $65\-75k/yr. We recognize that candidates bring a variety of backgrounds and skills, and we're committed to offering competitive and equitable compensation aligned with each individual's expertise.

  


#### **EEO Employer**

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training./

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**


Thrive delivers upon the promise of technology by enabling our clients’ digital transformation journeys with best practices on an AI, cybersecurity and cloud focused NextGen managed services platform.


Thrive’s culture is powered by diverse talent, big ideas, and a customer\-first mindset—and it’s what truly sets us apart. Thrive is built for people who want more than a weekday routine. If you’re hungry to grow, eager to tackle new challenges and ready to drive real impact in a rapidly expanding environment, then welcome to THRIVE!

**Position Overview**

As an Account Executive on Thrive’s Velocity team, you will drive revenue growth across a high\-volume portfolio of emerging and lower\-complexity accounts through proactive outbound outreach, upsell and cross\-sell selling, and disciplined pipeline management. This role is ideal for a motivated, early\-career sales professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys high activity, and is energized by building relationships, uncovering client needs, and closing transactional opportunities. You will partner closely with internal teams to deliver a strong customer experience while helping clients access the right Thrive solutions to support their business goals.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Manage and grow a designated portfolio of Velocity accounts through proactive outreach, relationship development, and opportunity identification
* Generate revenue by driving upsell, cross\-sell, and expansion opportunities across Thrive’s solutions and services
* Conduct a high volume of outbound calls, emails, and follow\-up activities to create pipeline and move opportunities forward
* Qualify client needs, identify buying signals, and align Thrive solutions to customer priorities using a consultative sales approach
* Own the sales process for transactional opportunities from initial outreach through quote, proposal, and close
* Maintain accurate account details, activity tracking, pipeline updates, and forecasting within Salesforce and related sales tools
* Partner effectively with internal stakeholders including service delivery, client success, solutions, and operations to support client needs and close business
* Monitor account activity, service trends, and customer feedback to identify retention risks and growth opportunities
* Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets tied to bookings, activity, and account growth
* Build knowledge of Thrive’s services, value proposition, and key market trends to communicate confidently with clients
* Participate in sales training, coaching, role\-play, and enablement activities to strengthen selling capability and accelerate performance
* Complete required reporting, documentation, and administrative responsibilities with accuracy, timeliness, and professionalism

  

**Requirements** **Qualifications \& Experience:**

* 2\+ years of sales, inside sales, business development, account management, or customer\-facing revenue experience, preferably in technology, managed services, SaaS, or a related industry
* Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of outreach and sales activity while maintaining strong follow\-up and organization
* Experience generating revenue through upsell, cross\-sell, renewals support, or transactional selling preferred
* Strong communication skills with the ability to build rapport, ask thoughtful questions, and clearly articulate value to clients
* Ability to identify opportunities, qualify needs, and advance deals in a fast\-paced, metrics\-driven sales environment
* Comfort using CRM tools such as Salesforce to manage pipeline, activity, and account information with discipline and accuracy
* Strong time management and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize across multiple accounts and opportunities
* Collaborative approach with the ability to work cross\-functionally and contribute to a strong team environment
* Curiosity, coachability, and willingness to learn Thrive’s solutions, sales process, and client needs quickly
* Bachelor’s degree preferred, but not required for candidates with relevant sales experience and a strong track record of performance

**Competencies to be Successful in the Role**

* Drive and Energy: Brings a high level of activity, urgency, and enthusiasm to managing accounts and creating opportunities
* Customer Focus: Builds strong relationships and looks for ways to help clients solve problems and gain value from Thrive’s solutions
* Sales Curiosity: Asks thoughtful questions, listens well, and uncovers underlying client needs and growth opportunities
* Communication: Communicates clearly, professionally, and confidently across phone, email, and virtual interactions
* Resilience: Stays motivated through rejection, setbacks, and changing priorities in a fast\-paced sales environment
* Organization and Discipline: Maintains strong follow\-up, pipeline hygiene, and attention to detail across a high volume of activity
* Coachability: Responds well to feedback, applies learning quickly, and shows a desire to continuously improve
* Collaboration: Works effectively with internal teams to support clients, solve problems, and move opportunities forward
* Adaptability: Adjusts quickly to new priorities, tools, messaging, and business needs in a growing organization
* Ownership: Takes accountability for results, follows through on commitments, and demonstrates pride in doing the job well

new_jobs.title: Associate National Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**SUMMARY:**

FNA Group is a world class and leading manufacturer of consumer and industrial pressure washers and other outdoor power equipment. FNA's highly acclaimed brands include Simpson, Delco and CRX. Exclusive licenses with recognizable brands such as DeWalt, Stanley Black \& Decker and Craftsman further strengthens FNA's market presence and awareness. FNA is a dynamic organization with unprecedented growth due largely to its ability to attract and retain highly talented associates.


We have an excellent opportunity for a results\-oriented Associate National Account Manager who can work remotely from a home office in the southeastern United States.

 **Job Description:**


As an Associate National Account Manager for FNA Group, you will be responsible for developing and growing key retail partnerships within the company's consumers portfolio. You will support our sales initiatives with our customers in efforts of growing our business. Additionally, you will interface with FNA Group Demand Planning, Marketing, and Product teams in developing selling strategies, launching new products and aligning our forecast in efforts of delivering incremental business for your customers while maintaining targeted volume and profitability levels. The Associate National Account Manager can work remotely from a home office in the southeastern United States.

 **Duties / Responsibilities:**

* Support the National Account Team in developing and executing the annual account strategy and targets.
* Develop relationships with key customer partners across merchant, inventory, and online teams.
* Work cross\-functionally with internal teams to execute new product launches, maintain current listings, and identify opportunities with assortment.
* Master product knowledge for assigned customer.
* Ability to present in front of internal and external key decision makers.
* Assist in building customer presentations for product line reviews, business reviews, product launches, promotional planning, and assortment recommendations.
* Analyze POS, inventory, market\-share, promotional, and competitive data to identify risks and growth opportunities.
* Partner with demand planning and supply chain teams to ensure inventory aligns with retailer forecasts, promotions, resets, and product transitions.
* Coordinate new\-item setup, SKU maintenance, content readiness, pricing, packaging, samples, and retailer\-system requirements.
* Support assortment planning and recommendations across in\-store and online channels, including online exclusives, bundles, and promotional offers.
* Maintain competitive intelligence on products, pricing, features, promotions, customer reviews, and assortment changes.
* Develop weekly and monthly business recaps that communicate performance, key trends, risks, opportunities, and action items.
* Support store walks, product training, trade shows, product\-walk events, and retailer meetings.

 **Required Skills / Abilities:**

* 3\-4 years in B2B or field sales, account management, or channel experience.
* Strong analytical ability, including experience interpreting POS, inventory, forecasting, market\-share, and profitability data.
* Strong communication, presentation, organization, and project management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate across functions in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Willingness to travel for retailer meetings, store visits, line reviews, trade shows, and internal planning sessions.

 **Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's Degree in business or equivalent.
* Experience in supporting Lowe's, The Home Depot, or another major national retailer is strongly preferred.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Find Your Career With LiftOne**

We’re a family\-owned company under our fourth generation of leadership and have built our business based on the principles of trust, integrity and a desire to help our customers and employees succeed.


LiftOne invests in people, facilities and innovative technology as part of the essential role we play in supporting our country’s supply chain and enabling critical goods to be delivered to homes and businesses. We’re a privately held company, and pair our scale with a strong foundation in our culture and values. This combination gives us a competitive advantage in the market and helps make us a trailblazing organization that is built to last.


We’re looking for hard\-working, team\-oriented professionals who enjoy working on new challenges every day. We believe our employees are the key to our success, and we’re committed to providing a work experience that helps our team grow to their full potential. We offer great benefits, competitive salaries and opportunities for advancement to all our employees.


Be a part of the essential work we do at LiftOne and make a difference for our customers, our community and our company. Learn more about what it means to become a team member with LiftOne.

**Summary**


As a LiftOne Account Manager, you will be combining technical knowledge with sales skill to profitably grow revenue for the company and maximize market share. This position requires someone that has a strong technical acumen, is assertive, personable, and solutions\-oriented. In this position, you will identify new sales opportunities and manage a book of assigned business, develop sales proposals, estimates, specifications, and presentations. You will prepare strategic plans to increase revenue and position LiftOne as the premier partner for material handling equipment, service programs, preventive maintenance contracts, parts, additional repair programs, rental power programs and rental services. The ability to work with people and teams is essential.

**Essential Functions**

* Strategically identify opportunities to grow sales profitably with new and existing customers within an assigned territory. Develop and execute account plans for existing and potential target accounts.
* Pursues the critical success factors for the application, distribution, and satisfaction of customer needs for material handling equipment and service programs
* Partner with the customer to understand their business and serve as a trusted advisor who understands their needs.
* Develop and deliver product demonstrations and sales presentations that explain why a customer should consider a change, why it makes sense now and then why you and CTE are in the unique position to deliver the solutions that will benefit the customer.
* Think critically and suggest improvements that lead to risk mitigation, cost savings, profitable revenue growth or other customer goal achievement.
* Understand and report on significant market trends and competitive intelligence.
* Provide clear and accurate responses for RFPs and contribute technical solutions directly to proposals.
* Identify customer business opportunities by analyzing cost\-benefit ratios of equipment in customer environment; engineering or proposing changes in equipment, processes, or services.
* Develop and calculate finance solutions for varied customer needs or demands.
* Build a strong understanding of customers’ business issues ie: inventory, asset management, ROI, financial statement analysis.
* Maintain and document customer interactions within a CRM and quoting system from first meeting to deal closure and follow\-up activities.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**


This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

**Qualifications**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualifying individuals to perform the essential functions.

**Education and/or Experience**

* Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree or extensive related experience in a technical discipline highly preferred
* Previous work experience with industrial services or technical sales with a documentable track record of successes and accomplishments.

* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities

* Execute the company brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area
* Participation in training and development programs
* Maintain adherence and compliance with all corporate, industry policies and procedures

* BA/BS degree required, Life Sciences preferred
* Business to business sales experience or internship experience and/or sales degree or 2\+ years of pharmaceutical experience
* Ability to identify key decision makers, develop positive relationships and strong customer dedication and influence prescribing habits

* Team player who can also work independently, highly collaborative and motivated to succeed

new_jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Associate - Global Customer Success
new_jobs.description:
StubHub is on a mission to redefine the live event experience on a global scale. Whether someone is looking to attend their first event or their hundredth, we're here to delight them all the way from the moment they start looking for a ticket until they step through the gate. The same goes for our sellers. From fans selling a single ticket to the promoters of a worldwide stadium tour, we want StubHub to be the safest, most convenient way to offer a ticket to the millions of fans who browse our platform around the world.



We're seeking a Strategy \& Operations Associate to improve the systems, data, and operating models behind StubHub's global customer success organization. You'll help thousands across our customer success organization deliver reliable outcomes through better staffing, training, standards, and performance visibility.



You will build the intelligence and operating systems that help Global Customer Success perform at its best. Working across data, technology, and operations, you'll turn complex problems into scalable solutions for a global workforce of thousands.


**Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:**



This is a full\-time position requiring flexibility in terms of schedule. Nights and/or weekends may be required based on the needs of the business.


**This role is hybrid in Atlanta, GA, and may require up to 20% travel to company offices in New York, Los Angeles, Limerick, and other international partner locations.**



**What You'll Do**
* Build the single source of truth for customer success performance, connecting service quality, productivity, staffing, training, and customer outcomes.
* Use AI, automation, and rapid prototyping to transform manual reporting and operational processes into faster, smarter, and more scalable systems.
* Develop decision tools that help leaders anticipate demand, deploy the right skills and capacity, and respond quickly during major events and demand spikes.
* Build the forecasting, capacity, and workforce economics models that translate customer demand, productivity, service targets, and cost into clear headcount, staffing, budget, and partner decisions across channels and markets.
* Reinvent how performance improves by translating customer interactions and operational data into sharper quality programs, training curricula, coaching, and knowledge systems.
* Tackle high\-impact, ambiguous problems – from emerging performance gaps to new tooling launches – owning the work from problem definition and analysis through recommendation and implementation.
* Design metrics, dashboards, and operating reviews that surface what matters, explain why it is happening, and make the next action clear.
* Establish shared standards, definitions, and feedback loops across internal teams and global outsourcing partners, creating consistency without slowing innovation.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, Data, and Technology leaders to test new ideas, scale what works, and shape the next generation of customer support at StubHub.
**What You've Done**
* 2\-5\+ years in business operations / strategy or consulting.
* Strong SQL and spreadsheet skills, plus experience building or maintaining dashboards.
* Experience leveraging AI tools to build, scale, and iterate data reporting and processes.
* Ability to structure ambiguous questions, validate data, identify patterns, and recommend action.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accurate, decision\-ready work.
* Ability to coordinate projects across stakeholders and move from analysis to implementation.
* Clear communication, customer\-first judgment, curiosity, and ownership in a fast\-moving environment.
**What We Offer**

This position is central to growing our school community by helping prospective families discover Pilgrim, guiding them through the enrollment process, and telling the story of what makes our school special.

The Coordinator will lead enrollment and admissions efforts, manage school marketing and communications, and support select fundraising and advancement activities. This is an opportunity for a creative, organized, and people\-oriented professional to make a meaningful impact on the future of a vibrant Lutheran school community.

**Position Snapshot**

* **Schedule:** Approximately 35 hours per week
* **Salary:** $42,000 annually
* **Performance Incentive:** Additional performance bonuses may be available for achieving mutually agreed\-upon enrollment goals.
* **Health Benefits:** Employee\-only medical, dental, and vision benefits
* **Health Opt\-Out:** Additional $2,010 annually, if eligible

* Gather stories, photographs, testimonials, and other content that showcase student life and the Pilgrim experience.
* Maintain and update enrollment\-related website content and support the school's social media and digital presence.
* Ensure consistent, compelling messaging across enrollment, marketing, and school communications.
* Develop creative outreach strategies to introduce Pilgrim to prospective families and strengthen awareness in the surrounding community.

**Advancement \& Fundraising Support**

* Assist with fundraising events, sponsorships, donor communications, and other advancement initiatives.
* Support school leadership, volunteers, and the board with donor outreach and stewardship.
* Create marketing and communications materials that support fundraising and community engagement.

**Administration \& Reporting**

Through thoughtful admissions, creative marketing, strong communication, and genuine relationship\-building, this person will help grow our school community and strengthen its future.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys **connecting with people, telling a compelling story, building relationships, and helping an organization grow.**

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**Business Development Representative (BDR)**
=============================================

**Location:** Chicago, IL  

**Schedule:** Hybrid (minimum 3 days per week in our Chicago office)

**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a highly motivated Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing sales organization. This person will be on the front lines of our go\-to\-market motion, responsible for generating qualified opportunities for our sales team by engaging CFOs, GCs, Corporate Secretaries, Equity Administrators, and capital\-markets executives at some of the most innovative companies in the world.


You'll be responsible for creating qualified pipeline through thoughtful research, outreach, strong discovery, and clear communication. This is a Chicago\-based role, and candidates must be able to work in our Chicago office at least three days per week.

**Role Requirements**
---------------------

* Intrinsically motivated self\-starter, willing to do whatever it takes to be successful in growing Vinyl Equity
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; you ask precise questions and articulate complex ideas simply
* Ability to manage structured outbound outreach to senior executives (CFO, GC, Corporate Secretary, Equity Admin)
* Build and maintain a healthy top\-of\-funnel pipeline using targeted email, phone, LinkedIn, and industry research
* Comfort operating within a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment where processes evolve quickly
* Demonstrated discipline with CRM hygiene, follow\-up, and detailed documentation
* A growth mindset and willingness to iterate, learn, and improve daily
* Ability to collaborate closely with the sales team to support strategic deal cycles
* Represent Vinyl Equity with professionalism and industry fluency in every interaction
* Must be based in Chicago and able to be in\-office 3\+ days per week
* Bachelor's degree

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------

* Prior BDR or other customer\-facing experience
* Familiarity with HubSpot
* Experience selling into financial services, fintech, SaaS, or B2B enterprise accounts
* Exposure to equity management, corporate governance, or capital markets
* Experience at a high\-growth startup

**You could be a great fit if**
-------------------------------

* You communicate with clarity: succinct, direct, and confident with senior audiences
* You enjoy guiding prospects through the early stages of their buying process by identifying pain, impact, and urgency
* You are curious, intellectually engaged, and eager to become an expert in capital markets, equity operations, and compliance workflows
* You take pride in operational excellence, including precise CRM updates, tight follow\-ups, and well\-structured outreach sequences
* You're motivated by fast growth and excited by the pace, autonomy, and opportunity that comes with an early\-stage startup
* You bring persistence and grit, and you are energized by hitting ambitious pipeline goals
* You thrive in environments where creativity and problem\-solving are essential to success
* You're energized by the idea of helping introduce real innovation into an industry that has largely stood still for nearly three decades
* You're comfortable with (and thrive in) ambiguity. This role will be essential in defining how Vinyl goes to market, but will require agency to ensure that we take nothing for granted and leave no stones unturned. There is no concrete playbook for outbound sales in this industry. We're defining it.

**You may not be a great fit if**
---------------------------------

* You dislike prospecting. This role requires consistent outbound sourcing.
* You prefer to leave product knowledge to others. Our expectation is that our entire GTM team will develop deep product and market fluency.
* You resist structured documentation or CRM hygiene.
* You prefer slow\-changing environments or rigid process definitions.
* You are uncomfortable engaging senior executives early in the sales process.
* You prefer to fit into a structured commercial environment with predetermined outbound clarity.

**Our Philosophy**
------------------


A few principles that guide how we operate at Vinyl Equity:

* We value high\-agency ownership, first\-principled thinking, thoughtful communication, and a bias toward action
* We believe small, exceptionally talented teams outperform larger teams with average talent
* We aim to demonstrate both product and industry expertise in every interaction with prospects and customers
* Creativity, drive, innovation, and consistency win in otherwise stagnant industries
* Act with high integrity without compromise

**Compensation and Benefits (for U.S.\- based full\-time employees)**
---------------------------------------------------------------------

* Base: $50,000–$75,000
* OTE: $75,000–$95,000 (uncapped commission, paid quarterly)
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401k
* Flexible PTO
* Hybrid work schedule
* Equity\-based compensation

* A generous 401(k) matching program that is above industry standards
* Financial rewards for performance compensation structure which includes salary, commission, and bonuses
* Low\-cost benefit options for you and your family's health and future
* An Automobile expense reimbursement plan
* Cell phone reimbursement plan

**Outside Food Sales Representative**

We invite you to join our sales team where you’ll experience a world where servant leadership and cutting\-edge tools and training come together to support your career growth and financial objectives.


As an Outside Food Sales Representative, you’ll be responsible for the overall sales and relationship management efforts for existing and prospective customers within your assigned territory. * Researching industry and market trends impacting restaurants within your territory

Our Sales Representatives enjoy:

* Comprehensive 12\-week sales training program
* Mentorship program

* Annual recognition events

-------------------------


Required

* Valid driver's license

Preferred

* Hunter sales mentality \- goal driven and self\-motivated
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), Intranet/Internet and Contact Management System
  
**Benefits**
  

Cintas offers comprehensive and competitive medical, dental and vision benefits, with premiums below the national average. We offer flexibility with four different medical plan options; one plan is offered at zero cost.  

  



Additionally, our employee\-partners enjoy:

  

  

• Competitive Pay
  

* 401(k) with Company Match/Profit Sharing/Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
* Disability, Life and AD\&D Insurance, 100% Company Paid
* Paid Time Off and Holidays
* Skills Development, Training and Career Advancement Opportunities

  

  

**Compensation**
  

A reasonable estimate of total compensation for this role ranges between $60,000 \- $150,000/Year and is a combination of base salary plus earned commissions. new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At Northwestern Medicine, every patient interaction makes a difference in cultivating a positive workplace. This patient\-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. As an integral part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to join our quest for better health care, no matter where you work within the Northwestern Medicine system. We pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, our goal is to take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better?

 **Job Description**  

The **Operations Coordinator Breast Imaging**reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

**Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with physicians and staff, both internal and external, to cultivate an interdisciplinary approach to patient care, ensuring efficient patient flow and problem\-solving.
* Oversees staff across different breast imaging locations
* Facilitate the delivery of high\-quality patient care and services in alignment with established policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, including Joint Commission and multidisciplinary hospital policies.
* Implement, evaluate, and uphold service standards consistently throughout the department.
* Manage patient flow to ensure a positive patient experience and optimize departmental operations.
* Promote and facilitate collaborative, multidisciplinary approaches to patient care.
* Coordinate critical situations involving patients, staff, and visitors, providing guidance and support.
* Identify and communicate key issues and trends to management for review and resolution.
* Uphold the organization’s philosophy and objectives while promoting teamwork and collaboration among staff.
* Resolve issues independently while seeking assistance when necessary, demonstrating strong problem\-solving skills.
* Assist the manager in recruiting, interviewing, and selecting new candidates.
* Support the manager with performance reviews, competency documentation, and staff training programs.
* Assess and communicate staff development needs to management to enhance skills and competencies.
* Create and manage staff schedules, ensuring adequate coverage and addressing vacation and leave requests.
* Approves timecards, as needed
* Monitor operations proactively, adjusting staffing levels based on patient volumes to prevent scheduling conflicts.
* Facilitate the orientation and training of new staff members, ensuring they are equipped for their roles.
* Act as a resource for team members regarding departmental processes and systems.
* Ensure continuity of care through effective interactions with other departments such as surgery, pathology, scheduling and registration.
* Collaborate with technical coordinators and leadership to maintain quality imaging services and patient care.
* Provide constructive feedback to management regarding staff performance and departmental operations.
* Participate in or lead projects and initiatives aimed at departmental improvement and efficiency.
* Maintain proficiency in all required applications and act as a operational subject matter expert for staff.
* Perform exams to the expected standards of license, as needed.
* Perform additional duties as assigned to meet the evolving needs of the breast imaging department.

  

**Qualifications** **Minimum Requirements:**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience

**Certification:**

* American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) Mammography (M) OR American Registry for Diagnostic Sonographer (ARDMS) Breast Ultrasound (BR)
* Basic Life Support (BLS)

  

**Additional Information** **Additional Information**


Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

**Background Check**


Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case\-by\-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

**Artificial Intelligence Disclosure**


Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

**Benefits**


We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

https://jobs.nm.org/benefits


Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

**If sign\-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed:** Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign\-on bonus. **Exception**: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

new_jobs.description:
Description:

Start Early is a champion for early learning and care from a child’s very first moments, so every child has the opportunity to thrive in school and life. Our desire to close the opportunity gap and create more inclusive experiences for our youngest learners guides everything we do. As a leader in early learning and care, we scale our deep expertise across program, policy, and research through partnerships nationwide.


We are recruiting individuals who want to join us in this mission and share a commitment to our core values of **appreciation \& respect, empowerment, diversity, excellence, learning and communication.** Become part of our rewarding, mission\-driven culture! We want our employees to feel empowered, motivated, energized, and passionate about the work they do.


This role is central to ensuring the Professional Learning Network of Illinois (PLN) delivers its events, trainings, and meetings with excellence and reliability. As a key point of support for learners, facilitators, and internal teams, this position fosters clear communication, responsive service, and a seamless participant experience. By supporting event and training logistics, maintaining office and inventory systems, and providing accurate administrative and data support, this team member strengthens the division’s ability to meet funder expectations and continuously improve the quality of its programs and services. This position is based in the Chicago office at 1 N. Dearborn, with regular onsite presence required to support training, event, and office logistics.

**Reporting to the Quality \& Systems Manager, you will:**

* **Customer Service \& Event Logistics:** Support the execution of training logistics for onsite events, including catering, materials preparation, room setup and teardown, and the shipping and receiving of training materials. Supports the delivery of the division's virtual professional learning opportunities for the field by assisting facilitators, taking attendance, supporting participant communication, and closing rosters. This responsibility is the largest and most time\-intensive area of the role, directly supporting PLN's ability to deliver meaningful, well\-organized learning experiences at scale.
* **Meeting Logistics:** Serve as the planning assistant for internal and external meetings, including scheduling, catering, and communications.
* **Operational, Office \& Fiscal Administration:** Support Chicago office operations, including office supply ordering and distribution, training inventory management, and training material distribution. Support staff appreciation documentation and division card reconciliation as needed and assists the Operations Team with DONA and self\-pay processes. This responsibility keeps the division's physical and procedural infrastructure running, ensuring staff and facilitators have the materials and guidance they need, when they need them.
* **Compliance \& Data Entry Support (Gateways, Early Intervention):** Support Gateways Authorized Entity processes and associated data entry and assists with the submission and tracking of EI documentation, ensuring required information is accurate, complete, and submitted on schedule. This responsibility is a routine but necessary supporting function that helps the division maintain compliance and preserve its credentialing standing.
* **Project \& Resource Support:** Provide logistical and administrative support to divisional projects and resources, including the HOVRS project, Video Library management and maintenance, and marketing and communications support. Supports the maintenance of divisional process documentation, such as SOPs, manuals, and other written guidance, so that content remains current, accurate, and transferable. This responsibility ensures that divisional tools and materials are easy for staff and learners to locate and use.


Requirements:
* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Minimum of 1 year of administrative, operations, or customer service experience preferred.
* Training in customer service technology, tools and/or methodology.
* **Detail Oriented:** Comfortable collecting and entering data accurately and consistently and following established processes and procedures.
* **Customer Focused:** Proactively prioritizes the customer above all else. Confident interacting with and communicating with customers. Elevates customer needs and potential solutions to the larger team. Strong passion for exceeding customer expectations.
* **Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* **Teamwork \& Judgment:** Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and, with guidance and established procedures, exercise sound judgment on routine and repeated responsibilities.  

Confidentiality: Ability to process, protect and exercise discretion in handling confidential information and materials.
* **Fast\-Paced \& Gets Things Done:** Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, goal\-oriented environment. Demonstrated capability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite.
* Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.
* **Onsite Presence:** This position is based in the Chicago office at 1 N. Dearborn, with regular onsite presence required to support training, event, and office logistics.
* **Physical Requirements:** Ability to lift, carry, and move boxes of training materials and supplies, and to set up and tear down event and training spaces. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

**Base Annual Salary: $40,125 \- $45,475**


As of the time of this posting, this is the expected base annual salary range. The base annual salary will be based on a wide range of factors, including skills, qualifications, experience, as well as business needs and limitations.
